The implemented extended deep CNN network can accurately recognize varieties of real test cases CT-scans images. The learning accuracy of the hybrid method of RESNET101V2 with Feature pyramid network (FPN) and preprocessed dataset is up to 98.68 percent and it is maximizing the standard available state of art technique by a good margin in terms of result accuracy.

articleTitle: Ensemble of CNN and DenseNet121 Models for Pneumonia Prediction Using X-Ray Images
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: When left untreated, pneumonia, a respiratory infection, can result in serious sickness or even death. In recent years, promising findings have been obtained in the accurate identification of pneumonia utilising X-ray image processing methods based on machine learning. In this article, we provide a deep learning-based approach for predicting pneumonia from X-ray images. We applied the averaging technique to combine CNN and DenseNet121, two well-known deep learning models, using a dataset from Kaggle. According to our tests, the CNN model had a test accuracy of 91.2% whereas DenseNet121 had an accuracy of 89.1%. The ensembled model's accuracy of 90.2 % shows how assembling can improve the accuracy of individual models. Our findings imply that deep learning models may prove to be a valuable tool for the precise and early detection of pneumonia, which may lead to better patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Mobile Sensing Based Classification System For Human Fall Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The elderly are at a considerable risk of falls, which is a primary cause of hospitalization and injury. Statistics from the CDC pointed out that one in four Americans 65 years of age or older are susceptible to falling incidents. Each year, resulting in over 800,000 hospitalizations and 27,000 deaths annually. Fall detection and rescue systems based on technology have been developed to address this issue, provide prompt emergency assistance, and reduce the incidence of injuries and associated healthcare costs. This paper systematically reviews sensor-based systems for detecting fallen individuals. This study aims to stimulate additional research in this area of study. One low-cost approach to fall detection illustrated in this paper involves using the built-in sensors of iOS phones to detect falls. A dataset and a classification system were developed to identify fall events utilizing the phone's accelerometer and gyroscope. This approach could benefit elderly individuals living alone without access to more expensive Systems designed to detect falls. Other sensor-based fall detection systems use various sensors, such as accelerometers, gyroscopes, pressure sensors, or cameras. By utilizing the Artificial Neural Network methodology, the gathered data has been evaluated, resulting in a proposed model with an impressive accuracy rate of 99%. This showcases the efficacy of the algorithm in identifying incidents of human falls.

Author Keywords: Human Fall Detection Systems and Classification

articleTitle: Syntactical Analysis of Student's Descriptive Answer Sheets and Predict Student's Performance Using NLP and Tensor flow Decision Forests
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The employment of computer-based assessment methods has become increasingly significant on a global scale for various types of academic evaluations. This approach exhibits a relatively higher speed compared to our conventional manual assessment procedure. The present study introduces a novel approach for assessing students' concise responses, including descriptive answers, through the utilization of Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques. Within this framework, an educator generates an answer sheet and a dataset of keywords to facilitate the examination procedure. The dataset is stored in designated data storage, while the students input their responses on the examination page. This research endeavour involves conducting syntactical analysis to compare standard responses and recording the results in a database. Additionally, an evaluation of the same response is performed using a Natural Language Processing (NLP) algorithm to identify grammatical errors, and the results are analysed using Tensorflow in the database. Through the implementation of these techniques, we can achieve optimal outcomes. The outcomes produced by the system are contrasted with the assessment conducted by the academic staff.

articleTitle: Car Recognition System Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Car recognition systems have been gaining popularity in recent years due to their ability to identify the make, model, and year of cars from images. In this paper, we present the building of accurate car recognition systems by using neural networks. This paper proposes a car recognition system using the convolution neural network and VMMRdb dataset and the ResNet-152 model, which provides state-of-the-art performance in image classification tasks. The performance of the proposed model is compared with the GG16 model. The experimental results show that the developed car recognition system achieved high accuracy of 54.4% and efficiency in identifying the cars which has important applications in traffic analysis, theft prevention, and marketing research. We also compared the performance of our model with that of other state-of-the-art car recognition systems, including the popular VGG16 model. This object recognition system has practical applications in various fields, such as law enforcement, parking access control, and traffic monitoring, and can help identify stolen or wanted vehicles quickly and efficiently.

articleTitle: An Ambitious Approach to Smart Internet Voting System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The “Online Voting System” is a platform where citizens can vote. It can be done electronically, through a website, mobile app, or anything connected to an internet device. The physical voting system is very inconvenient as it involves many issues such as physically visiting the polling station. Therefore, an “Online Voting System” overcomes these issues and will help in providing timely, convenient, and fast voting services. Also, this system will generate a more precise outcome. This paper proposed a voting system named as an ambitious approach to smart internet voting system, which is fast, easy to use, and provides high-end security by using the proper authentication method.

articleTitle: Data Mining and It's Applications in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Digitalization has resulted in accumulation of gigantic amount of data and that too at an alarming rate. Processing such a large amount of data is the biggest challenge of the recent world. Extracting meaningful information and ensuring correctness and preciseness of data is the core of current requirements of digital world. The process involving preprocessing of raw data, extracting meaningful information and deducing conclusive evidence for decision making lead to the field named as data mining. Data mining is a framework of patterns and rules aiming at extracting the relationship or hidden information from the enormous set of databases. The paper targets the healthcare sector and the role of data mining in it. It also presents the challenges pertaining to the healthcare industry. The current trends and the future scope have also been illustrated.

articleTitle: GeoCamp Online Reviewing Application Using NodeJS and MongoDB
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Today's consumers frequently use online search to reduce the perceived risk involved with relying on unfamiliar businesses and services. Consumers may turn to online reviews in particular (i.e., reviews written by other customers of a product), and many are likely to believe online reviews more than suggestions from friends and family.

articleTitle: Smart Contracts and Blockchain : An Analytical Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The conventional paper-based legal agreements have been replaced with smart contracts in the modern day. The way legal contracts are utilized to bind the parties to do business is changing as a result of this developing idea. SM-Smart contracts offer a solution to the issue of trust in the digital era. A smart contract is a computer program that is designed to automatically execute the terms of a contract between two or more parties. It operates on a blockchain network and contains the rules and conditions of the agreement. A software developer creates smart contracts by computer-programming the terms and conditions of the written legal agreement. In order for all parties to be aware of the conclusion right away, smart contracts are used to automate the execution of legal agreements. No third party is involved in the contract's execution. Numerous platforms and applications built using blockchain technology depend heavily on smart contracts.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Incremental Change in Population of Two Cities by Applying the Concept of Extrapolation Through MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Extrapolation is a statistical technique used to estimate or predict values beyond the range of known or historical data. Extrapolation is used in various fields such as finance, scientific research engineering to predict the future values and make informed decisions. The main purpose of this paper is to predict and compare the incremental change in the population data of two neighboring districts (Moradabad and Rampur) of Uttar Pradesh, India by using MATLAB. This work uses the extrapolation techniques to estimate the future growth of two districts. We have collected a historical data from census record of India. MATLAB is using to efficient analyze and visualize the population growth of both cities. Further the data is analyzed and plotted using MATLAB and calculate the population growth rate for each city with the individual year & result has plotted on a graph to compare the growth rate of the two cities. This study will be helpful and useful for urban planners and policy makers in making decisions about infrastructure development and resource allocation in these cities.

articleTitle: UV Radiation's Effects on Silicone Based Insulator's Thermal, Electrical and Architectural Capabilities
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The most significant issues that electronic power implements multiple encounters is infrared deterioration. The overall amount of energy the sun emits is typically divided into three main groups. Since such frequency is less from over 290 nano, has the greatest vitality of all UV light kinds. Consequently, is unquestionably bad for health and even other things on earth, like electronics barriers. The present paper's goal is to investigate how radiation-exposed elastomeric barriers age. Three distinct types of industrial elastomeric electrodes were seasoned for this function using radon and tainted solution. Then, by monitoring leaking prevailing, heat transfer measurement, and ground aspects, their electricity and heat characteristics alongside their variations on the surface were examined. It has been found that contamination of the way to solve has a greater impact on leaking current than radioactivity alone. Additionally, the mix of contaminants and radioactivity greatly intensifies leaking up to date. Particularly, pollution can harm the third high frequency components. Decay reduces the insulations' thermos breakdown frequency and deteriorates the systems' surfaces, particularly the plastics that encircle the filling. Additionally, it was discovered that could dissolve the filling and lower the layer's Al/Si ratio.

articleTitle: Resource Allocation in Cross-Layer Wireless Communication Systems and Energy Efficiency Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: One of the key study areas for the advancement of 5G technology is green energy-saving communication. The allocation of framework resources and the optimization of energy efficiency are the means by which framework execution can be raised under the supposition of the broad inclusion of concentrated base stations. Subsequently, how to really control systems' energy utilization and resource allocation will be critical in concluding whether 5G development will arrive at application impacts. To boost the efficiency of the wireless radio framework and work on the presentation of the blended wireless broadband communication network framework, this study investigates the entrance network communication framework. Finally, a controlled experiment is put up in this study to evaluate how well the algorithm uses energy. The research demonstrates that the approach suggested in this work has particular consequences and can serve as a benchmark for additional, related studies.

articleTitle: Advanced Prediction of Cardiovascular Disease Symptoms with Enhanced Deep Learning Algorithm using Design Thinking Phenomenon
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Heart Complaint, alternately known as cardiovascular complaint, confines different terms that prompt the cardiovascular and is the rudimentary base of demise worldwide over the span of the once many lifetimes. It assorts numerous hazard facets in heart trouble and a desire of the moment to get factual, dependable, and discerning proffers to mould an ancient opinion to attain rapid-fire operation of the disease. In being work originally data balancing is done by using Synthetic Minority Oversampling fashion (SMOTE). Preprocessing is performed to homogenize the input data scale using min- maximum normalization system. Formerly get the regularized input data it sends for point selection grounded on Modified ditz Hunt Optimization (MCSO) system. Eventually heart complaint vaticination is reckoned grounded on Ensemble Improved Convolutional Neural Network (EICNN). Formerly get the dimensionality reduced features it'll be shoot for point selection using Mutation funk mass Optimization (MCSO). Eventually heart conditions Vaccination is performed by using Ensemble of colorful Convolutional Neural Network (EVCNN) models like VGG16, ResNet50, commencement-V3. Experimental results displays the effectiveness of the intended model in rapport of perfection, recall, delicacy and f-measure.

articleTitle: The Impact of Financial Literacy on Financial Well-Being: The Meditational Role of Personal Finance Management
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This comprehensive review examines the intricate relationship between financial literacy and financial well-being from 2010 to 2023. It synthesizes findings from various studies and underscores the critical role of personal finance management as a mediating factor. The research demonstrates that higher financial literacy is associated with more responsible financial behaviors, influences retirement planning decisions, and significantly impacts overall financial health. The implications highlight the importance of targeted financial education and interventions to equip individuals with the knowledge and confidence needed for effective personal finance management.

articleTitle: Multiple Disease Prediction Using ML and Doctor Recommendation by Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: For the purpose of preventing and treating illness, accurate and prompt examination of any health-related issue is crucial. A dangerous illness might not be properly diagnosed using the conventional methods. The development of a machine learning (ML)-based medical diagnosis system for disease prediction can lead to a diagnosis that is more precise than one made using traditional techniques. Using various ML algorithms, we have created a system for disease prediction. More than 50 diseases were present in the data set that was processed. The diagnosis system provides the output as the disease that an individual may be experiencing based on the symptoms, age, and gender of the individual. In order to ensure that treatment can begin on time and lives can be spared, our diagnosis model can serve as an assistance for doctor by the early diagnosis of a disease and also recommend the nearby best possible doctor for the predicted disease to the user. The recommendation of doctors will be based on the sentiment analysis of patients reviews.

articleTitle: AggTrust: New Approach for Aggregated Trust Value for IoT with Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The Internet has undergone unimaginable advancements. Initially, progress was slow, but recently, innovation and development have occurred at an astonishing pace. IoT is a rapidly growing concept in modern communication networks, characterized by the widespread presence of objects such as mobile phones, sensors, smart devices, actuators, and other edge devices. These objects, equipped with unique addressing mechanisms, can communicate, and collaborate with each other to achieve specific goals. In this context, trust, security, and privacy play vital roles in the success of IoT implementation. Trust is defined as a crucial attribute for establishing reliability and connectivity among devices to ensure secure services and applications. Researchers have developed various trust calculation methods to address these challenges. This paper presents a survey of trust calculation methods for IoT systems, examining the available models and methods used by researchers. Additionally, a classification system is proposed to categorize trust calculation models based on parameters such as trust metric, trust source, trust algorithm, trust architecture, and trust propagation. The paper also highlights research challenges and future directions in the field of trust-based security in IoT.

articleTitle: BiLSTM Classifier: A New Approach for Detecting Cyber-Attacks in MITRE ATTACK Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Cyber-attacks have become a significant challenge to organizations worldwide. MITRE ATT&CK framework is a widely adopted methodology for identifying, categorizing, and describing different types of cyber-attacks. However, detecting and preventing these attacks remain a significant challenge for cybersecurity researchers and practitioners. In this study, we assessed the ability of the BiLSTM Classifier to detect attacks in different stages of MITRE ATT&CK frameworks. Our results show that the BiLSTM classifier can achieve high accuracy in detecting attacks across various stages of the framework, including reconnaissance, initial access, execution, persistence, and exfiltration.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Intrusion Detection System Based on Ontology
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: As the scope of wireless sensor networks and its applications are expanding, it also increases the risk of accessing networks by intruders. In this paper, a system to detect intrusion in the network using the concept of ontology has been proposed. It is termed as an intelligent system as it involves construction of ontology and the relationship between sensor nodes in the network has been maintained. The performance of the proposed system is measured with existing detection system having parameters- live nodes, sensor nodes, and patrol nodes, hop and energy (in joules). The evaluation metrics being used are attack estimation rate (AER), false positive rate (FPR) and Accuracy.

articleTitle: Prediction of Alzheimer's disease - A Machine Learning Perspective with Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: According to the World Alzheimer's Report 2022, the current number of people affected by dementia stands at over 55 million. Projections indicate that this figure will escalate to 78 million by the year 2030. Alzheimer's is primarily characterized by dementia, a neurodegenerative condition that progressively damages brain cells. Alarmingly, 75% of Alzheimer's cases go undiagnosed due to a lack of awareness. Machine learning models have shown significant value in the early prediction of Alzheimer's disease. These models enable physicians to start medication at an early stage, which can help delay the onset of symptoms. This paper focuses on the application of five highly effective models for Alzheimer's prediction. The Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS) dataset is utilized, and an auto classifier is implemented using IBM SPSS Modeler. Eight machine learning models, including C5.0, Neural Network, and Logistic Regression, are employed. Among these, the top five influential models Support Vector Machine (SVM), C5.0 decision tree, Neural Network, eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and Chi-square Automatic Interaction Detection (CHAID) decision tree are compared based on their performance metrics. After evaluating the results achieved by the classifier, it is observed that ensemble learning based XGBoost, outperforms other models, it achieves an impressive accuracy of 96.75% in the prediction of Alzheimer's. In ensemble learning decision trees have demonstrated exceptional performance as weak classifiers in classification-based problems. This system proves to be highly effective, easily implementable, and capable of accurately predicting Alzheimer's using clinical data of patients. Findings of this paper hold great significance for enhancing early detection in Alzheimer's disease.

articleTitle: Trading Strategy in View of Renewable Power into Indian Restructured Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Process of restructuring of power industry has already been implemented by the most of the developed countries to aim the reliability of power delivery and customer's satisfaction. Electricity generation by the conventional power sources emit greenhouse gases and other pollutants which results acid rains and global warming. Hence government of many countries are promoting the renewable energy generation by providing the subsidy and incentives. This paper proposed restructured and renewable electricity market model for Indian power sector. Promotion of Exchange of electrical power generated with renewable energy sources in terms of renewable energy certificated (RECs) is described as a consumer to use it as renewable purchase obligation (RPO).

articleTitle: Comparing Maxima Algorithm with Gradient Descent Algorithm for Sensors Uncertainty in Agriculture in Managing Water Wastage
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Aim: The aim of the research is to compare the Novel Maxima algorithm and the Gradient descent algorithm to classify the usage of the water in agriculture that helps in the water management and results in the precision value of wheat accurately. Materials and Methods: The rate of precision is obtained by taking the sample size of (N=48). To achieve the G power of 80% by comparing the precision of the Novel Maxima algorithm and the Gradient descent algorithm. Results: Gradient descent algorithm has the less precision value (75.13%) than compared to the Novel Maxima algorithm (77.96%) this helps in the process of the water management. The independent sample T -test shows that there is no statistical significance difference between the Novel Maxima algorithm and Gradient Descent algorithm with p=0.405 (p>0.05). Conclusion: The Novel Maxima algorithm (77.96%) has the more precision rate of finding the water management than compared to the Gradient descent algorithm (75.13%).

articleTitle: Leveraging Convolutional Neural Networks for Improved Drug Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The use of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) in drug identification has become a crucial area of research in the pharmaceutical industry. Medicine business is among most prior sectors and people think of the uppermost level of care or facilities irrespective of the cost. Medicine key information includes imprint, shape, color, and size. Imprint is indented or written on each medicine in the form of symbols, digits, alphabets, or a combination of these. What's the deal with identifying medicine? As various legal or illegal medicine is around the market it's difficult to differentiate between original and fake. Forget about the normal person it's also difficult for an experienced pharmacist to differentiate the drugs. In the proposed work, CNN is used to identify the type of medicine based on the imprint. The model was trained on Kaggle dataset of drug images, and the performance was evaluated using accuracy. The results showed that the proposed CNN model outperformed traditional image recognition methods and achieved a high accuracy in drug identification. This study demonstrates the potential of CNNs in automating the drug identification process, which could significantly improve the efficiency and accuracy of the pharmaceutical industry. The findings of this study have important implications for the development of efficient and reliable drug identification systems in the future.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Solutions to Polycystic Ovary Syndrome: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) is one of the most popular endocrine disorders. It is a kind of disorder which generally occurs in women when they are in their reproductive age. Women who suffer from PCOS can experience totally absence of menses, unstable menstrual cycles and as well as the rise in androgens or sex hormones. The ovaries will have many follicles at a time and they fail to ovulate an egg every month and may also lead to infertility. The major causes which lead to the syndrome are unclear till date. On the other hand, if the syndrome is not diagnosed early, it can lead to more serious diseases which include diabetes-2 and diseases related to the heart. The major objective of this paper is to review on the application of all the emerging technologies such as machine learning (ML), Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the detection of the PCOS. It will enable researcher to help in knowing what changes can be made in the technologies or what new technologies can be adopted to detect the PCOS. This research paper discussed the advantages, disadvantages and future direction of emerging technologies application in PCOS detection and prediction.

articleTitle: Security Metrics of WSNs in Airport Cargo Handling
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: With the advancements in wireless sensor network technology, it has become possible to enhance airport surveillance and security measures. Wireless sensor networks can be deployed at airports to detect and monitor various parameters such as temperature, humidity, air quality, and movement of people and vehicles. Wireless sensor networks can be used to optimize airport operations, such as monitoring the efficiency of baggage handling systems, optimizing aircraft parking, and reducing energy consumption. Overall, using wireless sensor networks in airport surveillance can significantly enhance airport security, safety, and operational efficiency. However, it's important to continue developing and implementing robust security measures to prevent potential attacks on these networks. Using wireless sensor networks to monitor vibration on aircraft is a promising approach to enhance flight safety. By detecting the vibration intensity of various components of the airplane structure, potential issues can be identified and addressed before they become critical. Wireless sensor networks allow for efficient and continuous monitoring of the aircraft structure, which can improve maintenance and prevent costly repairs or accidents. Additionally, real-time communication of this information to the cockpit computer can provide timely alerts to pilots, allowing them to take action before a component reaches resonance. By adjusting the wake period of a sensor node based on the sensed vibration level, the medium access protocol can improve the overall efficiency of the wireless network. It's also interesting to note that the article provides context about airport cargo and discusses popular routing protocols for wireless sensor networks.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Need of Inbound Marketing in Higher Education
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Universities have implemented marketing communication methods in a setting of rising rivalry among higher education institutions for the attraction of potential national and foreign students. Some of these methods include interactive inbound marketing, among others. The current study aims to discover how HEIs might advance in order to enhance their reputation and visibility through the implementation of innovative marketing communication methods mediated through the student's decision-making procedure. Seven semi-structured interviews and a statistically significant surve) were employed in our research. We analyzed the data and concluded that, among the areas studied, interactive marketing communication tools significantly influence the decision-making process of postgraduate students, leading to a shift in their impressions of the institution and their feelings about the brand. This means that even lesser-known schools with fewer resources can use these methods to improve their brand awareness and image among prospective and present students.

articleTitle: Experimentation of Code Smells Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: A code smell is a measurable indicator that highlights significant issues in the software development process caused by inadequate programming practices. These are usually introduced in a software program during the design or implementation phases, and may lead to more significant problems during software maintenance. The existing methods to detect smells based on metrics, heuristics or machine learning have certain limitations. In this paper, we suggest two models built on deep learning for predicting code smells: convolutional neural network (CNN) and recurrent neural network (RNN). These models use features extracted from source code to detect six different code smells. We then evaluate and compare their results. The proposed approach performs remarkably well for single code smell identification according to the experimental results obtained.

articleTitle: PCOS Diagnosis With Commonly Known Diseases Using Hybrid Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The Polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS) is the most widespread health concern currently affecting women in the world. The defining characteristics of PCOS are cysts in the ovaries and a hormonal imbalance. One in every five women in India is affected by PCOS because of the lack of awareness in women. The late identification of PCOS can also lead to high risk diseases including hypertension, diabetes, cardiovascular disease and obesity etc. Thus, the main objective of the paper is to examine how some features like heart diseases, obesity, diabetes, and high blood pressure can be used for diagnosing PCOS through hybrid and classification algorithms. In order to determine the best performing algorithm in this scenario, the comparison is made among the six simple classification algorithms based on the performance metrics. The algorithm which gives the highest accuracy is further used in conjunction to create hybrid algorithms. The performance metrics and time taken is compared among all simple classification and hybrid algorithms. The most efficient algorithm is then can be further used for PCOS diagnosis which in turn saves time and cost.

articleTitle: Efficiency Improvement of Electrical Vehicles Using Novel Permanent Magnet Motors and Compared with BLDC Motors by Reducing Power Loss
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The aim of this research is to compare the efficiency of electric vehicles using permanent magnet motors to that of BLDC motors by minimizing power loss. The permanent magnet motor and BLDC motor are used to increase energy efficiency by lowering power loss. There are two groups considered: group 1 is for permanent magnet motors with varying power loss values, and group 2 is for BLDC motors with varying power loss values. There are 20 samples in each group, for a total of 40 sample sizes. The calculated G power is 0.8. From the obtained results, there was a statistically significant difference of 0.001 (p 0.05) between the two groups. The revolutionary permanent magnet motor classifier achieved an energy efficiency rate of 64.97%, whereas the BLDC motor classifier achieved a rate of 24.32%. A revolutionary permanent magnet motor outperforms the BLDC motor in terms of energy efficiency. A BLDC motor has substantial switching losses at the same switching frequency. Switching losses are lower in new Permanent magnet motors. From this work, the permanent magnet motor has a greater energy efficiency than the BLDC motor due to lower power loss.

articleTitle: Design of a Microstrip Circular Patch Antenna at 2.4 GHz Using HFSS for IoT Application
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The antenna is a significant component of any wireless system communication device. The term Antenna comes from Latin word “Antenna”. One of the most common kinds of printed Antenna is micro strip antenna. These are extremely important in current wireless system communication networks. These types of antennas are built in straightforward manner using a conventional micro strip fabrication method. A micros trip patch is formed by combining a ground plate on one side and a patch that radiates on the other side. The micros trip antenna's main advantage is its ease of integration into IoT devices. A circular microstrip patch antenna is constructed in this work, and its various parameters were analyzed at frequency used for the antenna is 2.4GHz which is suitable for IoT application. FR-4 was chosen as the substrate material which is a fire-retardant material. The simulation of the work was done on Ansys HFSS software, which is an amazing tool for antenna designing. Moreover, the optimized gain for the antenna came out to be 4.40 dB and efficient up to 92% and directivity up to 6.57 which is suitable for IoT applications.

articleTitle: Heart Disease Predictive Analysis Using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Machine Learning (ML) has found widespread applications in the healthcare sector worldwide, including the diagnosis and treatment of heart diseases, locomotor disorders, and various other medical conditions. ML methods have revolutionized healthcare by enabling the analysis of large and complex medical datasets, leading to valuable insights and predictions that aid healthcare professionals in providing better patient care. ML's ability to analyze vast amounts of healthcare data, uncover patterns, and make predictions has significant potential to improve patient outcomes, optimize medical workflows, and advance medical research. However, it's essential to address privacy and ethical considerations when using ML in healthcare, ensuring the responsible and secure use of sensitive patient information. Supervised Learning methods like SVM, Random Forest, and Logistic Regression are used for the analysis of the dataset downloaded from Kaggle. The various performance parameters such as Precision, F-1 score, Accuracy, and Recall were used to compare the performance of different ML classification techniques. Among the various methods evaluated, the Random Forest classification algorithm was found to outperform the other methods across the fourteen available parameters.

articleTitle: Design of Rain Sensing Headlamp Using Model-Based System Engineering
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Rain sensing headlamps are a key component of modern automotive lighting systems that utilize sensors to detect moisture on the windshield and automatically turn on the headlights. This paper presents a model-based systems engineering (MBSE) approach to the design and development of a rain sensing headlamp system. The MBSE methodology is used to model and analyse the various subsystems of the rain sensing headlamp, including the sensor, control unit, and headlamp. The model is then used to optimize the design parameters of the system, such as sensor placement and sensitivity, to achieve optimal performance. The paper also discusses the integration of the rain sensing headlamp system with other advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), using a model-based approach. The results of the study demonstrate that the MBSE approach is an effective method for the design and development of rain sensing headlamp systems, and can be used to optimize the performance and integration of these systems with other ADAS. The findings of this paper can serve as a valuable reference for automotive engineers and researchers working in the field of advanced automotive lighting systems and ADAS.

articleTitle: Testing of Aircraft Failure using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The aviation industry possesses a considerable volume of information and maintenance data that can be effectively leveraged to derive valuable insights for predicting future actions. The primary aim of this investigation is to employ machine learning classification models to conduct feature selection and predictive analysis for the purpose of forecasting aircraft system malfunctions. Data pertaining to the maintenance and failure of aircraft equipment was gathered over a span of two years. The data was subsequently subjected to cleaning procedures, followed by the application of feature engineering and feature selection techniques. Model building and evaluation were then carried out. The Residual Life (RL) metric is utilized for the purpose of forecasting aircraft equipment failure. In order to facilitate the classification process, the continuous variable is transformed into a binary classification problem by establishing a threshold RL value. This enables the classification model to issue a warning in advance of the equipment's breakdown, thereby affording response teams an adequate amount of time to take appropriate action. The experimental outcomes of our classification model exhibit the efficacy of our model in predicting the malfunction of aircraft machinery.

articleTitle: Augmented Selection of Cluster Heads and Enlightening Network Lifetime in Underwater Wireless Sensor Networks Using Grey Wolf Optimization (GWO)
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The Underwater Wireless Sensor Network (UWSN) is a collection of sensor nodes deployed beneath the seabed to monitor and record challenging applications in offshore exploration and oceanic environments. In order to ensure proper energy consumption in a dynamic environment, the effective forwarding of data packets through efficient paths is crucial. Routing, therefore, plays a significant role in reducing power consumption by making informed decisions on packet destinations. In this study, we propose and analyze an efficient routing technique for underwater wireless sensor networks based on Grey-Wolf Optimization. The proposed technique is evaluated under various conditions, and the experimental results demonstrate a reduced number of iterations for selecting a cluster head, leading to a longer network lifetime compared to existing protocols such as Energy Efficient Routing Protocol (EERP) and Directional Flooding based Routing (DFR).

articleTitle: Enhancing The Felsenstein Method To Reinvigorate Phylogenetic Starting In The Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The present research examines how the Felsenstein approach might be improved in light of huge data and evolutionary inference. The Felsenstein approach, phylogeny starting points, huge data, statistical techniques, and testing hypotheses are among the important ideas and terms covered in the overview. It emphasizes the importance of repeatability in evolutionary inferences as well as the difficulties brought on by rogue genera and bootstrapping proportions. The article suggests a brand-new strategy to increase the accuracy of phylogenetic investigations that makes use of transfer separation and bipartition distance. The abstract's conclusion emphasizes the need of better methods for managing huge datasets and for recognizing instability taxonomic.

articleTitle: Solar Wireless Electric Vehicle Charging System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The drastic changes in solar-based devices are changing and they are solar-based for charging electric vehicles and other appliances. Electric vehicles are used for reducing pollution through which the machines are dedicatedly designed in the way to reduce pollution. Electric vehicles brilliantly hit the roads to introduce the main factor of technology. The production of electric vehicles is increased and mainly manufactured to increase the demand for vehicles in the current era. The main motive of the solar-based approach is to reduce the cost consumption and helps the user to achieve a more fertile amount of fuel for traveling. The sensors and the microcontrollers are used to increase the capacity of the vehicle powering time and maintain the process of vehicle ambiance. Electricity-based vehicles are proven to reduce the stress on the environment and help to increase the power of the traveling time with more ambiance and the controlled nature of the devising units. The main aim of the system is to help the controller to reduce the maintenance cost and retardation time of the circuitry to help the manufacturer to reduce the cost and increased the effectiveness of the system. The controlled nature of the system and the failure ranges are reduced and mainly proctored to increase the sector value. The main aim of the system is revealed through the process of communication through the demanding system of maintenance through the networking protocol.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Tree-based Ensemble Bagging for Vehicle Fall Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The effects of a car falling from a great height may be disastrous and even fatal. Serious injuries include shattered bones, head trauma, and spinal cord damage can happen to both passengers and drivers. A fall from a great height can occasionally be lethal. Anxiety and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) are two psychological effects that might result from such an accident. A vehicle fall can result in bodily injuries as well as monetary and legal repercussions. The driver or manufacturer may be held accountable for damages if a vehicle overturns due to carelessness or defective parts. Long court fights, financial settlements, and even bankruptcy may come from this. Platforms from the Internet of Things (IoT) have been heavily used recently to speed up rescue efforts after accidents. The suggested system builds a tree ensemble bagging based fall occurrence and classification model to report the occurrence and severity of a vehicle fall-off using data from smartphone and linked sensors that measure the rate of linear acceleration, altitude, and the speed of the vehicle. The study's findings demonstrate that the tree-based ensemble bagging method is a promising method for identifying vehicle falls and can greatly increase the safety of automobiles on the road. Metrics like precision, recall, and F1 score are used to assess the performance of the newly presented model. With a 0.94, the model is found to be very accurate.

articleTitle: Analysis of Different Wavelet for Removal of Single Channel Mixed Signal Noise
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In the past many speech enhancement methods has been developed. These methods improved the signal quality but these techniques enhanced the signal quality but were unable to eliminate the melodic noise that was already present in the signal. To some extent, the wavelet based methods are effective to such type of noises. In this paper, we present the study some mother wavelets function for the for enhancement of mixed noisy signal using binary mask thershoding function. In this paper we decomposed the mother wavelet up to three levels for speech enhancement purpose. Here we make the use of six mother wavelets. These are symlet(order 4 and 18),coifet5, bioorthogonal 3.1 and Deubechies (order 10 and 40) and performance of Hindi speech singnal is analysed on the biases of SNR,FwSNR, Cepstrum distance, PESQ, OVL1. Our findings demonstrate that coifrt5 and Deubechies40 mother wavelets are more successful at removing noise for a given binary mask thresholding function. MATLAB 2018a was used to implement the algorithms.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Cloud Security: Issues & Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Cloud Computing is a profitable and tensile interface for delivering Information Technology initiation. However, the perception of cloud security requires significant advancements for widespread enterprise adoption. This research aims to understand key factors in the cloud, such as privileged user access, compliance, data positioning, isolation, recovery, cost considerations, and security issues like data breaches and denial of service attacks. It explores emerging technologies and advancements to address vulnerabilities and enhance cloud security. The research paper presents a comprehensive framework covering cloud security, current risks, industry significance, research challenges, and hypothesized future advances.

articleTitle: Study of Chatbot In Customer Service at Banking
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Conversational Banking is a smarter method to keep loyal consumers by responding quickly to their inquiries. Technology has aided mankind in its transition from the Neolithic Period to the present digital era. The transition in customer behavior from service seeker to game-changer is rapid. Gone are the times when a company could afford to prioritize its consumers' demands later. With the customer becoming the final decision-maker for a company's decision to stay or go, it has become the goal of every company to guarantee that customer satisfaction is attained to the greatest extent possible. When it pertains to the banking business, Technology has ushered countless one-of-a-kind approaches for the company to maximize consumer happiness. One ingenious approach is to offer chatbots to clients. Chatbots created with AI are one of the most intriguing banking business methods that may lead to the bank winning the contentment vote of their devoted clients. It is projected that chatbots will reduce cost of businesses by about $7.3 billion in the next two years. According to Juniper Research, banks will save 826 million hours through chatbot interactions in 2023.

articleTitle: Internet of Things (lOT) in Community based Solar Cooking Technologies
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Solar cooking technologies offer a sustainable and environmentally friendly solution for communities to meet their cooking needs while reducing reliance on traditional fossil fuels. In recent years, the integration of the Internet of Things (loT) has enabled the development of community-based solar cooking systems that leverage data analytics and connectivity to enhance efficiency, user experience, and overall performance. This paper explores the application of loT in community-based solar cooking technologies, discussing the key components, benefits, and challenges. We examine the role of loT in monitoring and control systems, user interfaces, and data-driven optimization, highlighting the potential for widespread adoption and the empowerment of communities through clean energy initiatives.

articleTitle: Testing External Polymer Insulation Materials for Resistance to Electrical Tracing and Degradation Using the Inclined Plane Method
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: An important step in creating outdoor insulators is to assess the polymeric housing materials' resistance to weathering and electrical tracking. The terms “erosion” and “tracking” refer to the weight loss of the housing material and the production of a surface carbonaceous trail, respectively. With the help of the common tracking and erosion tests, composites can only be ranked relative to one another in terms of their tracking and erosion resistance, which makes it impossible to quantify these properties in absolute terms. Failure due to the track was a major issue during the early stages of the usage of organic insulating materials. The introduction of tracking-resistant composites with significant inorganic filler content has increased the importance of erosion.

Author Keywords: DC predisposed exam are some of the terms that may be used

articleTitle: Identification of Cyberbullying and Finding Target User's Intention on Public Forums
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Numerous cybercriminals are active in the online realm, carrying out cyber-crimes according to predetermined and preplanned agendas. Cyberbullying, which was formerly limited to physical limits, has now expanded online as a result of technology advancements. One type of cyberbullying is denigration or insult. The cyberbullying cases are in exponential rise in social media as per the reports of Computer Emergency Team by Sri Lanka. Insulting words are changeable in dynamic and the same terminology may have numerous meanings depending on the context. Bullying cannot be defined just because a statement comprises such a term. As a result, when classifying comments, standard keyword detecting approaches are insufficient. Other languages also may have dealt with this issue by utilizing lexical databases like WordNet, which might give synonyms as well as homonyms for words. Because no adequate lexical database mainly for the English language has been built, recognizing a word like bullying is difficult. As a result, employed rules to solve the problem. Facebook comments containing profanity were gathered, outliers were eliminated, and the remaining messages were pre-processed. Five feature extraction rules were employed to assess insult in the text. Following that, used the Support Vector Machine (SVM) technique. Using an F1-score of 85%, the findings demonstrate that when compared to existing works, SVM performs better. The focus on English language cyberbully identification, which has never been addressed earlier, distinguishes this study.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review on Role of AI and IOT in Prediction and Rehabilitation Model for Brain Stroke
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Internet of Things (IoT) have numerous applications in the healthcare industry as well as other areas of daily life. Which shows a remarkable change in the early prediction and rehabilitation of fatal diseases including cancer, heart attack, brain stroke, etc. and out of these, coronary artery disease is the most deadly disease, followed by brain stroke. Brain stroke is a critical medical condition that may cause even death if not treated on time. The aim of this paper is to study the significance of AI sub category i.e. Machine Learning (ML) and IoT techniques for brain stroke prediction and rehabilitation. The study is classified into 3 categories, and then to thoroughly review literature survey for each category. The literature survey from 2016 to 2023 shows a total of 25 studies. To predict and rehabilitate the brain stroke in real time environment, indicate a research gap that needs to be filled.

articleTitle: Smart Auto Image Captioning Using LSTM and Densenet Network
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The integration of semantic attention increase photo captioning ability. The premise underlying semantic attention-based techniques is that the model should prioritize words or qualities with high semantic value. Prior studies focused on the attribute detector and the captioning network as distinct entities. This hampers the best use of semantic data. Image captioning is the computational process of producing accurate written descriptions of an image's or video's visual content. Captioning images makes it easier to construct contextualized interpretations, allowing people to situate photographs within a larger context. Using photo captions can be useful in a variety of contexts, such as conducting research with an unlabeled image collection or attempting to identify. previously unknown patterns. Subtitles added to the photos using a Deep Learning Model. Recent advances in the fields of deep learning and natural language processing have made it much easier to generate captions for input photographs. This study will use neural networks to generate image captions on their own. The Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) model, a type of recurrent neural network, used as an encoder, together with a pre-trained lexicon and visual attributes. This enables the extraction of image data and the generation of captions.

articleTitle: The Impact of AI on Sustainability Reporting in Accounting
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Sustainability reporting has gained significant importance in recent years, with organizations increasingly recognizing the need to report on their environmental, social, and governance (ESG) performance. The traditional methods of collecting and reporting ESG data are often manual and time-consuming, leading to errors and inconsistencies. The emergence of Accounting, which integrates emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), blockchain, big data analytics, and robotic process automation (RPA) into the accounting profession, provides an opportunity to enhance the quality and effectiveness of sustainability reporting. The integration of AI in sustainability reporting has several potential benefits, including the automation of ESG data collection and analysis, the identification of trends and patterns in ESG data, and the provision of real-time insights into sustainability performance. This research paper investigates the impact of AI on sustainability reporting in Accounting.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Mathematics Learning: Exploring the Potential of Robotics and AI as Interactive Tools for Personalized and Engaging Mathematical Education
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Mathematical learning comprehends mathematical ideas in the past few years. By using the digitalization of technology, resources improved in terms of interactivity, interest, and accessibility. Rapid growth in digitalization leads to the efficient use of mathematical learning tools. There are vast ranges of resources available for mathematical education. Advanced technologies such as Robotics and AI inclusion in mathematical learning revolutionize learning experiences, developing learning environments and emphasizing creativity. Various applications of AI & Robotics in mathematical learning have been evaluated. Mathematical learning tools setbacks the revolution in the education sector for the growing interest of students and faculties. Logo programming & Lego Mindstorm which is a hardware and software have been evaluated for mathematical games. Finally, based on the thorough analysis various challenges faced by the technology have been discussed and future suggestion has been provided.

articleTitle: Systematic Review of AIS Based Trajectory Prediction Models
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive review of Automatic Identification System (AIS) trajectory prediction models. AIS is a vital technology used in maritime domains for vessel tracking and collision avoidance. Accurate trajectory prediction is crucial for ensuring maritime safety, efficient navigation, and resource management. This study systematically analyzes various AIS trajectory prediction models proposed in the literature, categorizing them based on their underlying methodologies, data sources, prediction horizons, and evaluation metrics. The review discusses the strengths, limitations, and potential applications of each model, highlighting their performance and suitability for different maritime scenarios. The findings of this review contribute to the understanding of AIS trajectory prediction and provide valuable insights for future research and development in this field.

articleTitle: A Methodical Investigation into the COVID-19 Risk Prediction Models
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: As a result of the COVID-19 pandemic, there is an urgent need for precise risk prediction models that can assist with the identification of individuals who are at a high risk of contracting the illness or experiencing severe outcomes. In this article, a comprehensive review of the previous research on COVID-19 risk prediction models has been done in the academic literature. Following the principles laid forth by the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA), we have undertaken this analysis, and it features an exhaustive search of numerous databases The various models are identified, their quality is evaluated, and throughout the process, both their benefits and drawbacks are emphasized. These findings present recommendations for directions that future research should take and provide insights into the current state of COVID-19 risk prediction modeling. In this study, we also provide 10 recent research articles that evaluate a variety of machine learning models applied to healthcare, as well as COVID-19.

articleTitle: Data Engineering: An Overview from a Future Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Data engineering is now an essential subject for handling, processing, and analysing big data as the amount of data collected is increasing exponentially. This paper gives a future-focused overview of data engineering. The creation, building, upkeep, and optimization of data architecture, infrastructure, and pipelines are all essential components of data engineering, a field within data science. Data pipelines that can effectively process massive volumes of data from diverse sources and formats must be built using data engineering techniques that are reliable, scalable, and flexible. Data warehousing, data modelling, SQL databases, NoSQL databases, and Apache Hadoop and Spark are just a few examples of the tools and technologies that fall under the broad umbrella of data engineering. Data scientists, analysts, and business users should have rapid access to correct data, which is the main objective of data engineering. In addition to optimizing data storage and performance, data engineering also entails guaranteeing the quality, integrity, and security of the data. Data engineering is an essential phase in the workflow for data scientists since it enables them to carry out advanced analytics, machine learning, and other data-driven operations. In conclusion, data engineering is a vital part of the ecosystem for data science, which offers the tools and infrastructure required for data processing and analysis. Companies may build strong, scalable data pipelines that foster business insights and innovation by utilizing best practices in data engineering. Data engineering is an important field that will continue to grow and transform in the coming years. Data engineers and organizations that can adapt to change and take advantage of emerging technologies and trends will be in the best position to succeed in a data-driven future.

articleTitle: Contemporary Trend Analysis on Depression Detection Using EEG, Eye Gazing and Facial Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Depression, being one of the scorching issues of the present era and contributes as a major cause of suicidal death over the world, affects around 280 million people worldwide. Like the other mendable disease, depression can be cured completely with proper and proactive diagnosis. The lack of awareness and reluctance to visit a clinical practitioner may make the situation more critical for a patient having depressive disorder. In this paper, we have reviewed available literature on three prime focuses- Eye gaze measuring, EEG and facial emotion recognition. The main aim of this paper is to perform a systematic review of the available literatures in the selected area and explore the trend in this area and try to indicate the future direction also. Around 130 papers from peer-reviewed, High-Impact journals and conferences like Elsevier, IEEE, Springer, Lancet, NCBI, MDPI etc. have been selected and a systematic review has been performed on those papers to determine the trends as well as to indicate the future direction of this research.

articleTitle: Enhancing IoT Security Through AI-Based Anomaly Detection and Intrusion Prevention
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Enhancing the Internet of Things (IoT) security is among the most pressing concerns confronting the information technology sector. With significant numbers of loT systems being created and established, it is difficult for these systems to interact securely without affecting performance. The difficulties arise since the majority of loT systems are resource restricted and so possess restricted processing capability. In, this study, we intend to study the enhancement of IoT security of anomaly detection and intrusion prevention. To enhance anomaly detection and intrusion prevention performance, a binary categorization of typical and unusual IoT traffic is created. In this paper, we carefully evaluate the specificity and complication of IoT security protection, and then discover that Artificial Intelligence (AI) approaches like Machine Learning (ML) and ensemble classifiers may offer new strong abilities to satisfy IoT security demands. This enhancement can be associated with ensemble learning methods that make use of a variety of learning processes with variable capacities. We were capable of improving the predictability of our predictions while decreasing the likelihood of classification errors through the combination of these methods. The outcomes of the experiments suggest that the architecture could enhance the effectiveness of the anomaly detection and intrusion prevention System, with an accuracy level of 0.9863.

articleTitle: Using String Data to Estimate the Shading Loss of Solar Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Aside from a greater emphasis on energy rationalization and efficiency, decentralized electricity supply methods are becoming increasingly significant for the world's energy supply, and their role in power consumption is growing. Examples of these sources include solar and wind energy. While installing photovoltaic (PV) systems, it is imperative to be cognizant of the great nation regulatory backdrop because energy projects typically require significant long-term financial investments. In the recent years, there has been a tendency towards the construction of new photovoltaic power plants mostly employing conventional crystalline PV to pinpoint the system's faulty components. This article uses a PV system in Hungary to illustrate the energy correlations of shading. This study's objective is to present a method for classifying the operational features of strings and PV power plants based on monitoring data, allowing for the estimation of the yearly energy loss. Since the solution is simple to adapt to real-time management and monitoring platforms but it makes the internationalization of Photovoltaic system easier, the model's creative novelty is that its application can provide practical assistance for the operator of Photovoltaic systems across the world potentially troublesome strings, enabling a more targeted examination of PV power installations. The model's new practical advantage is that it makes it easy to identify any power losses due to improper operation (e.g., incorrect inverter operation, adverse effects of trees as well as other objects, or improper spacing among both chords of PV power plants) through a more straightforward calculation mechanism. For the safety of the Photovoltaic panels, the later reconstruction of a strands, or even the solution to issues under warranty, early fault detection is crucial. Also, it is possible to identify any unfavorable changes in the fund's economic characteristics by calculating the annual wasted energy from shading.

articleTitle: Blockchain Application in Healthcare Domain: Industry 5.0 Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Blockchain is an advanced digital technology that has been increasingly used during the past decade to store sensitive information in all small and large businesses that can benefit from incorporating blockchain to increase confidentiality, integrity, security, privacy, and data openness. Modern manufacturing techniques that enable manufacturers to hit their target more quickly are combined to form Industry 5.0. Various manufacturing verticals like smart healthcare, manufacturing plant, smart education, cloud/fog/Edge computing, and supply chain Management (SCM) ecosystems are anticipated to benefit from Industry 5.0. However, trustworthy safe data transfer is necessary to synergistically balance and secure the industrial perimeter since data is shared between extended networks and heterogeneous networks in many authorized sectors. Due to its intrinsic ability to provide immutability, transparency, chronology, and traceability of data, and trust in industrial systems, blockchain (BC) is a preferred choice as security and privacy are key concerns for Industry 5.0 ecosystems. In this article, keeping in mind the need of existing industry, a literature review of some limited different types of security parameters has been done and the journey of the industry has been shown with the healthcare, and blockchain revolution and also discusses the various verticals of Industry 5.0. A comparative study of the blockchain revolution has been done in this article and explains the blockchain's role as a better security facilitator in Industry 5.0 is presented in this article.

articleTitle: Android Based Instant Messaging Application
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In today's digital era, instant messaging has become an integral part of our communication landscape. With the rapid growth of mobile technology, Android-based instant message applications have gained immense popularity. This abstract presents “InstantConnect,” an Android application that offers seamless and efficient instant messaging capabilities.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligent Based Assessment of Greywater Treatment Using Filters with Dynamic Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Greywater (GW) accounts for 50-80% of indoor domestic water usage and is the wastewater discharge from bathtubs, showers, kitchen and hand wash basins, and laundry. It symbolizes water that may be captured for usage at the home level. Urban gardens in middle-class to wealthy suburbs and food gardens in low-income peri urban and rural regions both employ GW on an informal basis in India to complement irrigation water consumption. This occurs in both urban and food gardens. However, owing to microbiological and chemical contamination, the reuse of greywater for irrigation without any considerable pre-treatment presents a potential danger to both human and environmental health. This research looked at the viability of a low-cost greywater treatment (GWT) system for residential reuse of greywater. Filtration, flocculation, sedimentation, and disinfection are all possible with the system's distinct units of barrels. Greywater flows and concentrations vary widely, making it difficult to assess and forecast how onsite treatment filters would react to different loading regimes. The effectiveness of 0.6 m x 0.2 m (height x diameter) filters made of activated charcoal, sand, broken bricks, and other materials in reducing biochemical oxygen demand (BOD), chemical oxygen demand (COD), turbidity, total dissolved solids (TDS), and faecal coliforms under various loading regimes was examined. Broken brick filters reduced COD by 74 to 40 percent, whereas charcoal and sand filters reduced COD 83%, respectively. Overall, the charcoal filters could handle both high HLR and high OLR, but the broken brick filters could only handle high OLR. When handling heavy and fluctuating loads, both broken brick and charcoal filters had a better capacity than sand filters. According to the study's findings, the GWT system has the potential to be a viable and promising low-cost, low-tech treatment system that can be operated and maintained by non-experts.

articleTitle: Machine Learning for Autism Spectrum Disorder Detection: A Systematic Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: A neurodevelopmental illness called autism spectrum disorder (ASD), often referred to as autism causes issueswith social communication. These issues are evident in the way ASD youngsters talk, according to prior study. This shows that quantitative speech variables may be used to judge the severity of ASD.A common way research is one method of identifying ASD behavioral child's expression of signals. Using Machine Learning can obtain the data of children having the autism spectrum disorder. Through last years, applying magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) to detect common patterns type community is a set of stacked auto encoders trained in an unsupervised manner and multilayer perception trained in a supervised manner. Quantitative assessment was completed on 817 multi-site Autism Brain Imaging I Global Data Exchange I (ABIDE I) data cases, including 368 ASD patients and 449 control subjects, and received an accuracy of type 85% when assessed using a set of classifiers.

articleTitle: A Recent Study of Machine Learning Based Techniques for the Detection of Cyber-Attacks on Web Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Detecting cyberattacks remains a challenging task in almost every digital environment, particularly when dealing with passive attacks. Major organizations have suffered from financial losses and negative publicity due to the lack of timely detection of ongoing intrusions. According to IBM Analytics 2022, 83% of companies are at risk of falling victim to cyberattacks. This can happen at any time, and the shocking fact is that in 2022, just in the United States, the typical expense of a data breach was nearly 9.5 million US dollars. This paper provides a comparative analysis of researchers' methodologies and architectures proposed in recent years to detect and mitigate this issue. Furthermore, the significance of machine learning (ML) is emphasized in this paper to enhance existing system security. The review paper covers Denial of Service/Distributed Denial of Service (DoS/DDoS), cross-site scripting (XSS), SQL injection, and other network layer attacks. A total of 20 papers were compared based on the attack covered, performance, collected dataset, and the technique used in the proposed model.

articleTitle: AI-Enabled Predictive Analytics for Proactive Maintenance in IoT Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Wind turbine operations and maintenance expenditures have always been a significant burden, with the majority of money spent on unforeseen unorganized failures, fixes, and downtime expenses. Commercial Internet of Things (IoTs) and artificial intelligence (AI) technological advances have achieved breakthroughs and are truly revolutionary innovations with the ability to monitor, forecast, and avoid catastrophic breakdowns. A Sensor-oriented IoT system (SOIS) will aid in the monitoring of critical characteristics of wind turbines that govern their operating circumstances, such as wind pace, motion, temperature, and power generated. For proactive maintenance of wind turbines, an integrated strategy using Machine Learning (ML) approaches for SOIS was applied. The system's diagnostic component receives sensor data and does predictive analytics in cloud environment. Five ML techniques are used, and the outcomes are summarized for prediction. The techniques' outputs are contrasted for the accuracy of the detected statistics, and it is discovered that the Optimized Artificial Neural Network performs better for proactive maintenance and predictive analytics of the power of wind turbines.

articleTitle: Classifying Turkey Earthquake Tweets to Classify Them Based On Their Sentiment
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This paper conducts sentiment analysis and classification of tweets pertaining to the earthquake that struck Turkey in February 2023, utilizing deep learning techniques. The study aims to provide valuable insights into public sentiments and responses, which can facilitate resource allocation for more effective and efficient disaster management. The obtained results can offer meticulously examined, real-time data that can be highly pertinent for rescue missions and disaster prevention efforts. The study employs a Kaggle dataset consisting of 500 tweets, with 300 seeking aid after the earthquake and the remaining 200 either containing relevant keywords or entirely unrelated content. The primary objective of this study lies in investigating variations in the accuracy and execution time of different versions of the BERT encoder models. Encoder models are utilized due to their ability to capture contextual nuances and transform text. By making use of state-of-the-art NLP models, this research seeks to identify the most appropriate version of BERT to achieve the desired goal.

articleTitle: Big Data and Predictive Data Analytics in the Smes Industry Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Machine learning techniques' effectiveness and practicality in manufacturing, particularly servicing, have greatly evolved in recent years. Big Data has important possibilities & prospects for SMEs. Big Data can foster collaboration among SMEs by developing quick fixes for problems across all sectors. By availing use of the availability for judgement, this may be accomplished. For two major reasons, SMEs are carefully chosen inside context: SMEs have the benefit & adaptability for speedier adapting to shifts toward productivity because of the overall assessment with in sector, which causes a little alteration in them to impact bigger macro scale effects. Nevertheless, there are also several problematic concerns in the Big Data setting, including storing, the capacity of the businesses to analyse and produce useful info from all of this, and privacy and confidentiality. Their use allows predictive maintenance, which yields substantial efficiency gains. However, putting such solutions into practise successfully still needs a lot of work in data preparation to get the proper information and interdisciplinarity in teams. Here, small and medium-sized businesses (SME) frequently lack capacity, skill, and experience. The installation of machine learning solutions for predictive maintenance in SME is presented in this study as a methodical and practice-oriented strategy that has previously been proven.

articleTitle: IoT Malware Detection Tool with CNN Classification for Small Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Since the number of linked devices continues to grow quickly, the Web of Everything (IoT) is being employed change today in more industries. More issues in regards to safety, stability, and supportability are brought on by an increase in smart devices, particularly as it relates to 5G technology. We are concentrating on the safety component of IoT systems in just this article because it is a relatively new field.
