For varied purposes, such as cost savings or a desire to forego the use of generation system, many Internet device manufacturers need not take security into account when designing their products. The opponent may use those potentially dangerous technologies to carry out several destructive assaults. As a result, we created a device capable of recognizing malicious activity from a particular IoT networks node. They are capable to offer detection methods for IoT utilizing a primary key that may be put inside the system using a multilayer brain networks for identification and surveillance. The accomplishment dispels any misconceptions about methods for deep training while demonstrating how that systems can be simply adapted and deployed to every system.

articleTitle: Kiosk AI Chatbot Monitoring System for Early Detection of Mental Illness Among the Prisoners
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The mental health problems among the prisoners has always been there and is increasing rapidly with time but there is no proper mechanism for its identification and neither there is any definite solution to this problem, it is one of the unexplored areas of research in India. This review paper identifies the factors affecting the mental health of prisoners, its types and legal provisions that adversely affect the mental health of the prisoners in India and the role of artificial intelligence in early identification and detection of mental illness among the prisoners. This review paper also discusses AI based verbal chatbot technology that can be incorporated in the prison through Kiosk which would have an enormous database of questions related to mental health of the prisoners, which would ask the questions verbally and receive the responses, and prepare a report of the mental health of the prisoner and provide a comprehensive report to the authorities related to prisoners mental health and it would also help them to identify that the prisoner is suffering from which kind mental health disorder. The modal that has been suggested by the researcher is distinctive and has not been used in Indian prison yet. This proposed technique solves the issue of early identification of mental health disorder in prisoners and lack of human resource in terms of healthcare staff as here the function of putting forward the question, analyzing the data, and sending the results to the appropriate authority is being done by the AI, and it will be helpful in reducing the workload of the prison system.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Deepfake Detection Techniques: A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Every person in this new generation has access to all of humanity's wisdom. Many technological possibilities are available. Nonetheless, we misuse this benefit by using deepfake for face swap. The deep fake method of machine learning, which is popular on social media, superimposes one person's face over another person's face. Deep learning, which has allowed researchers to produce deepfake images and videos considerably more rapidly and affordably, is the main ingredient in deepfakes. Even though the word “deepfakes” has a terrible image, more people are using the technology privately and practically. Although it is still fairly new, recent technological advancements have made it more difficult to tell the difference between deep fakes and synthetic images. Deepfake technology is evolving, and there is rising unease. The analysis of deep fakes has already been done by a number of researchers utilizing techniques like GAN, Convolution Neural Network with or without LSTM, Support Vector Machine, and Machine Learning. This paper analyzes the many techniques that have been used by researchers to identify Deepfake videos and rates the performance of multiple Deepfake video detection systems. According to our analysis, integrating CNN and the LSTM together produces superior outcomes and accuracy, which could also be improved by applying the concept of image enhancement.

articleTitle: Conceptual Framework: Leveraging Artificial Intelligence for Enhanced Travel Review Analysis and Insights
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This study proposes an AI-based paradigm for travel review analysis. Travel reviews influence customer choices and the tourist business. The framework includes data collection and preprocessing, sentiment analysis, feature extraction and topic modeling, deep learning, and insight production. Data collection and preparation provide diversified, high-quality trip review data for analysis. Sentiment analysis and opinion mining classify reviews to determine travelers happiness. Feature extraction and topic modeling reveal traveler preferences and interests by extracting keywords, topics, and features from reviews. Deep learning methods like CNN and LSTM networks capture complicated travel review structures and dependencies, improving sentiment analysis and opinion mining. These methods help contextualize passengers feelings and preferences throughout time. The proposed approach yields travel industry-wide information. They assist in data-driven decision-making, personalized suggestions, destination marketing and management strategies, service quality, market research and competitive analysis, and product creation. AI travel review analysis presents obstacles and considerations. These include data quality and availability, privacy and ethical considerations, bias mitigation and fairness, interpretability and explainability, technical skills and resources, user acceptability and adoption, and continual learning. By adopting the proposed conceptual framework and overcoming the obstacles, travel companies can gain deeper insights from travel reviews, improve customer experiences, and make informed decisions to stay competitive in the dynamic and growing travel market. Travel review analysis, artificial intelligence, conceptual framework, sentiment analysis, opinion mining, deep learning, data collection, preprocessing, feature extraction, topic modeling, insights generation, decision-making, personalized recommendations, destination marketing.

articleTitle: Suicide Ideation Detection: Harnessing Machine and Deep Learning for Early Risk Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The prevalence of suicide and depression has become a growing concern worldwide. Early detection of individuals at risk plays a crucial role in providing timely interventions and support. In this study, we explore the effectiveness of various machine and deep learning methods for the task of suicide and depression detection using the Suicide and Depression Detection dataset obtained from Kaggle. The dataset comprises 232,074 unique instances with two target classes. Through extensive experimentation, we observed that Support Vector Machines (SVM) achieved the highest accuracy of 95%, closely followed by Logistic Regression with an accuracy of 93.96%. Additionally, Random Forest, Passive Aggressive Classifier (PAC), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) demonstrated competitive performances, achieving accuracies of 93%, 93%, and 92.84%, respectively. 1D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) yielded an accuracy of 92.73%. Our findings highlight the potential of these models in identifying individuals at risk of suicide and depression, contributing towards proactive mental health care initiatives. Furthermore, the combination of 1D CNN and LSTM achieved an accuracy of 92.26%. These results emphasize the effectiveness of these models and their potential impact on proactive mental health care initiatives.

publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Social media enables individuals to express their opinions on a range of contacts with the outside world and topics that interest them. Many people share their thoughts or opinions through text, images, audio, and video. As a result, networking platforms cause a significant volume of unstructured data to be produced on the Internet. Sentiment analysis is a tool that can be used to quickly evaluate data in order to understand human psychology. When compared to current feature-based techniques, deep learning models for sentiment analysis offer detailed representation capabilities and improved performance. The automatic process of sentiment analysis determines the author's attitude and determines whether it is neutral, positive, or negative. Analysis of these emotions without consideration for voice and facial expressions is crucial and necessitates a supervisory technique for accurate emotion interpretation. Despite these difficulties, it is important to recognize human emotions as they increasingly communicate via social media platforms like Facebook, Twitter, etc. This article examines the difficulties researchers have had studying sentiment analysis in social media as well as other potential issues, and it introduces methods that have been tested through a series of experiments using real datasets and show significant advantages over other approaches currently in use for classifying text in social media.

This holds true even for those languages that have fewer resources available, such as Kannada, where it is possible for fake news to go undetected for longer periods of time due to a lack of preventive measures for its inhibition. Throughout the course of this research, we have gathered a labelled dataset of 2800 instances comprising Kannada news headlines. This research presents a novel fake news detection system tailored for the Kannada language. The system leverages a combination of machine learning and deep learning algorithms, along with diverse word embedding techniques. articleTitle: Evaluating The Role Of Fintech In Digital India

abstract: The level of financial inclusion in India has increased dramatically in recent years. The percentage of Indians with bank accounts has been rising in recent years and is now estimated to be over 85 percent. While the Indian government works to bring banking options to the country's unbanked citizens, the country's Fintech industry is gaining prominence. India should strive to enhance financial inclusion to serve the under banked portions of the population and to provide a secure operational environment for Fintech enterprises. In order to fully digitalize an economy, it is necessary to invest in areas such as digital infrastructure, digital literacy, and government initiatives to encourage residents to adopt it. India is one of the world's frontrunners in the transition to a digital economy, thanks in large part to its forward-thinking “Digital India” project and vision. By embracing cutting-edge innovations like AI and Blockchain, banks and other financial institutions can help India realize its vision of being a digitally empowered nation and a knowledge economy by fostering a presence-less, paperless, and cashless economy.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling for Disease Progression in Chronic Conditions Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Predictive modeling of disease progression in chronic conditions is a crucial task in healthcare, as it enables early identification and personalized intervention for patients at risk of adverse outcomes. In recent times, there has been a notable advancement in the field of machine learning techniques, which has demonstrated considerable potential in accurately forecasting the evolution of diseases. This development has proven to be highly beneficial for healthcare professionals, as it equips them with vital insights that can significantly enhance the management of patients. This research paper provides a thorough examination and comparative evaluation of different machine learning algorithms in the context of forecasting the course of diseases in chronic situations. We explore the use of diverse datasets containing longitudinal patient records, clinical variables, and disease-specific markers to train and evaluate predictive models. The study also investigates the impact of feature selection and data preprocessing techniques on the model's performance. Moreover, we assess the generalizability and robustness of the models across different chronic diseases to determine their potential for broader clinical applications. The results demonstrate that machine learning models can effectively predict disease progression, with certain algorithms outperforming others in specific scenarios. The research findings presented in this study offer significant contributions to the understanding and implementation of machine learning techniques for predicting disease development. The aforementioned realizations have the potential to be of substantial assistance to medical professionals in terms of making well-informed decisions, which will ultimately lead to better outcomes for patients.

Its key utility factors comprise of patient engagement and adherence, administrative activities, diagnosis, and treatment Despite the fact that AI is occasionally capable of doing necessary activities as well as or better than humans, implementation difficulties will prevent the jobs of healthcare professionals from being entirely computerized for a considerable amount of time. For value-based care to be achieved, health officials must understand the current state of AI technologies and the applications that can be made of them to improve the various service related to healthcare like various benefits, security, and accessibility of health care services. Additionally, it offers helpful suggestions to assist decision-makers in creating an AI plan that would support their shift to a digital healthcare system. Research in the field of drug creation and design is prioritised by pharmaceutical businesses and chemical experts. However, there are obstacles and difficulties that affect medication design and development due to low potency, astray delivery, time requirements, and expensive. Additionally, the drug discovery process is hampered by complex and massive data from genomes, proteomics, microarray data, and clinical trials. This research work represents an understanding of the use of AI technology in healthcare, and how AI & ML plays a significant role in drug discovery and development. Also ethical concerns and legal challenges related to the same are also discussed.

articleTitle: Evaluating the Performance and Reliability of 5G Networks for Data Communications

The prospective effects of this revolutionary new technology on the sector are evaluated through research and analysis. Faster speeds, wider coverage, and reduced latency are just a few of the many advantages that 5G technology offers. This opens the door for the development of new, more effective solutions that have the potential to completely transform the market. The article assesses the possible effects of 5G technology on the creation, adoption, and general use of items relevant to the industry. The article also examines ways to successfully assess the performance and dependability of 5G technology in the context of data communication as well as related issues and considerations.

articleTitle: The Deep Learning and Machine Learning Methods for Botnet Identification in the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In recent years, IoT (Internet of Things) devices and their attendant solutions have become more prevalent, particularly in manufacturing, supply chain management, healthcare, transportation, and numerous other “smart” settings. Thanks to IP (Internet Protocol) addresses designated to IoT devices, cyber-physical systems are now able to communicate with one another automatically. Inadequate protection on these ultimate platforms has resulted in attacks such as denial-of-service, Botnets, identity theft, and information theft. Mirai, Torii, Emotet, Dridex, Trickbot, Gluteba, and QBots are examples of Internet of Things-related threats. With the aid of AI, we can at last create cyber-physical systems that are both trustworthy and secure. Machine learning and deep learning approaches combat cyberattacks by identifying and blocking Botnets. This paper investigates Botnet attacks, which are prevalent in IoT devices due to a lack of security requirements during manufacturing or a lack of user security awareness. Anomaly detection is a potential weapon in the hands of machine learning or Deep Learning for identifying and preventing cyberattacks on Internet of Things devices. In this study, we present a Botnet detection system capable of detecting an attack on live traffic. Next, we employ the Aposemat IoT-23 dataset to evaluate and compare a variety of machine learning as well as deep learning techniques for detecting Botnets based on their conventional characteristics. Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU) is a deep learning model with a detection accuracy of 99.87% for identifying Botnets. Thirdly, we use the Wireshark program to investigate the Aposemat IoT- 23 dataset's raw packet captured (pcap) files for attacks. Then, we employ GRU, a deep learning model, to identify malware infections with a 99.89% success rate and reduced time complexities.

articleTitle: A System For Detecting Brain Tumors Through the Use of Deep Learning and Image Classification with Improved Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The success of treatment strategies and patient outcomes depends on early detection and accurate diagnosis of brain tumours. Deep learning and other image classification approaches have showed great promise in recent years for detecting tumours in medical imaging. This study details a method for automatically and accurately detecting brain tumours through the use of deep learning and picture classification. The proposed method employs a collection of brain images, such as MRI scans, to extract characteristics and classify the images into categories using convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The CNN model learns diagnostic features by being trained on a large collection of labelled data. The model's parameters are optimised through iterative training until they perform admirably at spotting cancer. The effectiveness of the system is evaluated across a number of dimensions, including sensitivity, specificity, precision, and accuracy. The outcomes demonstrate that the deep learning-based approach outperforms conventional image processing techniques in detecting brain tumours. The system's precision in classifying brain images enables early detection, which in turn aids in the rapid response and treatment planning required in such cases.

articleTitle: Internet of Things and Blockchain Data Supplier for Intelligent Applications

abstract: Dependence is increasing in direct proportion to how user-friendly intelligent applications are as technologies are used in a wider range of areas. Increasingly individuals are using these novel technologies every day in efficient ways, according to statistics. Through the integration of loT technologies and intelligent mobile device applications, it has been intended to develop a novel smart refrigerator platform with the capacity for autonomous self-purchasing and checking. This research's main objective is to do away with all third-party verification and substitute cryptography evidence for the reliance on a centralized authority for transaction verification. Although cryptocurrencies are the focus of the maj ority of blockchain applications, the technology is also useful in a wide range of other industries, including banking, automation, distributed storage of data, etc. The blockchain can indeed be utilized to construct decentralized apps and facilitate data accessibility and exchange on a considerably greater scale than the typical user-server framework implementations currently in usage by establishing a public, decentralized system. This research offers a proof of conceptual approach for field phones to hold and share data employing a DL constructed on the IOTA tangles, along with a technique for data access that may be utilized in loT and decentralized applications.

articleTitle: Elevating Cybersecurity in Defence: A Collaborative and Technologically Driven Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: As the world enters the 21st century, the imperative of safeguarding cybersecurity has intensified. Considering the expanding dependence on information technology (IT) systems for a broad spectrum of military operations, the stakes have never been higher for thwarting successful cyberattacks. Conventional security protocols have become increasingly precarious in the face of evolving cyber threats. This necessitates the adoption of avant-garde and nascent technologies to bolster the military's cybersecurity stance. The paper delves into an array of incipient technologies that proffers the prospect of enhancing cybersecurity in the realm of defence. These include artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), blockchain, and quantum computing. AI can be leveraged to automate numerous cybersecurity functions, such as threat detection and response. ML can augment the precision of threat detection and response systems. Blockchain, a distributed ledger technology, can safeguard data and transactions. Quantum computing, a nascent technology, harbours the potential to revolutionize computation. It could be utilized to breach present-day encryption standards, thereby rendering data vulnerable to attackers. Moreover, the paper appraises the exigencies and possibilities in defence cyber security and scrutinizes the policy and practice ramifications of these emergent technologies and best practices.

articleTitle: Impact of Lower Temperature on Polypropylene Electric Treeing with Repeated Pulsed Voltage
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Due to its lack of bridging and environmentally favorable attributes, polyethylene (PP) has been suggested as an alternative to cross-linked polyolefin (XLPE) used as a high-voltage direct-current (HVDC) line insulation layer. The difficulty of the low heat climate may arise while operating, and also the HVDC fiber network may create repeating pulsing energy. This study analyzes the properties of PP & XLPE trees under low conditions with pulse strength of 12 kV & 400 Hz. Additional research is done into how the electrically trees of PP affected by cold temp by pulse frequencies and amplitudes. The pulsed magnitude comprised 12 and 15 kV, while the pulse frequency was 400, 800, whereas 1200 Hz. Temp for the study is 30 to -196°C was used during the test. According to the findings, it is more challenging to produce the electricity tree in the PP compared to that of XLPE. During the same treeing time, the temporal dimensions and development stage of the trees in the PP are less than those in the XLPE. The mechanism of treeing is influenced by the low temp, pulse duration, and burst strength. It has been discovered that cold temperatures prevent the development of electrical trees. The act of tree spreading is accelerated by the greater pulse frequency. At -30 above -196 °C, the availability of large increases the pace of tree development and the fractals. The increased intensity at -90°C does not, however, speed up the tree development phase.

articleTitle: Advancements in Wireless Network Technologies for Enabling the (IoT): A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This comprehensive review paper offers a detailed overview of Wireless Network Technology within the realm of the Internet of Things (IoT). The IoT represents a network of interconnected devices that communicate wirelessly, leveraging various technologies such as Zigbee, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and Cellular Networks. The paper delves into an examination of these wireless technologies, exploring their respective advantages and limitations. Additionally, it addresses the associated challenges and issues faced by IoT Wireless Network Technologies, encompassing aspects like security, reliability, and interoperability. Through a thorough analysis, the paper evaluates the current state of IoT Wireless Network Technologies and investigates their applications across diverse domains such as healthcare, agriculture, transportation, and smart homes. Valuable insights into emerging trends and future directions within IoT Wireless Network Technologies, including 5G, Low-Power Wide-Area Networks (LPWANs), and Machine-to-Machine (M2M) communication, are provided. Moreover, the paper explores notable research endeavors undertaken in the field of IoT Wireless Network Technologies, encompassing topics such as network performance optimization, energy efficiency, and security enhancement. The concluding remarks underscore the importance of IoT Wireless Network Technologies in the contemporary technological landscape, emphasizing the need for further research and development to tackle the associated challenges and limitations.

articleTitle: GeneticSecOps: Harnessing Heuristic Genetic Algorithms for Automated Security Testing and Vulnerability Detection in DevSecOps
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This paper addresses security testing and vulnerability detection within the DevSecOps framework, emphasizing the need for automated tools to streamline and enhance security practices. Current challenges are identified, and related work is reviewed to establish context. Our Python-based solution offers two main components: an automated security testing tool for rigorous testing throughout the software development lifecycle and an automated vulnerability detection tool to identify potential vulnerabilities in system logs and network traffic. To optimize feature selection in the vulnerability detection tool, we employ the Genetic Algorithm (GA). The GA efficiently explores potential feature combinations, selecting the most relevant features to maximize vulnerability detection accuracy while minimizing the number of features. Simulated results validate the effectiveness of our solution in real-world scenarios, with the optimal solution achieving a fitness score of 0.982. By automating security testing and vulnerability detection, our approach enhances the security and reliability of software development. The paper concludes by discussing the implications of our findings and proposes future research directions. Embracing automation in security testing fortifies software applications and safeguards critical data from threats. Our proposed solution offers a promising avenue for advancing automated security testing and vulnerability detection within the DevSecOps paradigm.

articleTitle: A Study of CVSS v4.0: A CVE Scoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In the cyber world, almost all of the attacks that occur are due to the exploitation of some vulnerability of the system. Vulnerabilities have caused major harm to the growth and reputation of the organisations. Currently, MITRE assigns a unique number to each new vulnerability identified which is made available to the public via open-access databases. Further, each CVE is assigned a score known as the CVSS score based on its severity. CVSS is a commonly accepted industrial standard for scoring vulnerabilities published as CVEs. In this paper, an attempt is made to summarize the work done on CVSS. It is noticed that the researchers have proposed improvements to the CVSS scoring method and have analysed CVSS metrics. With fine-tuning, it can give better results in the prioritization process of faults and can be used as a severity measure in other systems as well.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Smart American Sign Language Detection in Alphabets
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Disabled people are of different kinds like physically challenged people, mentally challenged etc. To help the people who cannot convey their thoughts and who cannot hear others thoughts, sign language is being used to communicate with them. Sign language is something that is used to communicate through body movements mainly through hands and arms.American Sign Language(ASL) is an authorized sign language that is taught and used widely. ASL is difficult to teach and learn for them because it is completely new and they have no knowledge about it. In this research paper the ASL is recognized and converted into text through data mining techniques. The study uses a dataset of ASL alphabet images and applies various data mining techniques, including feature selection, classification, and clustering. The features extracted from the images include shape, size, color, and texture. The use of neural networks, decision trees, and support vector machines speeds up the data categorization process. Techniques such as k-means clustering and hierarchical grouping are used to facilitate entity grouping. The results show that the best performance is achieved using a combination of feature selection and classification techniques. The decision tree algorithm with the selected features achieves an accuracy of 96.5% on the test dataset. The system can accurately recognize all the ASL alphabets and convert them into text or speech. The system developed can be used to improve communication between deaf and hearing individuals and can be extended to recognize other ASL gestures and phrases. Future research can focus on real-time detection and recognition of ASL gestures using data mining techniques. CNN algorithm is used to recognize the image based on the images collected. The accuracy rate gets low and the detection is inaccurate. Therefore, VGG16 algorithm is used to recognize the images and it is unique in convolutional models.

articleTitle: Optimizing Real- Time Threat Detection with Feature Engineering Strategies for Intelligent NIDS
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The escalation of cloud-based network attacks has been observed to be in tandem with the rapid proliferation of cloud-based services worldwide. It has highlighted current network intrusion detection systems' (NIDS) inadequacies in adequately safeguarding against distributed security incidents, particularly within the framework of Internet of Things (loT) networks. The significance of intrusion detection systems in safeguarding computer security cannot be overstated, and considerable research endeavours have been directed toward enhancing NIDS methodologies to counteract network interruptions. Learning-based methods to improve detection accuracy by eliminating correlated, recurring, and irrelevant features are a significant area of emphasis in advancing NIDS. Prior studies have investigated the integration of Machine Learning (ML), Dimensionality Reduction (DR), and Deep Learning (DL) methodologies to enhance the accuracy of classification outcomes on Network Intrusion Detection System (NIDS) datasets. The variability in selected features, design, and kinds of attacks among NIDS datasets requires thoroughly investigating these techniques across diverse datasets. The objective of this article is to furnish an overview of prevailing frameworks through the utilization of benchmark datasets to detect atypical attacks and obtain a comprehensive understanding of the present status of Network Intrusion Detection Systems. The efficacy of current Network Intrusion Detection Systems is assessed by categorizing feature characteristics and applying diverse machine learning methodologies. The study delves into the topic of feature selection techniques as a means of augmenting anomaly detection. Additionally, they investigate the pre-processing of Internet traffic data. Furthermore, the article explores the potential of conceptualizing virtualized real-time Intelligent NIDS using feature engineering techniques. This paper enhances comprehension of NIDS by consolidating varied research findings, thereby furnishing valuable perspectives for creating more resilient and efficient intrusion detection systems.

articleTitle: Fall Detection Methods for Elderly People- A Comprehensive Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This survey research gives a thorough analysis of sensor technology and picture preprocessing methods for fall detection systems for elderly people. Caretakers face serious health hazards and difficulties when an older person falls. Numerous sensor-based and vision-based solutions have been put forth to deal with this problem. This survey talks about the difficulties with effective implementation of these techniques, such as sensor location, data fusion, and power management. It also examines several pictures' preprocessing methods, including background removal, object detection, tracking, and feature extraction, which are crucial for improving the precision and responsiveness of vision-based systems. This study also examines the benefits and drawbacks of the various sensor technologies used, such as accelerometers, gyroscopes, depth cameras, infrared sensors, pressure mats, and wearables. Important data on elderly falls is also provided to further emphasize how urgent it is to have effective fall detection systems. With the help of improved fall detection systems, this study will serve as a significant resource for researchers and practitioners, leading future developments to increase the safety and well-being of senior people.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Cotton Harvesting: Advancements and Implications
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This research paper explores the utilization of robots for cotton harvesting in the field of agriculture, while addressing the associated complexities. The study is divided into seven comprehensive sections: (i) Introduction to Agriculture Robotics, (ii) Methods used in agriculture field, (iii) Brief about Agricultural Robots, (iv) Some brief about Harvesting Robots, (iv) Robots for Cotton Harvesting, and (vi) Challenges faced in deployment of agricultural Robots. Additionally, the paper explores the concept of multifunctional robots capable of performing various tasks across different crop types. Each section is further divided into four subsections, covering aspects such as Mobility, sensing capabilities, Path planning algorithms, and manipulative functionalities. Through this investigation, the research aims to provide insights into the feasibility and potential of employing robots for cotton harvesting, thereby facilitating advancements in agricultural automation.

articleTitle: Investigating the Progress of Smart Grid Technologies in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia: Emerging Trends and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Modernization, improved living standards, as well as technological developments have all led to a rise in energy consumption. This led to a rise in power consumption that, if unchecked, could become out of control. This is a critical problem for the worldwide conservation and protection of the ecosystem as well as for the availability of sustainable power. Over the past several decades, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA) has steadily increased its electricity demand. The private, commercial, as well as manufacturing sectors increased consumption is driving the Saudi electricity industry's rapid growth. The Kingdom's recent domestic energy consumption patterns have unavoidable serious repercussions that have an impact on both production as well as trade stages. Therefore, quick action is required to reduce the nation's rising energy needs and encourage energy conservation. The dynamic smart grid can close the shortfall in Saudi Arabia between the country's current supply and rising demand. In order to attain long-term advancement and consistent electricity supply, Saudi Arabia is focusing on its Vision 2030 strategic approach. Recognizing the development of Saudi Arabia's smart grid technology adoption is determined by the consequences of this investigation. This paper succinctly explains the KSA's planned grid system transformation under the 2030 strategic plan. Also discussed benefits and obstacles, such as the transmission and distribution market, the requirement for new legitimate agreements on the purchase and sale of power, and the presence of a generation monopolisation, as well as significant capital expenditures, which are unavoidable. In the Kingdom, the benefits of implementing a smart grid outweigh the potential difficulties.

articleTitle: Improving Data Integrity of IPFS On-Chain Proof
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Decentralized cloud storage is made possible via the IPFS design, which makes use of peer-to-peer networking and content addressing. Its 200,000 network nodes, 2 million weekly users, and 125 TB of gateway traffic as of August 2021 make IPFS a well-liked subject for extensive operational network research. Although research on its structure and operation is scarce, it is used as a building component in a variety of projects and applications. As a result, we have provided some information on the architectural design, operating principles, characteristics, features, and difficulties that it presents. In general, IPFS offers a variety of capabilities and features that can be leveraged to create a fantastic decentralized application.

articleTitle: Digital Twin Technology with Machine Learning Algorithms for Reducing Wastage: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Reducing wastage is a critical challenge faced by humans and industries worldwide. Digital twin technology and machine learning algorithms offer a powerful solution for optimizing waste management processes and improving resource utilization. This review paper provides a comprehensive analysis of the applications, methodologies, and benefits of integrating digital twin technology and machine learning algorithms in waste management. By creating a virtual replica of the various products and leveraging machine learning algorithms to examine data and improve processes, organizations can achieve efficient methods to increase product durability and cost savings. The paper explores various aspects of product monitoring, prediction, and optimization, and discusses the challenges, potential solutions, and future directions for leveraging digital twin technology and machine learning in waste reduction.

articleTitle: Improving Imbalanced Data Classification Through Integrated Data-Level and Algorithm-Level Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Imbalanced class distribution is common issue in machine learning and data mining. It affects various applications like fraud detection, medical diagnosis, and network intrusion detection. The mentioned problem occurs when the majority class greatly outnumbers the minority class, hindering learning systems designed for balanced distribution. Furthermore, presence of overlapping instances between two classes exacerbates problem. This paper introduces a novel method that integrates ensemble and cost-sensitive techniques at algorithm-level with OSBNR approach at data-level to address this challenge. Furtherly, suggested technique is compared with conventional resampling methods, in conjunction with three ensemble algorithms and three cost-sensitive algorithms, to determine optimal combination. Simulation presents OSBNR is having optimal results in terms of processing time and evaluation metrics like G-mean, AUC-ROC, TPR-Recall, precision, Fl-score and FPR. PyOSBNR is simulated as python index package which can easily handle class imbalance in the presence of behavioral noise.

articleTitle: The Empirical Analysis of Machine Learning-Based Techniques for Improving Cyber Security
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The absence of training statistics is still the major obstacle among the numerous that tend to cause cyberattack identification difficult to identify. Millions of consumers are still at risk due to an absence of knowledge about website activities and characteristics that could lead to an attack, even when businesses and companies utilize well-known network surveillance technologies. In reality, the majority of attacks happen not since attackers employ sophisticated programming and evasive strategies, yet rather since victims lack the fundamental skills needed to recognize and prevent the attacks.Regardless of these difficulties, machine learning (ML) is demonstrated to fundamentally alter our awareness of the context of cyberattacks. For this research, ML techniques were applied to data from phishing websites to improve cybersecurity by contrasting five techniques and offering knowledge that the broad accessible may employ to prevent common phishing traps. The research outcomes imply that the neural network (NN) technique is the most effective one. Since NNs are built on multi-layer perceptrons, the foundation of intelligence, phishing identification will eventually be automated and transformed into an artificial intelligence endeavor.

articleTitle: Measuring the Implications of Email Viruses Through a Unified Model of Cyber Security
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The vast majority of email viruses propagate by ensuring that every address included in the address book of the victim is sent the malicious message or attachment. There are a variety of approaches that can be utilized in order to package and present these viruses. Some of them can be immediately identified as malicious based on the content of the body, the sender, who may or may not be trustworthy, and the subject lines, which are just unintelligible. It may be difficult for receivers to identify individual email messages that include malware since the malicious actor puts a lot of effort into making it appear as though the email message was sent from a respectable sender. Phishing is an attempt to steal sensitive information by impersonating a trustworthy entity, typically a business. Cybersecurity is an extremely important topic in the field of information technology. Information security is one of the most pressing problems facing our generation at the moment. When we think of cyber security, the first thing that comes to mind is cybercrime, which is expanding at an alarming rate. This is because cybercrime is the most common kind of online crime. In order to put an end to these cybercrimes, various governments and businesses are pursuing a variety of preventative measures. In spite of the many safeguards in place, a significant number of people continue to be anxious about the safety of their online activity. The difficulties surrounding the use of email viruses as a threat to cyber security are the primary focus of this article. From the point of view of email viruses, a unified approach for assessing the level of cyber security has been developed. In addition to this, it examines the most recent developments in the methods of cyber security, as well as the ethics and trends that are influencing the industry.

articleTitle: An Insight Through Reviews on Neural Network Based Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Since quite some time ago, companies have been collecting information and storing it in large data centers, where it is protected from unauthorized access. These data centers also have strict security protocols in place. Even though this information is not difficult to get, a very small number of companies have showed an interest in determining the extent to which it is really important. These businesses are having trouble finding out how to add value to their products and services, which is a major obstacle for them. Data mining is a potential solution that might be used to address the problem. Data miners have access to a wide variety of analytical methods, some of which include Artificial Neural Networks, Regression, and Decision Trees. These are just a few of the numerous options. The “black box” nature of the systems causes many practitioners to have skepticism about the topology of neural networks, despite the fact that these systems have a variety of applications that may profit from their utilization. This article takes a look at artificial neural networks and presents reasons against the widespread use of such networks in data mining. The field of data mining makes extensive use of neural networks for a variety of tasks for a variety of reasons. Neural networks are favored in the field of data mining despite having a complicated architecture, a long training period, and a murky presentation of the findings. This is as a result of the superior accuracy and much improved capacity of neural networks to tolerate background noise. Both the basic technologies and processes and the crucial technologies and procedures that are necessary to conduct out data mining based on neural networks are comprehensively described in this article. The study focuses on the fundamental technologies and procedures.

articleTitle: Unleashing the Power of Generative Artificial Intelligence: Exploring its Boundless Potential and Overcoming Challenges in Academic Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Integrating generative artificial intelligence tools can allow one to manage and develop novel business methods efficiently. With the introduction of self-learning generative artificial intelligence (GAI) tools, the corporate world is trying to figure out the applications and their business implications. Major technology companies like Microsoft, Google, Facebook, etc., have shown enormous interest in investing in ventures developing generative AI tools/models. These tools/models can be experimented with, and their business use is being explored. The study aims to explore the potential uses of generative AI (GAI) in academics through its current capabilities and applications. The study also highlights the potential challenges and concerns arising from using generative AI in academics. The study has used descriptive and quantitative methods to answer the research questions. The study has used a questionnaire based on the Likert scale to measure the significance of indirect variables, viz. perceived ease of use (PEOU) and perceived trust (PT) on direct variable adoption of generative artificial intelligence (AGAI) in academics. The sample size consists of 100 students and 100 university professors. The study Mentions that perceived ease of use (PEOU) positively influences GAI (AGAI) adoption. Also, perceived trust (PT) has a predictive ability of AGIA when controlling for PEOU. The use of generative AI in a few years will become imperative in most human lives, which makes it mandatory to explore the possible ways of its adoption in the mainstream rather than avoiding or restricting its usage in academics.

articleTitle: Predicting Rainfall Using an Artificial Neural Network-Based Model
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Rainfall estimation poses a significant and intricate environmental challenge in today's context. Achieving accurate forecasts often necessitates the deployment of sophisticated machine models and simulations because weather patterns and rainfall dynamics are typically highly nonlinear and constantly changing. In India, where agriculture serves as the cornerstone of the economy, special emphasis is placed on the relationship between agricultural productivity and rainfall. Farmers rely on rainfall forecasts to gauge potential crop yields. Precipitation forecasting leverages scientific and technological advancements to assess atmospheric conditions. Accurate monitoring of rainfall is pivotal for optimal crop growth, efficient water resource management, and strategic planning of water systems. To emulate the behavior of such intricate nonlinear systems, artificial neural networks (ANN s) have proven to be a valuable tool. Over the years, numerous researchers in this field have effectively harnessed ANN s. This research highlights several approaches employed by various researchers to predict rainfall using ANN s. This proposal underscores that forecasts based on ANN s outperform those derived from conventional mathematical and numerical methods, offering greater precision in rainfall predictions.

articleTitle: A High-Band Compact Microstrip Patch Antenna For 5G Wireless Technologies

articleTitle: Survey of Auto Recon SQL Mapping

abstract: The proposed system combines SQLmap, Burp Suite, Nikto, Nmap, and Hydra into a single automation tool for web application security testing. It supports popular web frameworks like Django and Flask, multiple SQL databases, and cloud-based scanning. Machine learning algorithms enhance vulnerability detection and classification, improving accuracy and comprehensiveness. The system aims to improve efficiency and accessibility in web application security testing, providing a comprehensive tool for automated vulnerability detection and Reporting.

articleTitle: High Quality Segmentation Using Deep Learning Centered Detection And Correction of Cardiac MR Motion Artefacts Throughout Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Deep learning techniques have been effectively used for a variety of purposes to separate anatomical features in healthcare imaging. Yet, the caliber of the picture being split has a significant impact on this outcome. The large quantity of clinical photographs with significant picture artefacts caused by organ motion, patient mobility, and/or picture acquisition-related difficulties is a frequently ignored topic inside the medical imaging evaluation field. This study compares various methods for concurrently compensating for artefacts and segregating the heart cavity. We address the effects of picture image noise on cardiac MR segments. The technique is based on our most current joint artefact detecting and reconstructing approach, which creates high-quality MR pictures from k-space the use of a By requiring a data integrity term, the associated logistic regression effectively transforms the artefacts correction problem into an under-sampled image enhancement challenge. In this research, we suggest coupling this with a recognition networks in edge architecture. Our instruction enhances three distinct tasks: Segmentation process, artefact restoration, and identification of artifacts are the first two. Using ventricular MR k-space data that has been artificially damaged with untreated rebuilt pictures; we train the reconstructing networks to autonomously repair formation-related aberrations. We demonstrate a high level of classification performance and clearly good pixel density in the absence of manufactured motion artifacts to use a training dataset comprising 500 2D+time cine MR observations from of the UK Biobank set of data. In comparison to several image correcting structures, we demonstrate improved efficiency.

articleTitle: Biometric Fingerprint Identification for Bank Locker Security System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The implementation of the security system for all devices is through passive communication technology. People from different origins and different regions need a security system for their regions for all their platforms. The convincing type of security system is that it makes sure that it works under proper guidance and natural care of the system. The leverage for the security devices is to make them work under proper conditions and the defined process. The One-time password-based technology is also used for the security system and other surveillance of the system. The process of communication and the surveillance system is wholly monitored by the one-time password-based security theme. The major surveillance is done by the process of superior convenience through the successive surveillance of the devices. The metropolitan areas which are under surveillance will be having the same banking systems through the adhesive nature of the locking system for security purposes and other amenities. The user who accesses the locker will be given a username and password for his access and then they have imprinted their fingerprint for extra care and security. People with extra care and security will be endowed with one-time password access through their registered mobile. The mechanized introduction to the locking system will be enhanced through the proposed system. Thus it will help making the system to work on its way to maintain security and safety of the devices which has been endowed and developed through it.

articleTitle: A Novel Survey on Hand Sign Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Motion recognition is an essential research part of computer vision with many applications including human-computer interaction and signal interpretation. In this article, we propose a convolutional neural network (CNN) model for motion recognition using live cameras. We gathered information about hand-drawn illustrations of the English alphabet (A-Z) before removing the background and converting them to black-and-white images. Previous images were used to train the CNN model and 95% accuracy was achieved on the test data. We implemented a model in Python and combined it with a user-friendly software interface that provides a real-time prediction of hand movements using a camera system. Our system has the potential to be an essential tool in many industries and businesses, including managing electronic devices and helping people with communication disabilities. The proposed models and methods provide robust and accurate solutions for real-time operational information and can be used in a variety of situations.

articleTitle: Improving the Reliability in Smart Grid Neighbourhood Area Networks by Avoiding Frequent Path Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In order to address the issue of Smart Grid Communication's inability to quickly recover from congestion that causes the original path forwarding of traffic. The self-healing, self-organizing, and self-configuring networks are considered in the WMN during packet transmission, a new technology known as Wireless Mesh Networks (WMN) that has gained the interest of customers. The traffic is timely transmitted to the crowded path, as well as the length of the routers' packet queues and the congested path's available bandwidth, in addition to the periodic sending of probing packets. In this paper, the new model of Smart Grid Neighborhood-Area Network (NAN), the Congestion Control Notification Frame (CCNF) is developed to manage the congestion by sending the notification message during packet transmission in the Mesh Network (MN), and also the effective route is predicted through Waggle-Sparrow Optimization (WSO). In addition, the research presented the comparison opposed to HWMP under NS2 for the proposed design justification to improve the performance of IEEE 802.tts. The proposed CCNF can allow the portable deployment of low cost and is designed to prevent congestion while transferring packets through the issuance of notification alerts that arise in the WMN. As a result, the new method produces better comparable results than the ones now in use.

articleTitle: Multi Objective Optimization Based Land Cover Classification Using NSGA-II
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The current investigation makes use of a technique referred to as with multiple goals ounces-based land cover classification in order to identify the several forms of land use that are present in a certain area. For the purpose of forecasting the characteristics, the NSGA-II framework is going to be used, and it is going to offer accurate findings. The K-means Clustering method is applied for determining how the Land should be categorized. The tried and true strategy of Pareto Search was utilized for the land cover classification that was carried out in order to make comparisons more straightforward. The data revealed that NSGA-II attained an acceptable degree of performance when contrasted with the results of the Pareto Search.

articleTitle: Application of Soft Computing Techniques for Predictive Analytics in Financial Markets
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Successful applications of predictive analysis can be found in finance. For these goals, modern soft computing theories are applied. In contrast to other apps, financial applications have unique characteristics. Forecasting is crucial, particularly in the financial industry because it lowers expenses, which can increase revenues and help businesses win the competition. Due to inescapable changes and expansion in every aspect of life, almost every organization on earth is operating in an unpredictable environment. Forecasting becomes increasingly difficult as a result of these developments, which either directly or indirectly affect stock market values. The demand for trustworthy, economical, and efficient forecasting models is therefore great in order to reduce uncertainty as well as risk in investing in the stock market. Academics and information researchers have developed a variety of time series models for the most precise and perfect future prediction. Financial autoregressive time series models have produced precise prediction-capable predictive models like the autoregressive moving average and autoregressive integrated moving average. To predict the closing value of the BSE100 S&P Sensex record every week and every day, discrete wavelet change and wavelet denoising soft computing models are combined with autoregressive models in the continuing work.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Leading Edge Big Data Technologies, Nomenclatures, and Knowledge-Centric Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In light of the exponential growth of data volumes and the requirement for effective data analysis and processing, Big Data has emerged as a disruptive paradigm in the field of information technology. The aim of this study provides a complete review of Big Data technologies, terminology, and applications that utilize data. We go into the core concepts and underlying technology and then highlight a number of notable knowledge-centric applications that demonstrate the influence of Big Data across various industries. This paper offers a review of recent Big Data technology developments. It attempts to assist users in selecting and implementing the best Big Data technology combination for their technological demands and individual application requirements. It additionally provides a global overview of major Big Data technologies. It classifies and explains the main technologies' features, benefits, limitations, and applications.

articleTitle: Animal Collision Detection in Real Time to Prevent Accident using KNN Classifier in comparison with Stochastic Gradient Descent
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This project aims to assess and improve the detection of animal collisions in real-world situations. Materials and Methods: To forecast animal collision detection in real time and avert accidents, KNN and stochastic gradient descent are used with different training and testing splits. Both algorithms which are used in this study underwent 10 iterations, resulting in a total 20 iterations. The sample size for the study was 1347 and was sourced from the kaggle website, with the G Power as 80% (g power setting parameters: <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\alpha=0.05$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{power}=0.80)$</tex>. Results: K-Nearest Neighbor (79.82<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) has the increased accuracy over Stochastic gradient descent (75.19%) with a significance value of 0.039 (p<0.05) for both accuracy and loss, which is statistically significant and there is no insignificant differences between the two algorithms. Conclusion: The accuracy percentage for K-Nearest Neighbor algorithm is 79.82% whereas the accuracy percentage for stochastic gradient descent algorithm is 75.19%. Based on the analysis, K-Nearest Neighbor (79.82%) performs better than stochastic gradient descent (75.19%).

articleTitle: Efficient Energy Management in Photovoltaic System Using Grid Interconnected Solar System Compared with Battery Energy Storage System by Limiting the Panel Array Losses
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The main research work is to enhance the energy generation through photovoltaic systems by comparing two PV methods-Grid interconnected solar system(GISS) and Battery energy storage system (BESS) by reducing the array losses. Two sets of samples are collected from each group, group 1 Grid interconnected solar system has 12 samples and group 2 Battery energy storage system contains 12 samples. The total sample size is 24 with the G power set at 80%. By using Grid interconnected solar system energy generation is 4540.7 kWh/year, and the same for Battery energy storage system energy generation is 4282.5 kWh/year. The significance is 0.037 (p<0.05) therefore in two sets of groups are statistically significant. In regards to energy generation, it has been observed that Novel Grid-connected solar systems have outperformed better than Battery energy storage systems.

articleTitle: Design of Sensor Based Walnut Cracking Device and By-Product Classification via K-Means
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Kashmir is a leading producer of walnuts in India. They are considered the healthiest nuts and are very costly owing to their nutritional value. Kashmir is one of the leading producers of walnuts, contributing to about 90% of production in India. However, the farmers don't get much higher rates for these organically produced walnuts as the separation of kernel and shell is a laborious task. This paper proposes an automatic device to separate walnut shells and their hulls making them market ready at a faster processing speed. The walnuts are passed through a conveyor belt where they are broken down by using automated hammer, applying the perfect pressure so as not to break the walnuts completely and ensure the kernel is taken out of the green and brown shell. The shell and the kernel are separated by the data from the color sensor and image processing technology with classification techniques. The device provides a sustainable solution for post harvest agricultural practices in walnut cultivation.

articleTitle: Gender and Age Classification Using Caffe Network
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The availability of labelled data at scale has contributed to the rapid expansion of Deep Learning. This results show that training deep-cnn learning representations can lead to huge increases in performance on specific tasks. The caffe net model surpasses existing modernization approaches for gender and age approximation when tested against the Adience benchmark. It is suggested convolutional net architecture is simple and accurate to 95%.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Recurrent Neural Network over Convolutional Neural Network in Predicting R2l Attack in IoT Devices with Improved Accuracy and F1 Score
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The main target of this study is to more accurately and efficiently predict the R2L attack on IoT devices using Novel Recurrent Neural Network than Convolutional Neural Network. Materials and Methods: The number of IoT devices that can interact with one another has increased along with the capacity of the internet. This change makes the traditional methods and antiquated data processing techniques for identifying attacks, which are useless. It is challenging to spot attacks on IoT devices and recognise fraudulent activity in its early stages due to the growth in network traffic volume. The study utilized GPower software to calculate sample size requirements. The total number of iterations required for the study was determined using the clincalc tool, which indicated a value of N=20 (10 iterations for each group). For a sample size of 5479 and (ɑ=0.05; power=0.85), each group performed 10 iterations, resulting in a total of 20 iterations for both groups combined. Result: RNN (90.3140%) recognises objects and improves the accuracy over CNN (89.9210%) with significance value P=0.757 (p>0.05), which is statistically insignificant. The F1 score of RNN and CNN are 0.90 and 0.89 respectively. Conclusion: When compared to Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Novel Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) has more accuracy.

articleTitle: Unleashing the Power of Machine Learning: A Precision Paradigm for Breast Cancer Subtype Classification Using Open-Source Data, with Caution on Dataset Size and Interpretability
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This research paper introduces an innovative approach that harnesses the power of machine learning algorithms and open-source data to enhance the precision and personalization of breast cancer treatment decisions. Leveraging the publicly available Breast Cancer Wisconsin (Diagnostic) Dataset. we explore the potential of machine learning in accurately classifying breast cancer subtypes. A wide range of machine learning algorithms, including Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machines, Decision Trees, Random Forest, and Gradient Boosting, are employed to classify breast cancer subtypes. Their performance is evaluated using key metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC). These metrics provide a comprehensive assessment of the algorithms' effectiveness in subtype classification. The results demonstrate the exceptional performance of the machine learning models, with Logistic Regression emerging as the top-performing algorithm, achieving an accuracy of 99.12%, precision of 98.61 %, recall of 100%, F1-score of 99.3%, and AUC-ROC of 99.87%. These remarkable metrics highlight the potential of machine learning in accurately identifying and distinguishing between malignant and benign breast cancer subtypes. The identified best-performing model holds promise for improving precision and personalized treatment decisions in breast cancer management.

articleTitle: Estimation of Surface Roughness Characterization in Turning of Monel 400 by Discrete Wavelet Transform in Comparison with Empirical Wavelet Transform to Calculate Prediction Error
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: To determine the Surface Roughness of the Monel 400 super alloy using a DWT Transform (Discrete Wavelet Transform) Algorithm and compare it with the EWT Transform (empirical Wavelet Transform) Algorithm to minimize the Prediction Error. Materials and Methods: Two groups, each consisting of 8 samples, were analyzed using a two-tailed T-Test, with a total of 16 samples being used. The calculations for this analysis were derived from clincalc.com and included an enrollment ratio of one, an alpha error of 0.05, a beta error of 0.2, a G-power of 80%, and a confidence interval of 95<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>.Results: When using the suggested approach, the resultant average error is proposed with a lower prediction error. The mean average error predicated on discrete wavelet transform is 1.33, Empirical wavelet transform is 2.76 and the significant factor is 0.002 (p <0.05).Hence, both the EWT algorithm and DWT algorithm are statistically significant. Conclusion: This study demonstrates that, in terms of prediction error, the Discrete Wavelet Transform algorithm is significantly better than the Empirical Wavelet Transform.

articleTitle: Improved-Hybrid GA-Based Technique to Optimize the Resource Utilization in Cloud
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Data clustering is a technique related to technology that can be used and utilized in vast areas of computer science and other applications. In this work, the technique access and used for clustering is improved-hybrid clustering in cloud computing with the application of GA in the algorithm. The process is started by uploading the text documents on the cloud and the GA algorithm of improved-hybrid similarity is applied and results are considered for analysis. The research is a step towards innovation and two parameters for resource optimization are taken into consideration viz., memory consume and CPU utilization. The results obtained for memory utilization and CPU utilization are scalable and optimal in the carried-out study.

articleTitle: A Small Comparative Study of Machine Learning Algorithms in the Detection of Fake Reviews of Amazon Products
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Nowadays the popularity of online shopping has increased, leading to a significant rise in the number of product reviews on platforms like Amazon. However, this increase has also attracted a growing number of fake reviews, which are designed to deceive consumers and manipulate product ratings. Detecting and filtering out these fake reviews is crucial for maintaining the integrity and reliability of online review systems. We proposed a methodology to identify fake reviews on Amazon using sentiment analysis, support vector machine algorithm and logistic regression algorithm.The objective is to show how well the suggested approaches work in separating fraudulent reviews from real Amazon reviews.

articleTitle: Accurate Air Quality Prediction Through the Use of Statistical Models and Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The practice of estimating the concentrations of air pollutants in a certain area over a predetermined time frame is known as air quality prediction. As is well known, air pollution harms both the environment and human health as a result of constantly rising urbanization. Predicting air quality is the only approach to stop the negative effects of air pollution. Consequently, the project's abstract emphasizes the significance of predicting air quality and how to do it using statistical models and machine learning algorithms. According to the technique, the project would use supervised learning, in which a machine learning model would be trained on previous data to forecast future air quality levels. To discover the highest performing regression method, regression techniques such as linear regression, decision trees, and random forest regression will be investigated. The predictions given by this model allows individuals to be aware of diseases caused by air pollution and at what level diseases are caused, as well as to improve the air quality in surrounding places. This model's predictions may give them insight into how to maintain the air clean and prevent certain diseases.

articleTitle: Modeling Roadblocks of Digital Transformation Practices for Net Zero in Indian MSMEs
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Digital transformation is the process of utilising digital technologies to create or modify business processes, organisational culture, and consumer experiences to meet shifting business and market demands. Current research concentrates on the modelling of digital transformation roadblocks for net zero. Using the decision-making trial and evaluation laboratory (DEMATEL), the obstacles are classified into two categories. This study's findings investigated the most influential and influenced roadblocks. This study can aid policymakers in the development of digital transformation adoption strategies for net zero.

articleTitle: Sophisticated IOT Home Control Utilizing the Things Voice IOT Framework with Google Assistant
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The web is used by the Internet of Things (IoT), a significant technology that enables connectivity among diverse gadgets. It makes it possible for individuals & things to communicate in any way, at any time, from everywhere. IoT-based technologies come in a wide variety. One of the greatest well applications that have raised human being's life conditions is house control. In this article, we present a paradigm for sensible smart management that may be used to buy and charge household products from anyplace in the world. This gadget focuses on interacting with users yet also managing other gadgets with voice detection and artificial learning. Building a sophisticated home management system that is more stable & intelligent sufficient to conserve power is thus our primary goal in creating this system. & human endeavors PIR detector, temp detector, MQ2 detector, & Sensor are the major four instruments utilized in this design. This model's equipment is all affordable, changeable, & available.

articleTitle: An Effective FL-CNN Based Data Securing Model for Heart Disease Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Cardiovascular disease is the leading cause of death worldwide, according to the WHO. Coronary heart disease is most dangerous. 2015 saw 360,000 US heart attack deaths. Effective heart disease treatment prevents global deaths. An updated FL-CNN model improved cardiac disease diagnosis and prognosis for doctors and patients. Hospitals cannot disclose patient data for security and privacy reasons. Thus, centralizing data is hard. Federated Learning can train machine learning and deep learning models using massive volumes of distributed data. On the UCI Cleveland dataset, CNN with Federated Learning achieves 94.99% accuracy, while CNN with centralized learning achieves 97% accuracy.

articleTitle: An Energy Efficient and Secure Framework for Software Defined Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Software Defined Networks (SDN) brings in a lot of features which support the network for utilizing the energy of the nodes in an optimized manner, latency-sensitive applications and security. SDN easily realizes the security in the environment by centrally placing the controller to globally monitor the whole network. Security is implemented using policies for man-in-the-middle, denial of service and saturation attacks. The switch and controllers in the network fundamentally follows FCFS, priority queuing policy. In this research, we have used Multiple Feedback Queues (MFQ) to improve the queuing policy for request and response messages. These MFQ's changeably uses the suitable queuing algorithm to reach high level of optimization. The paper focus upon, i) hybrid clustering ii) a new scheduling model for SDN Network iii) multiple controller environments iv) Policy based secure autonomous systems. The model is validated using mininet, wire shark and Iperf tool and has outperformed the single and multiple queue based scheduling in the network farm and has comparatively attained 10% more efficient results.

articleTitle: Real Estate Forecasting System Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The idea of this paper is to predict the value of houses and properties of the market value. The aim of the presented paper is to estimate the market value of the asset being sold. This application assists in determining a location's beginning pricing based on location-specific factors. The below mentioned idea to find the price of a location based on location variables. The below discussed models helps to find the market value of any property in India through different databases depending upon the locations. The presented paper suggests the buyer in determining the prices of different houses with the similarity of characteristics and properties. According to the survey made the prices of properties always rise every year, so a buyer needs a real estate forecasting system. This research paper can help estimate the price of a house which helps both seller and buyer for a reasonable price to buy a property. The result showed that machine learning algorithms in linear regressions model can accurately predict area price with high accuracy rates. However, some challenges such as property value based on area, characteristics, locality, facilities provided. It highlights the importance of machine learning algorithms for price predictions to research and address the challenges.

articleTitle: Computer-Aided Detection of Atrial Fibrillation Episodes from Electrocardiogram Signals Using Variational Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Atrial Fibrillation (AF) is defined as a heart beating irregularly. It may increase the risk of stroke and sometimes results in heart failure. Lately, the number of patients with AF episodes has increased exponentially worldwide. Early detection is the only way to reduce and control its effect.
