However, it is crucial to detect AF in the early stages in most patients who do not show any significant symptoms in the early stage. Many recent studies have shown ways to identify early symptoms based on the signature present in the recording of the electrocardiogram. Usually, the signature is present in terms of either frequency domain or time-frequency domain characteristics. None of the studies have shown classification using features from each domain and described the specific behavior of each feature relating to the characteristic of AF. In this work, a rigorous collection of features from each domain is calculated and analyzed for the automatic detection of AF patterns using variational mode decomposition. High-frequency decomposed components have been used for further processing. The dataset from the MIT-BIH repository has been utilized to measure the robustness of the introduced approach. We obtained the highest accuracy of 98.67% on the MIT-BIH database. Obtained indicators show that the proposed method outperformed latest approaches.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Algorithms for Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Image classification is a popular and important area of image processing research in today's society. For machine learning, SVM is a very good classification model. CNN is a type of convolution neural network that has an unpredictable development and uses convolution calculations. It is one of the most well-known deep learning algorithms. This review thinks about and inspects exemplary AI and profound learning picture classification procedures involving SVM and CNN as specific illustrations. Using a large sample mnist dataset, this study found that CNN has an accuracy of 0.97 and SVM has an accuracy of 0.89; SVM has an accuracy of 0.85 and CNN has an accuracy of 0.82 when working with a small sample ImageNet dataset. Tests in this review show that for little example informational collections, standard ML has an improved arrangement impact than deep learning structure does.

articleTitle: Prediction of Dermatological Disease with Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Dermatological disorders (DD) are widespread health issues in nations worldwide. The dangers of infections are hidden, and may lead to both mental and physical health problems. In severe circumstances, it might even result in skin cancer. Therefore, one of the most difficult jobs in medical image processing is to diagnose DD from clinical photographs. Additionally, diagnosing DD manually by medical professionals is time-consuming and arbitrary. Therefore, automatic DD prediction is necessary for both patients and dermatologists, which speeds up the planning of therapies. In this piece of writing, we reviewed the different types of DD, procedure uses for the identification and categorization of DD and their early identification by the help of various machine learning (ML) algorithms which gives their specific accuracy rate in which Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) shows the highest accuracy with the accuracy rate 99.05% respectively.

articleTitle: Advancing Wireless Communication: A Comprehensive Study On Multi-User Mimo-Ofdm Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: A actually massive settings is created when horizontal frequency division packet switching, a common technique for high-rate wireless data transport, is integrated with transceivers at the transmitting and receiving ends to increase spectral efficiency and/or to boost system power on time-variant and intensity touchpoints. The multiple access future research directions in design process are investigated in this article, which would include measured data and simulation, input signal spectrum sensing methods employing intuitive arrays, space-time methods, error - correcting computer programming methods, protocol and datagram style, or signal computation for frequency and time standardization, spectrum sensing, and channel locating in frameworks. The article also takes into account an open-source hardware solution.

articleTitle: Unveiling the Dynamics of Digital Economics: A Comprehensive Exploration
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The rapid spread of digital technologies has led to a paradigm shift in financial activity, commonly referred to as digital finance This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of the development of digital finance, with various aspects such as digital platforms, cryptocurrencies, e-commerce, and data-driven decisions. Let's delve into the transformative impact of technology, examine the challenges and opportunities it presents, and propose possible frameworks for understanding and organizing this evolving landscape. Through interdisciplinary research, we seek to provide a nuanced understanding of the complex interactions between technology, finance and society in the digital age.

articleTitle: Determining the Accuracy of Resonate Demography Expedition Using Faster Regions Based on Novel K-Means Algorithm Comparing with Gradient Boosting Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Determining the accuracy of resonate demography expeditions using faster regions based on Novel K-means algorithm compared with Gradient Boosting algorithm for actual time resonate management. Materials and Methods: Novel K-Means algorithm and Gradient Boosting algorithms are replicated by multiple bounds to robotize sound management systems to optimize the pH. Accuracy is valued taking G power 80% to both algorithms and we have taken 10 samples in this work for every single of the algorithms. Results: Comparing on accomplished outcomes, the Novel K-Means algorithm has fundamentally greater accuracy (82.2070<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) on comparison with Gradient Boosting algorithm accuracy (79.2980%). Two groups were found to be statistically significant, where <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{p}=.001(\mathrm{p} < 0.05)$</tex>. Conclusion: The K-Means algorithm gives good outcomes to detect audio statistics than Gradient Boosting.

articleTitle: TrackerBot: Parallel Object Tracking and Collision Avoidance Design for Unmanned Ground Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Autonomous rovers are mobile robots, designed to operate in various conditions without any human intervention. These rovers are equipped with sensors, actuators, and control systems that enable them to navigate and interact with their environment. They are widely employed in fields like exploration, search and rescue, environmental monitoring, and surveillance. In this paper, we propose TrackerBot, which is an autonomous rover that integrates parallel object tracking, videography, and collision avoidance in real-world scenarios. The proposed rover can navigate safely and capture high-quality visual data of its targeted moving object. The rover control system is operated via a proportional-integral-derivative (PID) controller, and is accompanied by computer vision capabilities. It enables it to seamlessly detect and track objects at a parallel level in its environment, avoid obstacles and collisions, and record video footage with minimal hardware requirements. The proposed system performance is evaluated through its ability to navigate complex environments and capture high-quality visual data.

articleTitle: Unveiling the Language of Comics: Classifying Speech Balloons for Enhanced Analysis and Interpretation
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This study introduces a new method for classifying speech balloons in comic images, utilizing a combination of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Random Forest (RF) algorithms. The primary objective of the proposed model is to accurately distinguish between various classes of speech balloons. The evaluation of the model yields promising results, indicating its efficacy in achieving high precision, recall, and F1 scores across most speech balloon classes. Precision values range from 89.00% to 96.64%, denoting accurate positive predictions. Similarly, recall values range from 88.89% to 95.57%, showcasing the model's capability to effectively capture a substantial portion of positive instances in the majority of classes. The F1 scores, ranging from 89.14% to 96.10%, highlight the model's ability to strike a favorable balance between precision and recall. Additionally, the support values, which provide insights into the dataset's distribution by reflecting the number of instances per class, shed light on its characteristics. The model's accuracy values, ranging from 0.97 to 0.99, demonstrate its overall correctness in classifying speech balloons with a high level of precision across all classes. This research contributes to the field of image classification and offers valuable insights for the analysis and understanding of comic images.

articleTitle: Incorporation of Agents with Ontology to Develop a Healthcare Assessment Provision System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Extracting useful patient information from a multitude of web pages and traditional hospital systems, and afterwards displaying these search results in a comprehensible manner, is a challenging undertaking. This is achieved via the implementation of conventional methodologies that aid in the anticipation of infections and ailments, such as heart attacks and several others. However, a disheartening aspect is that these conventional approaches were inadequate in detecting early indications of the human health system. The resolution to this issue may be found by utilizing an agent-based integration method, facilitated by the utilization of ontologies. This research focuses on the integration of data linked to human health, both structured and unstructured, using a suggested system that utilizes ontological-based agents. These agents work together to coordinate and semantically integrate external data sources. The process of integrating data leads to the derivation of new knowledge based on a set of rules, so transforming it into a multi-agent decision support system. The algorithm under consideration demonstrates the capability to forecast individuals' health state by analyzing their performed activities. The study provides a comprehensive analysis of a methodology that focuses on human daily activities, specifically targeting the improvement of cardiovascular health in individuals.

articleTitle: Development of Shape Memory Alloy Based Heat Engine for Solar Energy Harvesting
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Solar energy is the most ubiquitous and abundant of various types of environmental energy available on the earth. Conventionally photovoltaic cells are used to convert solar energy to useful electric power, where available commercial technologies ensure efficiency of 10-25%. In this paper an investigation has been performed to use Shape Memory Alloy (SMA) for harvesting solar energy to electric power. SMA exhibits large deformation with change between martensitic region of low temperature and the austenitic region at the higher temperature. Employing this characteristic, we demonstrate SMA based heat engine to convert solar energy into useful mechanical work, which further has been used to generate electric energy. Nitinol wire has been used as the SMA material to absorb the solar heat and covert the same to mechanical work and electric power. The SMA wire has been initially in bending mode which exhibits large deformation when is heated by solar energy. Further, the deformation of the wire has been used to drive a custom-made micro-generator to utilize the wire deformation to electric energy. Theoretical calculations have been presented to discuss the energy balance of input solar energy, mechanical work done, and electric energy harvested. Experimentation of the prototype ensured 2.08% of efficiency to deliver average power of 4.86 µw.

articleTitle: Deep Neural Networks for Traffic Sign Recognition Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to offer a deep learning-based traffic sign recognition approach that focuses on the identification and categorization of traffic signs. In this study, we used ResNet-50, VGG16, RegNetX002 and, DenseNet121 to implement transfer learning, which entails leveraging pre-trained models to extract features from images and then training a new model on top of those features for the detection task. Finally, on the Traffic Signs (GTSRB plus 162 special classes) dataset, we computed the accuracy rate obtained by each transfer learning model.

articleTitle: Bidirectional Laser Based OCDMA-VLC System For Smart Home Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: A bidirectional symmetric 3 x35Gbps optical code division multiple access (OCDMA) with visible light communication (VLC) system is presented. The performance is measured using multi-diagonal (MD) code for different users with channel impairments. The simulation results indicate that faithful VLC range of 45m is achieved successfully. Also, the system employing MD code can supports 80 numbers of end users in both downlink as well as upstream transmission. Also, the system shows that best performance over other existing ones for smart home applications.

articleTitle: Software Cost Estimation Using Temporal Data Mining Techniques: An Over View
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Data mining is a process that involves extracting new, non-trivial information from huge datasets. This information can be used in a variety of applications. Several fields, including temporal pattern recognition, statistics, optimisation, temporal databases, high-performance computing, visualisation, and parallel computing, all meet in the rapidly developing field of temporal data mining. The growth of digital data and the processing power of computers have severely limited a field called data mining that integrates computer science and statistics. The software cost estimation category is one of data mining's disciplines. This study's primary objective is to comprehend the temporal mining methods currently in use in order to spot the gaps and flaws in the most recent software cost estimation technologies. This research also includes a concise summary of recent developments in the field of temporal data mining that has taken place recently. This study serves as a springboard for a discussion of the reasons why temporal data mining was required in the industry, which played a significant part in the development of the current generation of temporal data mining techniques for software cost assessment.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Output Power in Three Phase Induction Motor Using Torque Controlled Method Compared with Voltage Controlled Method by Controlling the Stator Voltage
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The goal of the proposed work is to increase the output power of a three phase induction motor by managing the stator voltage with sustainable power electronics devices as opposed to voltage control. Materials and Procedures A total of 14 speed samples, which were obtained by adjusting torque and voltage, were taken. In order to quantify the stator voltage control in a three phase induction motor with torque controlled method and voltage controlled method, these samples are divided into two groups, each having seven samples. G power is assumed to be 0.8. Results: It was found via this research that the innovative voltage controlled approach produced a stator voltage of 173.68 volts and the novel torque controlled way achieved a stator voltage of 189.94 volts. The statistically significant result obtained is 0.010 (p<0.05), which is significant. Conclusion: From this work it is observed that the novel torque controlled method performed significantly better than the voltage controlled method in three phase induction motor stator voltage on basis of output power.

articleTitle: Loss Functions in Link Prediction Based on Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: GNNs are neural networks that can be used to analyse graphs directly. We're going to discuss utilising GNNs for link prediction even though they can also be used for node-level tasks (like giving each website on the internet a score) and graph-level tasks (like predicting characteristics given a molecular structure). It is feasible to predict if a link will most likely connect two network nodes. Given the pervasiveness of networks, it has a wide range of uses, including reconstructing metabolic networks and recommending friends, movies, and knowledge graphs. To train these link prediction networks. We mostly use the binary categorical cross-entropy (CE) loss with adaptive moment estimation to train these link prediction networks. A loss function, cost function, or error function is a calculation formula that returns an event or the value of one or more variable to its true number, which in turn represents some “costs” associated with this event. In this study, we evaluate the effects of various loss functions on the effectiveness of GNNs for link prediction with specified labels and various sample sizes. Our findings for GNNs demonstrate that in both of the aforementioned circumstances, there is no discernible difference between models trained using CE and other conventional loss functions.

articleTitle: Service Migrations in Multi-Access Edge Computing Using Adaptive Migration Window
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: 5G networks support a Multi-access Edge Computing (MEC) infrastructure to host many heterogeneous applications at the network's edge. MEC infrastructure helps 5G to achieve the high-bandwidth and low-latency targets demanded by modern applications. Applications hosted in MEC have Service Level Agreements (SLAs) that guarantee service quality to the users. Service migrations are done in MEC to prevent SLA violations caused by application performance or overload conditions. While several existing research on MEC study the impact of service migrations on user mobility, there is a paucity of studies on service migrations performed during application overload conditions. This paper proposes a novel Adaptive Service Migration Window (ASMWA) algorithm to initiate service migrations in MEC using the application's resource utilisation, user QoS and service migration duration. We have compared the performance of ASMWA with the state-of-the-art Exponential Weighted Moving Average (EWMA3) and static threshold algorithms. Our simulations show that the ASMWA performs better when compared to EWMA3 and static threshold algorithms in minimising SLA violations and QoS degradation during service migrations in MEC.

articleTitle: Comparative Energy & Hardware Analysis on Implementation of 8-Bit ALU Using Different FPGAs Families
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Multiple developing countries admit serious shortages of energy. Using the Vivado software platform and multiple generations of FPGAs, an efficient 8-bit ALU is implemented, boosting the growth of environmentally focused connectivity. In order to get there, a wide variety of FPGA families had to be studied. Different FPGA boards from the Genesys, Kintex, and Virtex families are employed. Researchers looked at the power needs of several FPGA families to identify the most efficient. A comparison of power consumption reveals that Genesys consumes 10.871 W, Kintex 7.01 W, and Virtex 18.975 W. Genesys, Kintex, and Virtex each have temperatures of 44 degrees Celsius, 34 degrees Celsius, and 35 degrees Celsius, respectively. Power dissipation can be minimized by adhering to the requirements for employing the Genesys family of 7 series of components rather than the other two families. Kintex's power efficiency is on par with that of other types of FPGAs. Comparing the energy efficiency, cost, size, and performance of the Genesys board to the Kintex board, the latter comes out on top in every category.

articleTitle: Brain Tumor Detection and Classification Using a Hyperparameter Tuned Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Brain tumor detection using MRI scans when integrated with a deep learning approach can be immensely applied in identifying the tumor at early stages, with minimum medical professional aid. This research paper aims to develop an advanced predictive model that accurately classify brain tumors as benign or malignant using MRI scans. Here, a novel convolutional neural network (CNN) model is proposed to automate tumor detection and improve diagnosis accuracy. The model used a dataset of around 7000 brain cancer data classified into 4 labels which include glioma, meningioma, pituitary, and no tumor. Data wrangling and pre-processing are then applied to unify the images into a single format and remove any inconsistencies. Further the records are segregated into train and test samples with a 70–30 split. The proposed model recorded an optimum accuracy of 94.82%, precision of 94.2%, recall value of 93.7% and f-score metric of 93.9% respectively. In conclusion, the paper concluded that the proposed model can be applied to enhance the precision of both brain tumor diagnosis and prognosis.

articleTitle: Apply Agglomerative Algorithm and Vgg16 on Brain Tumor Segmentation (Dataset to be Used Brats)
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Medical imaging analysis relies heavily on the segmentation of brain tumours to help in treatment planning, diagnosis and patient monitoring. The recent breakthroughs in artificial intelligence and deep learning approaches have revealed promising outcomes in automating this crucial process. The BRATS (“Multimodal Brain Tumour Segmentation Challenge”) dataset is used throughout this study to investigate the potential of the agglomerative method in tandem with the VGG16 “convolutional neural network” architecture for brain tumor segmentation. Ground-truth tumor segmentation labels are provided with multimodal MRI scans from the BRATS dataset. These modalities include T1c, T1, FLAIR and T2. This research intends to improve clinical decision-making and patient care by increasing the precision and speed of brain tumor segmentation by the combined use of the agglomerative algorithm and VGG16.

articleTitle: Analysis of Credit Card Fraud Transaction Detection using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Credit cards are now used in daily life. The need for online business transactions is rising as quickly as the internet. Markets are expanding thanks to the internet, which influences customers to buy the things they need. The inability to raise enough funds can occasionally prevent you from getting the things you need. For a limited time, businesses are also offering good discounts on their products. It forces the user to need to buy things. Use of credit card is necessary to satisfy the user needs. Additionally, credit card companies provide numerous discounts and reward points for using credit cards to make purchases. When the number of people increases in using credit cards, then the chance of fraudulent transaction is also increases. Finding out about fraudulent credit card transactions becomes urgently necessary. Unauthorised and illegal actions are seriously hindering the expansion of the credit card industry. Financial losses result from fraud in many circumstances. Credit cards are utilised on websites. Numerous methods are offered by machine learning algorithms which can be used for determining that whether a transaction is fraud or not. This study compares various machine learning algorithms and demonstrates that the KNN method performs best, with a 99.9% accuracy rate. This provides a thorough review of the effectiveness of various machine learning methods, which is helpful in creating applications for detecting credit card fraud. This paper also shows that lowest accuracy of 98.6% is achieved using Naive Bayes algorithm.

articleTitle: Design And Implementation of Two Axis Sun Follower PV System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The general population is interested in developing techniques for utilizing sources of clean energy due to known as simultaneous hazards to fossil fuel exhaustion along with warming temperatures. among the many declaring avenues for renewable power was solar power. A solar energy system's ability to produce energy can be significantly increased by sun tracking devices. In order to offer reliable system reliability, this article offers an innovative layout for a multi-axis tracking photovoltaic (PV) array that makes use of feedback regulation theory, a five-quadrant light-depending resistor (LDR) detector, and straightforward electrical circuits. The put forward that is suggested achieves tracking of the sun by means of a special hybrid-axis AC drive and an independent photovoltaic inverter. A technological breakthrough with a straightforward and efficient development is controlling its deployment. To confirm the viability of the plan, a resized-down laboratory model is also built. Scientific proof supports the solar system's tracker's efficacy. To sum up, the findings in this research could be useful names for uses for sunlight in future generations.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Models for Movie Review Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Movie evaluations represent an individuals' personal viewpoints and possess the potential to influence the prosperity of a film, therefore, precise categorization of such reviews, through sentiment analysis becomes paramount. This paper compares the effectiveness of five different machine learning models for movie review sentiment analysis using two text preprocessing techniques: TF-IDF and Bag-of-Words. The results indicate that Logistic Regression achieves the highest accuracy in both techniques, with Random Forest as the next best-performing model, followed by Gradient Boosting. This study emphasizes the crucial role of selecting the right preprocessing technique and algorithm for a particular task. It also suggests further research into other vectorization techniques and domain-specific features to improve sentiment analysis model accuracy.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Anti-Predatory Nature-Inspired Algorithm on the CEC'14 Test Suites
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Anti-Predatory Nature-Inspired Algorithm (APNIA) is a recent proposal in evolutionary computations. It emulates the self-preservation strategies of frogs. It has several advantages, like a reasonable convergence rate, a balance between exploration and exploitation, and preserving diversity in solutions during the evolution process. Apart from different types of evaluations, CEC benchmarking problems are one of the finest test suites that measure the performance of an evolutionary algorithm. With this motive, this work evaluates the performance of the APNIA in solving CEC'14 benchmarking problems. We evaluate the performance of APNIA based on the CEC'14 guidelines. Our experimental evaluations demonstrate the moderated performance of APNIA for solving the CEC'14 test suite problems in different dimensions.

articleTitle: Automatic E-Challan Generation if Vehicle is Not Insured
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Today, the automatic recognition of number plates serves as the cornerstone of efficient traffic management, and the automatic localization and detection of number plates are useful for a variety of purposes, including the detection of fake number plates and the generation of e-Challans when traffic laws are broken. Along with these problems, it is also important to focus on whether the vehicle is insured, and this is what the current project addresses. A minimum amount of third-party liability insurance must be carried by all vehicles, according to the Motor Vehicles Act of 1998. Vehicle insurance is mandatory because it protects drivers from the financial costs of accidents. The availability of compensation for victims of harm brought on by other drivers is also supported by laws governing vehicle insurance. Bodily injury and property damage insurance are the coverages that are needed by the majority of states. This study focuses on determining whether the vehicle is insured or not by automatically detecting the number plate and verifying with the database if the vehicle is uninsured. If so, a fine is assessed and a notification is sent to the registered phone number.

articleTitle: Sentimental Technique Implementation on Textual Data
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The increasing amount of real-time or near-real-time data in the big data age provides organizations with opportunities to make data-driven decisions. However, social media data, such as that generated by Twitter, is typically unstructured and difficult to manage. This paper proposes an efficient text data pre-processing approach and develops an algorithm for training decision tree, random forest, SVM, and logistic regression classifiers on a dataset. The algorithm weights the sentiment score based on the hashtag and cleaned text weights, and the most efficient data pre-processing strategy is identified using a novel technology called the hash vectorizer. The effectiveness of the algorithm is tested against manually sorted sentiments and sentiments created before text data pre-processing, and the resultsshow its accuracy is comparable to human-annotated feelings. This research contributes to the existing body of knowledge by providing a precise method for cleaning social media data and a new approach to sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: Enhanced Metaheuristic Based Hyper-Parameters Tuning for Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Hyperparameter tuning is a crucial step in the process of building accurate machine learning models. Finding the optimal combination of hyperparameters can be challenging, especially in complex models with large hyperparameter spaces. Genetic algorithms (GAs) have become a popular approach to address this challenge by efficiently exploring the hyperparameter space and selecting the best combination. In the paper, different machine learning models are used along with the genetic search algorithms for the prediction of multi-diseases. The purpose of using the genetic algorithm is to optimize the learning models hyper-parameters. Based upon the evaluations we come to know which models performed well after hyper-parameter optimization using meta heuristic optimization.

articleTitle: Real Time Investigation of IoT Based Sun Follower
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The goal of this investigation is to explain the conceptualization, production, & evaluation of just one axis internet-connected sunlight surveillance systems. The detection model comprises of a number of sensors controlled by an Atari platform, as well as the language of things web page to display outcomes. In the present investigation, solar panels having a thirty WP capability were employed. On the fifth level for the Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Electronics at Universidad Negeri Se Padang, Indonesia the inspection procedure was conducted. Screening results' gathering of information occurs in immediate as well as will be shown as graphical data, Sensors that are attached to a computer and a WIFI device provide the data. Additionally, the information is transferred through a Thingspeak technology computer which might be seen on a laptop or an Android-powered gadget. In sunny skies, photovoltaic cells can provide power throughout 7:00 morning until 18:30 pm; however, in cloudy or wet conditions, power output drops & separates early, before nightfall. According to the experiment accomplishments, every record can be transferred correctly and promptly watched online. As a result, the tracking solar panel is successfully and quietly watched, while Google makes it simple to retrieve every record.

articleTitle: Understanding Stock Market Trends Using Simple Moving Average (SMA) and Exponential Moving Average (EMA) Indicators
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The task of forecasting stock market trends is widely regarded as one of the most difficult challenges in financial time series analysis, owing to the dynamic and non-linear nature of financial data. Forecasting the stock market is an essential requirement for comprehending market patterns and devising trading strategies. The present study is centred on the examination of financial data through the implementation of the present discourse pertains to two distinct technical indicators, namely the simple moving average and exponential moving average. The aim is to predict the future path of the stock market's movement. The utilization of the moving average approach has gained widespread acceptance due to its ease of implementation. The experiments were conducted utilizing a five-year historical dataset from two distinct stock markets, namely TCS and Apple. The present study draws a comparison between two companies by analysing their respective trading signals to infer the potential movement of their stock prices.

articleTitle: Multimedia Security Using Blockchain and IoT-Based Distributed System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This article explores how IoT device systems handle multimedia data and presents a secure multimedia framework utilizing blockchain technology. The proposed framework high- lights how blockchain ensures the safety and transparency of multimedia records, document access, and shipping processes between owners and customers. To address these challenges, we introduce a decentralized peer-to-peer multimedia file-sharing platform based on the Inter Planetary File System (IPFS) built on blockchain technology. Additionally, we propose a multimedia file block approval consensus mechanism. Recently, blockchain has been recognized as a potential technology to enforce critical security requirements in IoT devices. It offers protection for IoT networks that require sharing multimedia data, including applications in smart cities, retail, energy, security surveillance, and healthcare.

articleTitle: Efficient Tool Condition Monitoring Using SOM-Hebb Classifier on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Tool condition monitoring is vital for enhancing productivity, reducing costs, and improving product quality in manufacturing industries. Existing approaches, such as threshold-based methods, sensor-based methods, and machine learning-based techniques, have limitations in terms of accuracy, adaptability, interpretability, and computational costs. This research proposes a tool condition monitoring system based on the Self-Organizing Map (SOM) algorithm and the Hebbian learning algorithm. The system is implemented on a Field-Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) platform for real-time processing in manufacturing environments. A dataset is acquired using sensors, pre-processed, and divided into training and testing sets. The SOM-Hebb classifier is designed with appropriate parameters, and the tool condition monitoring algorithm involves projection histograms, discrete Fourier transform (DFT), and the SOM-Hebb classifier. The FPGA implementation achieves high-speed processing and meets timing constraints. Simulation results demonstrate the system's functionality and accuracy, with a classification accuracy of 99.22%. The system exhibits a processing time of 35 clock cycles. This research provides a promising approach for efficient and accurate tool condition monitoring in manufacturing industries.

articleTitle: Quantum Attacks on Public Cryptosystems
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) networks have emerged as a revolutionary technology in ensuring secure communication in the digital age. By leveraging the principles of quantum mechanics, QKD allows two parties to establish a secret key securely, which can subsequently be used for encrypting and decrypting sensitive information. While QKD holds immense promise for enhancing cybersecurity, it also presents several challenges that necessitate further research to achieve its full potential. The research presented here examines the development of QKD networks, their real-world use, as well as the general QKD network architecture and the most recent advancements in QKD network deployments.

articleTitle: Unveiling the Dynamics of Free Trade: A Big Data Analytics Perspective on Domestic, Economic, and Strategic Dimensions
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In the sector of essential monetary techniques, the worldwide results of unfastened change dynamics on the environment have attracted a variety of interest. This examines the distinct trends of unfastened exchange agreements by using giant facts analytics. We analyze the core objectives of FTAs (Free Trade Agreements), which include boosting economic growth, improving market efficiency, and promoting international cooperation, in detail by carefully examining the domestic, economic, and strategic ramifications. This is accomplished by using a wide range of statistics, including trade volumes, economic indicators, and geopolitical ties. These databases offer insightful understandings of the complex interactions of free trade among participating countries and the global community. This study gives a sparkling viewpoint on the dynamics of free exchange, highlighting the importance of utilizing huge data analytics for radical know-how of the complicated dynamics entailed by using present-day monetary policies.

articleTitle: Analysing the Functions of Smart Security Using the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: IoT is becoming part of everyday life. IoT devices might reach 30–35 billion by 2022. Due to economical World Wide Web access, more people utilise the Internet. Thus, a significant number of Internet-connected devices generate massive amounts of data. The largest difficulty in the IoT market is safeguarding IoT devices and network data. Privacy, confidentiality, integrity, and dependability problems must be addressed while transferring user data across devices. Many sectors make IoT devices to different standards. Incorrectly setup IoT devices (faulty applications on mobile devices) might increase Internet Protocol data traffic and consume device batteries quicker. This research analyses the communications behaviour of IoT devices and mobile apps, security threats to IoT technology, IoT tools, manufacturers, and simulators. This article deals also with the role of the Internet of Things in advancing smart security. The problems are handled with the help of these upgraded devices that are easily accessible from a remote location with an internet connection.

articleTitle: Random Forest Based Predictive Attrition Scoring Model In Financial Services Industry: Sourcing Data From Single Employee View
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In the return zone, where investments are higher in employees, the cost of attrition is higher than in the investment zone. This cost rises manifold when attrition occurs among top performers of the firm. This work attempts to develop a predictive attrition model for top performers among sales and collection managers and field employees in the financial services industry using a sample of 8000 employees and 36 predictors. These predictors encompass supervisor effects, HR data such as attendance, compensation, appraisal, and performance output including psychological variables such as burnout and engagement. The model deploys the Random Forest technique and can predict with an accuracy ranging from 61 to 67 percent for both managers and field employees in sales and collection over a three-month window. The work further demonstrates the application of the LIME technique to identify the top three reasons for the high-risk category of employees which can be used by HR to devise tailored retention strategies.

articleTitle: Implementation of ABC & WOA-Based Security Defense Mechanism for Distributed Denial of Service Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Computer systems are vulnerable to information theft as a result of the extensive use of the internet, which has caused an increase in security defence mechanisms. In order to overcome these theft various approaches have been proposed like Machine Learning, Swarm Intelligent Algorithm, Bayesian-based algorithms etc. For choosing effective and efficacious features and improve the Security Defense Mechanism. In order to lessen Distributed Denial of Service (DDO) assaults, we suggested a novel hybrid classification approach in this study based on Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) and Whale Optimisation Algorithm (WOA). The results are compared with other algorithms. These algorithms have shown promising results.

articleTitle: The Role of Cloud Computing in Ensuring Business Continuity During Disasters
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The most important aspects of a firm are business continuity planning and disaster recovery planning, yet they are frequently overlooked. Even before a tragedy strikes, businesses need to have a well-organized strategy and document for company continuity. Disasters may be brief or prolonged, but when a company is prepared for any difficulty, it flourishes and endures. This essay provides information on the value of business continuity and disaster recovery benefits that cloud computing may offer. This article aims to explain how cloud computing supports business continuity and disaster recovery through its service models. It also emphasizes system virtualization, another distinctive aspect of cloud computing that aids disaster recovery. It also makes an effort to comprehend how cutting-edge technologies like virtualization, SAAS, and CAAS help business continuity and disaster recovery.

articleTitle: Solar PV Wind Hybrid Energy Generation System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Renewable resources like the sun, wind, biomass, hydropower, geothermal energy, and ocean resources can all be technologically used to produce clean energy. Despite producing significantly less energy than fossil fuels, solar and wind power have grown rapidly in recent years thanks to the use of PV cells and wind turbines. The solar-wind hybrid power system, which uses both solar and wind energy to generate electricity, is covered in this article. Both commercial and residential applications are compatible with this hybrid solar-wind energy generation system. The wind generator's alternating voltage is converted into a constant DC value by employing AC-DC converters, which can then be converted back into AC voltage to power AC loads. In order to get the most power from the sun when it is there, a boost converter-based Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) system is used. Given that harmonic content has a negative impact on generator longevity, heating problems, and efficiency, this method offers improved harmonic reduction.

articleTitle: Managing Smart Urban Transportation with the integration of Big Data Analytic Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Urban traffic management is a major challenge for cities worldwide, but with the help of technology, such as big data analytics and intelligent transport systems, cities are working to improve their situations. An integrated big data analytics platform has the potential to change transportation networks for the better, providing real-time insights that can be used for decisions. By collecting and analyzing real-time data from various sources, such as traffic sensors and GPS, we can predict traffic flow and create plans more efficiently. This paper will explore how an integrated big data analytics platform can be used to improve urban transportation management. It discusses some of the challenges that urban transportation systems face and provides insights from government officials and industry experts. The importance of this paper reviews fundamental concepts such as big data analytics and smart cities so that you have a better understanding of what this technology can do. Afterwards, it identifies opportunities for improving urban transportation networks using big data analytics.

articleTitle: 4 Port MIMO Antenna Enhanced Isolation And Gain By Using Frequency Selective Surface
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In this research a small 4 port multi input multi out (MIMO) antenna is presented working in the frequency range between 4.6 GHz - 7.3 GHz for fifth-generation (5G) communication. The antenna maintains a gain of 7.75 dBi at 5.2 GHz and 5.3 dBi at 5.8 GHz while having a wider working bandwidth of 2.7 GHz. The suggested antenna system comprises a four-element orthogonally arranged with a frequency selective surface below the height of 15 mm for enhancing the gain. The presented MIMO system has the following dimensions: 50.5 mm x 50.5 mm x 1.6 mm. Radiating elements in the suggested MIMO design are arranged orthogonal to one another to achieve good isolation. Additionally, the isolation between each element is below -22 dB in the entire frequency range. High diversity gain, minimal envelope correlation coefficient are further characteristics of the suggested MIMO antenna design.

articleTitle: Application of Hadoop for Analyzing Data Using Mapper Files
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In contemporary times, a substantial quantity of valuable and indeterminate data is readily accessible in numerous practical applications. This information might be used by many different industries and government agencies to get useful insights. This data has the potential to assist managers in improving their strategies and optimizing their decision-making processes. Several private enterprises and governments have started investing and funding initiatives to increase earnings and make the best use of resources. The analysis of large-scale datasets is crucial to the development and growth of future efforts, and the phrase “big data” is used to describe such massive amounts of data. This study presents an analysis of Big Data analytics based on empirical findings. The present study involves an analysis of New York Stock Exchange data through the utilization of two mapper files within the Hadoop framework. The annual computation of the highest and lowest values of each stock exchange, as well as the mean stock price, is performed.

articleTitle: Enhancing Trust and Privacy in Edge and Cloud Computing Through Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Edge and cloud computing environment is currently employed in a variety of fields, yet despite their growing prominence and advantages, it faces certain difficulties, including data privacy and trust. Intruder assaults ought to be avoided, and data storage ought to be restricted to authorized individuals only. The majority of methods of authentication use a trusted group to go through the procedure. Consumers and computer systems must both be enrolled with the trusted group to be granted authorization to authenticate other individuals. Because the whole framework is dependent on just one trusted group, in this case, one point of collapse may trigger the whole structure to malfunction, and problems with scalability exist. Blockchain innovation can be used to ensure data privacy and trust in storage and trading procedures. To tackle the problems that continue to arise in current platforms, this work discusses a decentralized method that involves removing the idea of a single trusted group through the implementation of a blockchain framework in edge and cloud computing where any moment an individual or server desires to access the framework, it is not required to enter itself by hand, yet the authorization procedure is executed out autonomously during the framework. The findings from experiments and performance examination show that the suggested design is advantageous and surpasses those that exist in the relevant field.

articleTitle: Demand Prediction Of Private Cars With Parallel Multi-Task Learning Model Using Ridge Linear Classification In Comparison With K-Nearest Neighbour Algorithm For Better Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The research work intends to enhance the precision of forecasting private car demand by applying Ridge Linear classifier algorithm and comparing its accuracy with K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN) algorithm. Materials and methods: The UCI repository database were used to download the experimental data. The total number of iterations for each group is 10 iterations with total iterations of 20 calculated by performing an independent sample t-test with a Gpower of 0.8 along with alpha quality and beta qualities of 0.05 and 0.2 respectively also the Confidence Interval (CI) of 95%. The K-Nearest Neighbors method (KNN) and the Ridge Linear classifier models were used to predict the demand for private automobiles. Results: As compared to the Ridge Linear classifier model, which has more accuracy rate of 71.36 percent, when compared to the K-Nearest Neighbours method (KNN) classifier has a 70.90 percent. The significance value was analyzed using the independent sample t- Test analysis where p<0.05 and this work showed a significance value of p=0.19. There is no significant difference between the two groups. Conclusion: The accuracy of Ridge Linear Model is 71.36% is higher compared with K-Nearest Neighbors algorithm that has an accuracy rate of 70.90% in analysis of to predict the demand of private Cars with improved accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Full-duplex OFDM modulation based FSO-Fiber system for 5G scenario
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: A full-duplex 40/40Gbps orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) basics free space optics (FSO)-fiber system is presented. The performance is measured under different turbulences effects with fiber impairments. The simulation results indicate that faithful fiber and FSO transmission ranges of 40km and 350m under turbulences effects is obtained. It is also observed that fiber-FSO link indicates best performance compared to fiber and FSO links with signal to noise ratio of 25dB in upstream and 10dB downstream direction. Also, the designed system shows that best performance than other existing ones for fifth generation (5G) applications.

articleTitle: Increasing Automotive Electrical Equipment Effectiveness with Enhanced Iron Loss Estimation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: For improved transformer design in car uses, precise modeling of ferrous failures of flexible superconductors for a variety of frequency bands and eddy currents concentrations is essential. [1] For this reason, various empirical iron-loss models were put forth that describe the processes that cause loss. The majority of these have issues with magnetization flux concentrations and bad precision for longer wavelengths. The usual iron loss formulas and a sophisticated iron loss algorithm are compared in this article. By including a high order component for the flux density of magnetic matter, the suggested Formula addresses a problem with the widely used metal models. To determine the iron losses of an electrical machine for the driveline of a fully electric car, for example, one uses the iron-loss algorithm.

Author Keywords: Power Systems and Machine Loss Analysis

articleTitle: Advanced Privacy Preserving Model for Smart Healthcare Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The rise of intelligent healthcare, the rise of the internet of medical things, the corona virus pandemic, and the rise of big data-based medical applications. The generated biomedical data is extremely private and confidential. Unfortunately, traditional medicine systems are unable to handle the enormous volume of biomedical data. Consequently, data is usually the cloud is used to store and share data. Afterward, several uses for the shared data are made such as investigation and the finding of novel information. Biomedical information typically appears in written form (such as test results, medication recommendations, and diagnoses). Unfortunately, such data is exposed to a variety of security risks and attacks, including privacy and confidentiality breaches. Despite significant advancements in the security of biological data, most current methods produce significant delays and are unable to handle real-time responses. In order to enhance the healthcare system, this study presents an innovative, fog-enabled, privacy-preserving paradigm termed “r sanitizer.” This work is based on a Convolutional Neural Network with Bidirectional Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) and recognizes medical entities efficiently. The test results show that with a recall of 91.15%, precision of 92.6%, and a F1 score of 92%, r sanitizer beats the most recent models. Comparing the sanitization model to the state-of-the-art reveals a 28.77<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> improvement in privacy preservation.

articleTitle: Exoskeleton Motion Control and Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The paper describes the analysis, implementation, and control of a 17 degree of freedom (DOF) robotic exoskeleton model using Accelerometer and Gyroscope (GY-MPU), Electromyography (EMG) and flex sensors. The GY-MPU axis modulation signals are used to interpret human limb movements (arms, shoulder, and legs), while the flex signals detect elbow joints angular displacement measurements. The paper also implements EMG based control on a 5 DOF 3D bionic hand, interpreting hand grasp/release movements via the EMG signal. Skin surface EMG signals of forearm muscles and hand force/forearm torque are used as input information to the proposed controller. Fuzzy control is applied to realize natural and flexible motion assist, and an experiment is performed to evaluate the exoskeleton robot. While by applying the skin surface EMG signals along GY-MPU as the main input signals to the controller, the robot can be controlled automatically without requiring any additional equipment, the image processing capability is also intended to be integrated as part of the sys. An experimental setup includes sensors, control unit, signal-processing board, and actuators. The kinematic analysis of the different DOF of humanoid robot includes forward and inverse kinematics. The GY-MPU are reliable and easy to use, while the EMG and flex sensors require careful signal processing design due to unstable raw signals. The work has potential applications in development of exoskeleton body suite which can enable our soldiers to perform extraordinary actions during all kinds of military war craft such as conventional as well as close quarter combat (CQB) missions with edge cutting AI integrated image processing tools.

articleTitle: A Neuro-Fuzzy Network to Detect Breast Cancer in Healthcare Domain
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Detection and analysis of serious diseases like breast cancer is one of the topics for mining analysis and research. The paper proposes a neuro-fuzzy approach for detection of breast cancer by using fuzzification method. The method is validated on the Wisconsin breast cancer dataset comprising various parameters namely clump thickness, size, nuclei and cells. The proposed approach is compared with existing classifiers namely MLP and SVM using 10 point cross validation simulation in MATLAB neuro-fuzzy inference system. Various evaluation metrics like RMSE, precision, recall, f-measure are done to perform analysis of the simulated results.

articleTitle: Enabling Speech Recognition for Lesser-Known Language
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: An overview of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) technology, including its history and challenges in implementing it for regional languages. The challenges include lack of training data, dialectal and pronunciation variations, limited vocabulary, code mixing, and lack of standardization. Addressing these challenges requires significant research and development efforts to create accurate and reliable ASR systems for regional languages. In this research paper we have discussed various Automatic Speech Recognition model along with the application used in various field finally we have evaluated the accuracy of ASR for major Indian languages.

articleTitle: Energy Efficient Structure-Free Data Aggregation and Delivery in WSN: A Design Thinking Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The Wireless Sensor Network's (WSN) efficient communication capabilities, it has found a wide range of applications, some of which include battlefield surveillance, monitoring of surroundings and congestion, and contemporary agriculture. The energy use of certain sensor nodes inside a WSN, the delivery of packets, the amount of delay, and the lifetime of the network are all limited. In previous work, energy efficient is not achieved effectively in sensor network. The Enhanced Squirrel Search Algorithm (ESSA) is suggested in this study to address the problem by enhancing data aggregation and network energy efficiency. Data aggregation is carried out via Cluster Heads (CH), and CH based data aggregation is a crucial approach for lowering each sensor node's energy usage in WSN. In order to increase the network lifespan over WSN, CH selection is crucial. Using an objective function that chooses the best CH sensor node to gather data, the ESSA produces the best fitness values. The selection of sensor nodes takes into account factors like energy, distance, and bandwidth. The suggested ESSA model's results are simulated using energy consumption, network lifespan, data aggregation accuracy, and time. Based on the experimental findings and observations, the suggested ESSA model extends the life of the network and increases data aggregation accuracy while using less energy.

articleTitle: A Novel Machine Learning Model For Financial Volatility Detection In Corporate Companies
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Anticipating the volatility of financial resources can be valuable since volatility is much of the time utilized in a few financial areas. In this review, we utilize long transient memory (LSTM) and deep brain organization (DNN) models to assess stock file volatility. Most of related research projects train machine learning models utilizing the distance misfortune capability, yet this has two disadvantages. The first is that their models can't be reasonably contrasted with econometric models since they make botches while involving assessed volatility as the gauging point. We also perform probability-based analysis functions to prepare deep learning models and test individual models against test probabilities for solving these two problems. Our findings show that deep learning models with probability-based unhappiness features can estimate volatility more accurately than econometric models and deep learning models with distance unhappiness features. Of his two deep learning models with probability-based misfortune functions, the LSTM model performs the best.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Networks: A Comprehensive Review of Architectures and Application
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Convolutional Neural Networks have become a popular image and video recognition tool, achieving state-of-the-art performance in various domains such as object detection, face recognition, and natural language processing. This paper provides a comprehensive review of CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) architectures and their applications. We first introduce the basic structure of CNN s, and their unique features compared to traditional neural networks. Our review aims to provide a full overview of CNN s and their applications and to identify future research directions in this field.

Index Terms: ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge

articleTitle: Analysis of Blockchain Technology to Protect Data Access Using Intelligent Contract Mechanism for 5G Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: With constantly changing internet models automating and digitising countless residential and industrial applications, the world of today has made significant progress in the sharing of healthcare data and the implementation of crucial actions. The two most crucial factors in the setting of healthcare data exchange today are privacy and data integrity. In order to prevent unauthorised individuals from viewing or accessing sensitive data, such as medical information, encryption is essential. The intermediary nodes shouldn't be given too much weight because conventional encryption techniques could not be deployable through them. The current security alternatives for IoT-driven healthcare monitoring frameworks are discussed in this article along with the numerous security challenges that exist in the current 5G network design and how blockchain technology may be used to encrypt data between nodes. The suggested approach outperformed the alternatives and the present strategies for IoT-driven healthcare monitoring frameworks' security solutions, according to a variety of performance factors utilised to test it. A number of performance parameters were used to test the suggested technique, and the results showed that it performed better than the alternatives.

articleTitle: Secure Authentication Protocols For Internet Of Things (Iot) Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The ability to give typical gadgets an extra technique for distinguishing proof and correspondence is known as the Internet of Things (IoT). The scope of IoT application spaces is extremely wide and incorporates things like wearables, savvy urban areas, shrewd homes, and e-wellbeing. Accordingly, many billions or perhaps many billions of gadgets will be connected together. These shrewd gadgets will actually want to assemble information, process it, and, surprisingly, come to decisions all alone. In these circumstances, security is totally important, and authentication specifically is of extraordinary significance given the potential mischief that could result from a maverick unauthenticated gadget in an IoT framework. IoT has as of late arisen as the state-of-the-art innovation that is intensely affecting business, medical services, and military applications. Remote correspondences are especially powerless to security takes a chance since anything associated with the internet is an objective for programmers and a possible wellspring of cyberattacks. Numerous IoT issues are presenting security gambles and forestalling Start to finish encryption during information transmission. Most of IoT gadgets presently being used don't have further developed arrangements or security systems, which makes them helpless against programmer assaults.

articleTitle: The Smart Performance Analysis of Cyber Security Issues in Crypto Currency Using Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Crypto currency is subject to persistent and dynamic cyber security risks. As with all types of online assets, digital wallets, exchanges and even individual user accounts are often subject to both malicious attacks and other vulnerabilities. Blockchain technology, due to its distributed nature, is more secure and provides a strong platform on which to build digital currency platforms. This paper seeks to examine the performance of Blockchain technology for improving the security of crypto currency transactions. To assess the system's performance in this regard, we conduct a series of tests to evaluate the system's resilience against various types of attacks, including distributed denial of service (DDoS) and other specialized cyber attacks. We assess the performance of various cyber security measures employed by the crypto currency and Blockchain platforms, including multi-signature wallets, distributed identity solutions, and data encryption approaches. The proposed model achieved 86.82 % hit rate, 87.05<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> miss rate and 88.57% fall out. Our results, based on an extensive empirical study of crypto currency transactions and Blockchain records, indicate that Blockchain technology significantly enhances the security of crypto currency transactions compared to other technologies. Our findings offer quantitative evidence that Blockchain-secured crypto currency networks are less vulnerable to attack than conventional payment systems.

articleTitle: Implementation of Cloud Computing and Monte Carlo Simulation in the Healthcare Telemetry Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Cloud computing in the healthcare industry allows medical organizations to store patient data securely and in compliance with privacy regulations. Furthermore, it enables remote monitoring of device performance, enabling clinicians to proactively identify and eliminate any potential problems. By identifying and predicting risks, clinicians can make well-informed decisions and conduct preventative measures such as targeted medication, avoiding risks and minimizing medical errors. Monte Carlo simulation enables healthcare organizations to accurately model and simulate complex systems, enabling them to analyze and assess the impact of each decision taken on the risk profile of the organization. Monte Carlo simulation can help healthcare organizations proactively identify, quantify and manage risks before they become real, enhancing the ability to ensure patient safety and maximize outcomes. This helps them to make more informed decisions and to improve overall efficiency and reduce costs. The combination of cloud computing and Monte Carlo simulation is revolutionizing the telemetry functions in the healthcare industry. By securely storing, monitoring and analyzing medical data, healthcare organizations can gain valuable insights for making better decisions faster. Furthermore, by simulating and modeling outcomes in advance, it is now possible to identify healthcare risks and operational issues in real-time, reducing the potential for unexpected costs and failures. In the future, this will enable healthcare organizations to apply a preventative approach to risk management and continue to provide safe and effective healthcare services.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Human Iris Recognition And Verification Framework Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The component of a computer system that is in responsibility of user security is one of the most important modules. It was demonstrated that simple logins and passwords are easy for hackers to obtain and cannot guarantee high efficiency. Biometric identity recognition is the preferred alternative. The most popular and commonly utilised method for system security, according to the researchers, is biometrics. Iris-based biometric systems are the most secure of biometric systems. A valuable and effective tool for human identification, the iris pattern is a different biological feature for every individual. Even though a number of approaches to this purpose have been described, features, including the high memory consumption, long run times, and computational complexity. New iris verification algorithms have recently been developed as a result of the advancement of machine learning technology. Hence, a novel approach to human recognition and verification framework using Machine Learning algorithm is described in this analysis. The texture-based features are extracted by use of the Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) and the Hausdorff Dimension (HD). The Support Vector Machine (SVM) algorithm is used to identify and verify the human iris in this strategy. The accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity of the presented approach are evaluated. The robustness of the system is demonstrated by its performance.

articleTitle: Multi-Class Skin Diseases Classification with Color and Texture Features Using Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Skin diseases are very common in our daily lives. In the present era, the prevalence of skin diseases is significant, resulting in it being a prevalent health concern. Due to the similarities in the appearance of different skin conditions, automatically classifying them using lesion images poses a challenging task.A small circular or randomly shaped spot on the patient's skin may be identified as indicative of a skin disease. Under certain circumstances, this illness can represent a serious threat when it transforms into skin cancer. Multi-Class Skin Diseases Classification with Colour and Texture Features Using Convolution Neural Network is discussed in this paper. The study investigated several deep learning-based methods for extracting characteristics from various skin cancer images, which are then used with machine learning classifiers to identify the type of skin illness. In the biomedical fields, machine learning algorithms are also widely used for segmentation and diagnosis. To alleviate the burden and assist patients in the early evaluation of a skin lesion, Computer-Aided Diagnosis (CAD) systems have been developed. Therefore, choosing appropriate Machine Learning (ML) algorithms and feature extraction techniques is essential to achieving high classification accuracy. The study's results indicate that integrating characteristics obtained from a Convolutional Neural Network can enhance the effectiveness of categorizing various skin lesions. The performance of the provided architecture is evaluated based on its sensitivity, accuracy, and specificity.

articleTitle: Impact of AI in Financial Technology- A Comprehensive Study and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Presently across the world, financial institutions strive tremendously hard to make financial services smarter to benefit from the advantages of digitization. To enhance client services, financial technology (Fintech) uses a variety of modern breakthrough technologies, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), 5G/6G, Blockchain, Metaverse, IoT, and others, in the financial sector. Many important financial services and procedures, including loans, authentication, fraud detection, quality control, creditworthiness, and several more, would be streamlined and improved by the adoption of technology. However, a need exists for the development of innovative financial products as well as the corresponding technological ecosystem. To launch Information and Communication Technology (ICT) alternatives, various major tech companies have placed their emphasis on Fintech. In this paper, we first explore the latest opportunities in Fintech. Furthermore, we also attempt to present a foundation of the Fintech accelerators, such as IoT, 5G, Digital twins, and Metaverse. Additionally, we also outline recommendations for future research directions in Fintech while looking forwards to potential difficulties.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of LSB & DCT Based Steganographic Techniques: Confidentiality, Contemporary State, and Future Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In order to maintain anonymity and security, the steganography is the technique of cloaking confidential data within what seems like harmless digital material. Several steganographic methods have been established devised over time, but those centered around the discrete cosine transformation (DCT) and the least significant bit (LSB) have drawn the most consideration. In this study, two common steganographic methods are compared and contrasted with an emphasis on the secrecy they can keep, the usage they are now receiving, and any potential difficulties in the future. As an alternative, the DCT-based method uses the frequency domain properties of cover media to obfuscate hidden information. Since it spreads the concealed information across several frequency coefficients, it provides greater security than LSB-based techniques. The resilience and imperceptibility of the concealed data are improved by a variety of DCT-based algorithms, such as the modified quantization and matrix encoding approaches, which we explore in detail. We also give a general summary of both approaches' current state in terms of their application, constraints, and areas in which they may be used. We evaluate the benefits and drawbacks of each approach, considering elements like payload size, computing difficulty, and detection resistance.

articleTitle: Employing Convolutional Neural Network for IoT Healthcare Attack Detection in Intensive Care Unit
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The Internet of Things helps the healthcare sector to embrace the methodologies with emerging technologies and facilitate technological change from traditional to highly equipped technology. Some of the frequent uses of the Internet of Things in healthcare include monitoring patient healthcare, enhancing proper healthcare and searching medical resources. This digitalization and increase in the use of internet-connected sensors in healthcare have taken to a new height through advancement in technology. But security and efficient use of IoT in healthcare is still a critical challenge. Cyber-attacks are very common at present with the main motive of hacking private patient data and stealing other health information from the devices equipped for fetching patient's well-being. This research paper shows the employment of a convolutional neural network for detecting attacks on Intensive care units in hospitals. The results achieved by the convolutional neural network technique prove that deep learning methodologies are a promising solution to provide reliable and trustworthy communication in healthcare sectors with the Internet of Things devices.

articleTitle: Blockchain based Smart Energy Trading in a Sustainable Community: A Comparative Technological Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The significance of blockchain enabled smart con- tracts for the energy market is widely recognized, given the continuous shift towards a more decentralized and flexible energy grid. Blockchain Technology (BCT) is viewed as a critical technology for facilitating the shift to a more economical, transparent, and transactive sustainable energy market because of its autonomous, configurable, and tamper-proof character. This paper explores the significance and scope of blockchain technology in various stages of smart energy trading in sustainable communities. Our investigation analyzes the existing processes, difficulties, and potential of energy trading mechanisms in renewable energy markets, providing an adequate basis for the research. This paper also proposes a blockchain based Peer to Peer Energy Trading (P2P-ET) architecture using Hyperledger Fabric, notably on the concepts of organizational focus, private channels, and chain code, as well as the flow of transactions in the Hyperledger Fabric network. These components must be successfully developed and implemented in order to establish a strong energy trading network.

articleTitle: Quantum Man-in-the-Middle Attacks on QKD Protocols: Proposal of a Novel Attack Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
