abstract: Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) protocols theo- retically propose a high-security level based on the advantages of quantum computing. This paper analyze the security level of one of the most well-known QKD protocols, BB84, against the man-in-the-middle attack strategy. Specifically, we leverage quantum entanglement to enhance communication security by the injection of a malicious photon in the middle of transmission. In the security analysis, we measure the variation in mutual information between the sender-receiver and sender-attacker to assess the protocol's resilience against potential attacks.

articleTitle: Calories Burned Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In today's world, where people are leading busy lives with changes in their lifestyle and work commitments, it has become difficult to prioritize regular physical activity to maintain good health. The lack of physical activity and unhealthy food habits can lead to various health issues, including obesity. To maintain a healthy lifestyle, it is crucial to balance diet and exercise, and knowing calorie intake and burn is essential. While tracking calorie intake is relatively easy, monitoring calorie burn is challenging due to the limited devices available. This research aims to develop a model using a Random Forest Regressor machine learning algorithm to accurately predict the number of calories burned. The model was trained on more than 15,000 data points and demonstrated a Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) of 8.3. However, with additional data, the accuracy of the model can improve over time. The primary goal of this research is to develop an accurate and efficient model that can aid people in maintaining a healthy lifestyle by accurately predicting the number of calories burned during physical activity.

articleTitle: Implementing Blockchain Based Security in EHR Using Ganache
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: A blockchain-based electronic health record (EHR) system has been proposed to manage patient data and maintain computerized records across different healthcare institutions. The main objective of this system is to provide immediate access to patient health information while addressing concerns about privacy and security. It is developed on the Ethereum network using programming languages, tools, and technologies such as Ganache, Solidity, and web3.js. The system uses smart contracts to provide security and privacy, and transactions are verified and propagated to the entire decentralized network. The system includes a cryptocurrency wallet (MetaMask) with a centralized privacy system that allows authorized parties to access and secure records quickly. The proposed system aims to achieve several objectives such as allowing users to receive the same data simultaneously, increasing efficiency, building trust, and reducing barriers. It secures data storage by restricting user access and enables the secure transfer of patient medical records. The solution allows for better transparency and ownership of sensitive data, which can be recorded and safeguarded via blockchain technology, therefore assisting the healthcare sector. This paper describes a medical record system and a new protocol that can be used quickly and safely, paving the way for more secure and efficient healthcare systems. Overall, the proposed system offers potential solutions to the challenges associated with traditional EHR systems and has the potential to revolutionize the healthcare industry.

articleTitle: Video Anomaly Detection with Spatio-Temporal Inspired Deep Neural Networks (DNN)
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Intelligent surveillance systems must be able to detect anomalies promptly to prevent malicious activity. It is common for deep learning methods to be used in video anomaly detection to focus on analyzing video streams from just one camera with a single scenario. Using large-scale training data with high complexity is necessary for these deep learning methods. This paper uses a spatiotemporal-inspired Deep Neural Network (DNN) to detect video anomalies. Rather than expensive optical flow calculations, a Deep Neural Network (DNN) is used for motion information in the proposed approach to achieve high recognition accuracy at a low computational cost. Experimental results on publicly available datasets demonstrate that the proposed model provides better input frame generation performance and is more accurate than existing approaches.

articleTitle: Enhancing Guest Experience and Operations Efficiency in Homestays Through Artificial Intelligence: A Conceptual Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) in homestays could improve the tourist experience and operational efficiency. This article proposes a comprehensive conceptual framework for AI in homestays, encompassing visitor experience enhancement, personalized suggestions, predictive analytics, inventory management, maintenance scheduling, and data analytics. AI algorithms allow homestay owners to make personalized recommendations for activities, local sights, and meals. AI-powered home automation systems let guests customize lighting, temperature, and entertainment. AI-powered chatbots and virtual assistants help visitors with questions and requests. Predictive analytics models help operators optimize pricing, estimate demand, and allocate resources, improving revenue management and operational efficiency. AI-based inventory management systems optimize inventory levels, reduce waste, and ensure supplies. Proactive maintenance using AI lowers downtime and enhances the visitor experience. AI-enabled data analytics systems measure occupancy rates, revenue, and visitor satisfaction in real time for informed decision-making and ongoing development. AI in homestays must handle ethical issues including openness, fairness, and accountability, as well as privacy and data security. Cost, technological knowledge, and user approval are other challenges. This article concludes that AI technology in homestays can improve tourist experiences and operational efficiency. Future research should address ethical, privacy, and implementation issues to fully fulfill AI's transformational potential in homestays.

articleTitle: A Review Paper On The Use Of Artificial Intelligence In Postal And Parcel Sorting
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The postal and parcel sorting industry is critical to the logistics industry, facilitating the efficient and timely delivery of parcels worldwide. As parcel volumes continue to increase, there is a growing need for faster and more accurate sorting processes. Artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a potential solution to this challenge, with the ability to analyze vast amounts of data quickly and accurately. This review paper provides an overview of the importance of postal and parcel sorting in the logistics industry and how AI can improve the efficiency and accuracy of the sorting process. The discussion reveals that AI has already been successfully implemented in various aspects of the sorting process, including sorting, routing, tracking, and delivery. However, the review also highlights the challenges and limitations of using AI in postal and parcel sorting. These include issues related to data quality, privacy, security, and ethics. The limitations of current AI technologies, such as bias, interpretability, and scalability, must also be addressed to improve the effectiveness of the sorting process. Overall, this review paper highlights the potential of AI to significantly improve the efficiency and accuracy of the postal and parcel sorting process, and its continued development and implementation are likely to have a profound impact on the logistics industry as a whole.

articleTitle: Gorilla Troops Optimization Algorithm for Optimal Placement of EV Charging Station with DG on Power Network
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This paper employs a novel optimization approach for addressing the problem of optimal allocation of Distributed Generators (DGs) with Electric Vehicle Charging Stations (EVCSs) on Radial Power Distribution Networks (RPDNs). In this paper, the goal of integrating Distributed Generation (DG) is to mitigate the negative impacts of EVCS load on the RPDN. In this study, a nature-inspired Gorilla Troops Optimization Algorithm (GTOA) is utilized to determine the optimal placement, sizing, and power factor of Distributed Generation (DG) units in conjunction with Electric Vehicle Charging Stations (EVCS) installation on the RPDN. The primary optimization objectives of this coordination approach are the minimization of power loss, reduction of voltage deviation, and enhancement of the voltage stability of the system. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is evaluated by considering various cases of DG placement with EVCSs on the RPDNs. Also, a comparative analysis is conducted to assess the effectiveness of the proposed method in comparison with Moth-flame optimization and ant lion optimizer algorithms. The results demonstrate that the GTOA provides superior solution quality compared to competing algorithms.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study Of The Machine Learning With Federated Learning Approach For Predicting Heart Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Heart disease is a leading cause of mortality worldwide, resulting in millions of deaths annually. As individuals age and their physical condition deteriorates, the risk of developing heart disease increases. To mitigate this risk, predictive models leveraging machine learning and artificial intelligence have emerged as valuable tools for early diagnosis and treatment. In this review paper, we introduce the Google-pioneered concept of federated learning as a means to address concerns about data safety in the context of heart disease prediction. Federated learning, also known as collaborative learning, employs a technique wherein an algorithm is trained through multiple independent sessions, each utilizing its own dataset. This paper aims to provide a comprehensive investigation of recent machine learning approaches and databases employed in predicting the occurrence of cardiovascular disease.

articleTitle: Development of a Machine Learning Based Decision Support System for Rice Fungal Disease Management
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Rice is one of the most important grains, providing the main food for more than half of the economy's new people. However, rice production has been severely damaged by fungal diseases. In this survey, we propose a state-of-the-art device to localize fungal diseases in rice flora using photo manipulation techniques. The machine can detect and classify five new fungal diseases: brown, scab, wheat blast, blight and leaf spot. The system uses information on new images of modern wheat with and without fungal diseases. We extract features from snapshots using various imaging techniques and then use the extracted features to train a fashion algorithm. It has been observed that the proposed method provides 95% accuracy in detecting and isolating fungal diseases in rice plants.

articleTitle: Water Quality Monitoring System Using Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are playing an important role in transforming the field with sensor technology. WSNs have become an important generation for many operations, such as military operations, surveillance vehicles, and intelligent transportation systems (ITS). WSN also plays an important role in monitoring environmental conditions like air quality monitoring, water monitoring, and pressure and temperature monitoring. Water quality monitoring uses high-power radio frequency communication channels for providing highly reliable real-time systems. This helps in preserving our natural resources. A WSN consists of various sensor nodes that collect records from the environment. The parameters included in determining the quality of the water are pH level, temperature, and turbidity. Sensor nodes sense the data and send it to the base station in real-time or any monitoring system. In this paper, we proposed a water quality monitoring system based on Bluetooth technology for real-time monitoring of data. This wireless system of water quality monitoring will give real-time monitoring of data. It also reduces the labor cost and provides flexibility in terms of long-distance and location. The proposed system could be customized also. The result of measurement shows the evaluation in terms of reliability and effectiveness.

articleTitle: A Novel Design Evolution of mmWave W-D Bands Modified Rectangular Patch Antenna with Circular and Rectangular Slots for Future IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The research article elaborates microwave access for 5G-6G infrastructure on a novel band design working at the centered frequency of 90GHz in the W band with a peak return loss of -38.068 dB, along with a modified inset-fed rectangular antenna with circular and rectangular shaped slots in the patch and ground plane. Furthermore, it comprises an additional dual band ranging from 100.88 GHz to 150.78 GHz in the D band. The substrate fabricated on the proposed antenna is identified as a 0.254mm thick Rogers RT/ Duroid 5880 (with a 2.2 permittivity) radiating EM energy along with the casting impedance matching technique. In the wideband, observe a second resonant frequency of 113.5 GHz, operating in the EHF (extremely high frequency) band corresponding to a peak return loss of -33.9 db. To achieve the simulation and designing of the proposed antenna, HFSS along with its electromagnetic analysis has been employed. The antenna technology showcases EM wave a holistic design approach and its compact dimensions of 6.2×7.4×0.254mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. To enhance the transmission coefficients of the proposed structure, the rectangular feed line with an impedance of 50Ω is connected to the rectangular patch. The sweep range is recognized from 60 GHz to 160 GHz, i.e., 100 GHz frequency. The total efficiency of the proposed antenna is measured as 87.3 % which is essential for cost savings, reduced energy consumption, and improved environmental sustainability. A peak gain of 6.38 dB is achieved along with the front-to-back ratio of 7 dB. Significantly the spectrum above 90 GHz is foreseen as a catering agent for 6G compact devices. Thus, the research paper aims to analyze the design evolution of the proposed antenna with various parameters like Average gain, Reflection coefficients, and bandwidth and to catalyze the evolution of future network communication scenarios via 6G technology applicable in IoT technologies.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Prediction Approach For Financial Forecast System In Stock Exchange Marketing Management
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Financial forecasting is a crucial task in stock exchange marketing management. In recent years, machine learning algorithms have gained popularity as a powerful tool for financial forecasting due to their ability to handle complex patterns in the data. In this context, this paper proposes a novel machine learning prediction approach for financial forecasting using ARIMA and Gradient Boosting algorithms. ARIMA is a widely used time series model that can capture the temporal dependencies in the data. Modelling using ARIMA uses Those three factors, namely trends in the data may be captured by adjusting the following orders: differencing (d), autoregression (p), and moving average (q). Modelling using ARIMA can handle time series, both stationary and non-stationary data, making it a suitable choice for financial forecasting. Gradient Boosting, to contrast, is a ML algorithm that can pick up complex patterns in the numbers by iteratively Modelling using decision trees. It works by modifying the importance of individual data points to improve the accuracy of the predictions. Gradient Boosting can handle both regression and classification tasks and is particularly useful for predicting non-linear relationships in the data. The proposed approach combines the strengths of ARIMA and Gradient Boosting to improve the accuracy of financial forecasting. The ARIMA model is first used to pre-process the time series data and to extract the temporal dependencies. The residuals obtained from the ARIMA model are then used as input to the Gradient Boosting algorithm, which learns the non-linear relationships in the data. The proposed approach was evaluated using real-world financial data from the S&P 500 index. The The findings supported the strategy that was presented outperformed both the ARIMA and Gradient Boosting algorithms alone regarding precision and forecasting performance. All things considered, the planned approach achieved an accuracy of 96.4%, which is significantly higher than the 91.3% and 92.7% achieved by the ARIMA and Gradient Boosting algorithms, respectively. In conclusion, the proposed approach provides a novel solution for financial forecasting in stock exchange marketing management. By combining the strengths of ARIMA and Gradient Boosting, the proposed approach can improve the accuracy of financial forecasting and provide valuable insights for decision-making in the financial industry.

articleTitle: A Review Study on Feedback Models for Information Retrieval
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The benefits of feedback for researchers as achievement and development are undisputed. For this reason, researchers have sought to develop ideas and frameworks that describe how feedback works and what factors may influence feedback engagement in it. This review paper aimed to summarize the best-known models and ideas we discovered through a methodical, three-step process. We discussed the definitions, models, historical context, and certain basic mechanisms of feedback systems. At the end of our examination of the models, we reached eight major conclusions. This study aims to advance knowledge in this area and help researchers and educators select the best models for their studies and policy development in feedback model. We further evaluated and analyzed the fourteen models in our supplemental study to classify common features and integrate them into a new comprehensive model.

articleTitle: Brain Tumour Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: A brain tumour is an ailment resulting from the formation of aberrant brain cells. There exist two elementary varieties of brain neoplasms: malignant (cancerous) brain neoplasms and benign (non-cancerous) brain neoplasms. Because brain tumours are rare and come in various kinds, it is challenging to forecast the survival rate of a patient predisposed to them. The type of brain tumour, the degree of cellular abnormality, the part of the brain where the tumour is located and other variables all affect how it is treated. As artificial intelligence advances, deep learning algorithms are utilized for the verdict of brain tumours using magnetic resonance imaging data. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) scanning technique utilizes Strong electromagnetic waves to provide accurate and sharp images of the interior body. This research paper focuses on providing a comparative analysis of several algorithms which can be used for image segmentation and detecting tumours.

articleTitle: Credit Card Financial Fraudster Discovery with Machine Learning Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Credit card financial fraudster activity is a critical issue in today's technological era for financial institutions and their customers. In this study, we investigate the use of multiple machine learning models such as support vector classifier, logistic regression, K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) classifier, random forest classifier, decision tree classifier, a machine learning algorithm, to detect fraudulent credit card transactions in a dataset where only a tiny fraction of transactions is fraudulent and need to investigate the detection with at most accuracy. To address the issue of imbalanced data, we employ under-sampling of the majority class and oversampling of the minority class. Our results show that the logistic regression, random forest classifier, support vector classifier, decision tree classifier, and KNN classifier model can achieve 99% accuracy in detecting fraudulent transactions. Additionally, we perform feature importance analysis to identify the most significant variables that contribute to fraud detection. The approach used in this study can contribute to the development of more sophisticated fraud detection models for financial institutions. It also provided the pattern of fraud detection daily on the week chart. Overall, our findings have practical implications for financial institutions and researchers seeking to improve their fraud detection capabilities, which can lead to a more secure and trustworthy financial system for all stakeholders involved.

articleTitle: Hybrid Classification Model For Acoustic-Based Emergency Vehicle Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In our daily lives, transportation holds a significant priority in today's fast-paced world. This research proposes an innovative method that makes use of vehicle-to-infrastructure communication to improve traffic management and road safety. Through this technology, automobiles can communicate directly with one another and transmit vital data concerning vehicle overloads to the hardware infrastructure that has been established on roads. By exchanging data in real-time, we can alert the infrastructure to potentially dangerous circumstances. Research focuses on feature extraction from the communicated vehicle data using the Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCC) technique. This algorithm has shown to be incredibly effective in identifying pertinent audio qualities for additional research. Additionally, a brand-new vote classification approach that combines the strength of three classifiers is proposed. k-Nearest Neighbours with Support Vector Machines (SVM). Provided results for the study are a significant contribution to the expanding field of intelligent transportation systems and offer insightful information to researchers, infrastructure managers, and legislators who are tasked with building more intelligent and secure road networks.

articleTitle: Dorsal Hand Vein Based Authentication Systems Using Chicken Swarm Optimization

articleTitle: Dynamic Price Management System in a Distributed Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: With the increase in the number of e-commerce applications on the internet, the demand and supply of commodities have increased. Though a static pricing system can be used in today's evolving market, prices of a commodity ought to be dynamically updated to improve revenues. The main challenge is to design a system dealing with real-time price updating based on the analysis of the available and complex data. The fundamental challenge is to design a dynamic price management system that meets the demand of customers and the availability of a commodity to maximize revenues with minimum cost and time involvement. In this paper, a Dynamic price management system (DPMS) for a flexible and connected smart nation has been designed to control and monitor the pricing of a commodity from selling platforms like retail, wholesale, the company's website, and e-commerce. Enormous pricing management system models have been researched, but in this paper, our objective is to provide a flexible, versatile, and intellectual pricing management system that handles the pricing of a commodity through a single interface for all the selling platforms. Smart pricing is the dynamic adjustment of prices or repricing of a commodity based on the market demand for a product. This model simplifies the vendors' problem of controlling a homogenous commodity's price component on different selling platforms like retail, wholesale, and e-commerce for a fully connected smart nation.

articleTitle: Examining Effectiveness of Cloudlets in Mobile Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The use of mobile devices and the applications that can be downloaded onto them are becoming more commonplace in everyday life. Mobile apps need a large number of resources to develop and maintain. On the other hand, computers that need less resources to function properly are considered to be cleverer. Before we go on to the next topic, let's begin by going over some background information on cloudlet-based mobile computing. Following the completion of that task, we will move on to the next step of completing the review of the most recent research on data offloading and computing based on cloudlets. Following that, we will discuss two problems that end users have while using cloudlets. In our conclusion, we take a look at the present state of affairs in this industry as well as the challenges and opportunities that lie in store for the future. Because of the delays caused by WAN connections, offloading work to the cloud is not always a viable option for successfully completing it. This is especially true for real-time applications such as augmented reality, such as the ones that were discussed before in this paragraph. As a direct consequence of this, the cloud itself is required to be sent to the location of the mobile user in the form of cloudlets. Cloudlets don't need to be a fixed infrastructure directly next to the wireless access point; rather, they may be built on the fly using any LAN network device that has the requisite capacity to do so. This allows for more flexibility. In contrast to the traditional conception, which necessitated the use of specialist equipment, cloudlets are now able to be produced without the need for it. Because of this, the creation of cloudlets moves forwards much more quickly.

articleTitle: A New Era of Land Cover Land Use Categorization Using Remote Sensing and GIS of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Big data is the present era in which we find ourselves. Using spatial data, including auxiliary geospatial datasets and remotely sensed satellite images, has become prevalent in land cover and land use mapping (LCLU). Moreover, deep learning and machine learning algorithms have recently been innovated, offering new prospects for LCLU mapping. But problems often arise when it comes to using big geospatial data. This article summarizes research advancements in remote sensing (RS), machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), and geographic information big data for LCLU classification. We analyzed the advantages, disadvantages, and potential future directions of LCLU mapping utilizing big geospatial data. Further research is needed to improve the LCLU process at larger scales.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Techniques for Sentiment Analysis: A Comparative Study

abstract: In today's digital era, exposure to the internet has changed the economic space; now people give their views regarding products and services provided to them online so that others can decide based on these reviews, and service providers can also take benefits from these to improve their product or service. This ultimately helpful in economy growth. In this direction, sentiment analysis provides a means to gain insight into people's opinions. This study examines the use of three distinct deep learning models: LSTM, GRU, and ELECTRA to apply sentiment analysis to the Spotify music app. Comparing the accuracy of each model, it is discovered that LSTM and GRU perform better than ELECTRA, with accuracy values of 77.21 % and 77.32%, respectively, as opposed to ELECTRA's accuracy value of 72.03 %. These findings imply that the particular dataset and attributes utilized for training these models may affect their efficacy. In conclusion, this work sheds light on the effectiveness of deep learning models for sentiment analysis and emphasizes the significance of careful model and feature selection for obtaining correct findings.

articleTitle: Monkeypox and other Skin Conditions Detection Utilizing CNN with VGG16 Transfered Language

abstract: The upcoming multi country monkeypox outbreak in 2022 becomes a worldwide health problem. Following Covid19, the monkeypox virus has issued a fresh warning that it might become an across-the-world epidemic; interaction with infected animals or people spreads the virus. Monkeypox has been correlated to Measles and Chickenpox. Monkeypox can be differentiated from other skin diseases by its etiology. These viruses are all different infectious diseases that are spread via the air and have similar symptoms. The most effective approach to avoid these is through vaccination, but no vaccine is available to prevent monkeypox infection. The study provides an image categorization to separate signs of monkeypox, chickenpox, and Measles sickness. In image-based diagnostics, such as identifying cancerous cells, tumor cellular identification, and COVID-19 patient detection, machine learning (ML) has shown significant potential. The image categorization method used by the researchers was deep learning (DL) utilizing Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture and VGG-16. Transfer learning is a technique that enables a model learned on one dataset to be applied to another, allowing the model to translate information from the initial data set to the newly acquired data. This strategy is recommended by experts because neural networks are exceptionally good at learning comparable images and accurately predicting new data. As a consequence, at epoch value is 15; the VGG-16 has a high accuracy of 92%. However, it might be high if images are more widely available. As a result, a dataset is urgently required to include images of monkeypox afflicted patients.

articleTitle: A Review of Sign Language Recognition Approaches

abstract: Communication has proven to be one of the most efficient ways to convey ideas throughout time. It continually proves to be one of the best ways to make one's suggestions apparent. This review provides a thorough study of various texts on sign language recognition in several languages. The technical advancements made in this area are briefly explained. Additionally, a comprehensive assessment of potential future developments for this subject has been successfully taken into account.

articleTitle: An Analysis of Machine Learning Techniques for Forest Cover Type Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: For environmental management and conservation, forecasting the forest's tree cover is essential. Accurate prediction models are needed to evaluate the possible effects and pinpoint places that need rapid attention as deforestation and forest degradation become a more widespread concern. In this study, we employ machine learning to predict forest tree cover using dataset of environmental variables and historical tree cover data. The foundation of our approach is the Random Forests ensemble learning technique, which combines different decision trees to improve prediction accuracy. Our goal is to create a model that, using environmental variables like elevation, rainfall, temperature, and soil type, can precisely forecast the number of trees in each location. To train and evaluate our model, we employ a dataset of more than 500,000 forested regions located throughout the United States. With predictions of forest tree cover being upto 97% accurate, the results demonstrate that the Random Forest model outperforms conventional machine learning techniques. Machine learning may be utilised as a useful tool in environmental management and conservation efforts by estimating the amount of forest tree cover. Accurate tree cover forecast can help in determining which regions need forest preservation, reforestation, or both.

articleTitle: Ensemble Deep Learning Models for Stock Prediction: Analyzing Financial Data and News Articles of S&P 500 Companies
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The use of Deep Learning (DL) in the analysis of financial data has significantly increased in popularity in recent years. Analysing textual, numerical, and graphical financial data is part of this. Future stock price predicting is one of the complex problems in DL for finance that stands out. The difficulty is caused by the vast number of variables that affect stock market volatility and trends at the same time. These variables include aspects unique to the company, such as actual and predicted earnings, dividends, product launches or recalls, significant contracts, management changes, possible takeovers or mergers, and accounting problems. External variables that affect stock movements include investor sentiment, industry performance, and economic statistics. Therefore, this paper provides a novel DL model for stock prediction using the aforementioned variables included in the S&P 500 index, i.e. publically available datasets. We investigate different DL models, including Long Short Term Memory (LSTM), Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN), Bidirectional-Recurrent Neural Network (RNN), and Deep RNN. Our ensemble models achieve an astounding 85% accuracy in predicting the direction of the S&P 500 index by looking at weekly historical prices, financial reports, and news articles pertaining to large-cap businesses in the S&P 500 index from January 1, 2000, to December 31, 2019. When compared to cutting-edge models that have been reported in the literature, the ensemble models exhibit competitive performance.

articleTitle: Edge Computing for Sustainable Energy Management: An Environmental Aspect
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The unprecedented growth of the world's population and industries has led to the ever-increasing demand for energy. However, the generation and distribution of energy have far-reaching impacts on the environment. To mitigate these impacts, sustainable energy management has become a priority for many countries. Edge computing has emerged as a promising technology that can aid in sustainable energy management. This paper explores the role of edge computing in sustainable energy management with an emphasis on the environmental aspect. The paper examines the concept of edge computing and how it can be applied to sustainable energy management. The paper also highlights the environmental benefits of using edge computing in sustainable energy management. The paper concludes that edge computing can play a significant role in sustainable energy management, particularly in mitigating environmental impacts. Complex interactions between edge devices, edge servers, and cloud data centres may explain why edge computing has received less attention to energy efficiency than cloud data centres. Reaching energy efficiency goals with edge computing requires thorough testing of edge devices, edge servers, and cloud data centres. This paper's goal is to give readers a synopsis of edge computing's history and evolution. We then shifted our focus to the fundamentals of edge computing. The study concludes with a discussion of the advantages and disadvantages of edge computing.

articleTitle: Traffic Prediction Analysis (TPA) Using Machine Learning Methodologies
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: A traffic prediction system might help drivers in making better travel choices. Minimizing carbon emissions, reducing traffic congestion, and improving the effectiveness of traffic management to deliver such traffic flow data is the main aim of traffic flow prediction. Prediction of traffic is essential in a system of intelligent transportation. Effective traffic forecasting can help with route design, vehicle dispatching, and reducing traffic congestion. Due to its incredible capacity to predict traffic patterns, a branch of machine learning which is also called “deep learning,” has recently attracted a lot of attention. In this study, a comparative evaluation has been done to predict traffic flow based on deep learning. To prepare the stacked auto encoder model, basic traffic flow features are included. The goal of this study is to conduct a thorough screening for deep earning -based traffic forecast algorithms from multiple angles. This study recommends a deep learning method to predict urban traffic that combines data from twitter messages with traffic and weather data. The predictive model uses a deep Bi-directional long- short-term memory (LSTM) Stacked Auto Encoder (SAE) architecture for multi-step traffic flow prediction that was trained from tweets, traffic, and weather datasets. To support study in this area, it also gathers and arranges frequently available public datasets.

articleTitle: Role of Ontology-Informed Machine Learning in Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Ontologies are used in practically every major biological database to formalise and reason about domain information in the life sciences. Ontologies are increasingly employed to offer background information in similarity-based analysis and machine learning models. Combining ontologies with machine learning is still experimental. We discuss how semantic similarity measures and ontology embeddings can use ontologies' background knowledge and provide constraints to improve machine learning models. Ontological research can help in machine learning by introducing the broad aspects of the future scope. The ontology supports structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data types for building a piece of valuable information.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review on Green Manufacturing of Automotive Parts
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Automotive industries play a significant growth in the global economy. Even though, the automotive sector faces a growing number of environmental problems, such as pollution, resource depletion, and greenhouse gas emissions. Green manufacturing has become more popular in the industry as a response to these difficulties, with an emphasis on sustainability, effectiveness, and environmental responsibility. An in-depth investigation of the condition of green manufacturing techniques in the automotive sector is the main goal of this systematic research. This systematic review employs scholarly articles, academic journals, case studies, and reports from 2019 to 2023 to understand the best practices and latest developments in green manufacturing of automotive industries. This comprehensive assessment provides insightful information about the tactics used by automobile makers to reduce their environmental impact while maintaining competitiveness in a changing market. It adds to the continuing discussion about environmentally friendly manufacturing techniques and serves as a starting point for further study and the formulation of government regulations about green production in the automobile sector. In the end, this assessment is an essential tool for academics, decision-makers, and business experts who are attempting to find their way toward a more sustainable manufacturing sector of automotive industries. To achieve environmental goals, manufacturers should keep emphasizing sustainable materials, making investments in green manufacturing based on the 5Rs.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Traffic Control Systems For Smart Cities In Civil Engineering

articleTitle: Implementation Of Secure Storage For Maintaining Characteristic Contracts In Civil Law
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In public life, the contract, which is one of the oldest legal instruments, is widely used to regulate relations related to the satisfaction of certain needs of participants in civil law relations. Property relations that develop at the stage of sale of manufactured goods, performance of work, provision of services is based on the construction of the contract. Property interest is secured by an agreement. A contract is an agreement between two or more persons on the emergence, change or termination of their civil rights and obligations. It can be seen from the definition that the interested parties in the contract are counterparties directly participating in it. Civil law relations arising under this agreement apply only to both of them and create relative legal relations. According to the principle of relativity, the contract, as a rule, obliges the parties that have concluded it does not affect third parties. Contracts concluded for the benefit of third parties are one of the very important exceptions to this principle. When it comes to cyber security, the characteristic contract made for the favour of a third party may involve the exchange, processing, or storage of sensitive information. This article discusses the features of the secure storage for contract concluded in favour of a third party as a subject of research. The secure MD5 fused AES algorithm is proposed here to improve data privacy and security in the storage.

articleTitle: Influenza Flu Diagnostics and Detection using Artificial Intelligence-based Learning Approaches: Challenges and Recent Study

abstract: Influenza is a life-threatening disease mainly for an older population. In other section of the paper, we have given comparative study of the same work done in section 3 that helps researchers in getting brief knowledge about available datasets, Artificial intelligence algorithms is used with their outcomes and limitations. The motive of overall study is giving brief knowledge about Influenza flu and role of Artificial intelligence in it.

articleTitle: Enhancing Language Representation with Emotional Intelligence: A Weighted TF-IDF Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In the era of vast data availability, harnessing the power of smart automation and computational analysis is crucial for understanding public opinions in real time. Emotional intelligence technology plays a significant role in this intelligence landscape, and its research is pivotal in gaining insightful perspectives. Traditional scientific research often relies on representation classification, which primarily focuses on the semantic knowledge of words while neglecting their emotional dimensions. This study highlights the potential of sentiment analysis as a promising area of investigation and emphasizes the need to develop robust and precise methods that can effectively handle the complexities of natural language and capture the nuances of human emotions and sentiments. To address this, we propose a language representation enhancement technique that integrates emotional knowledge into the TF-IDF algorithm, resulting in weighted language representations. Furthermore, we explore the performance of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) in the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP). We find that while both architectures have demonstrated exceptional performance, RNNs, with their ability to predict longer-term dependencies, offer a more comprehensive understanding of language and provide richer information compared to CNNs. Future research should focus on refining these techniques and advancing our understanding of emotional intelligence in computational analysis.

articleTitle: Making Health Care Smarter: The Role of Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Machine learning algorithms make a significant contribution to disease prediction. The main objective of this is to support researchers and practitioners in choosing the most suitable machine learning algorithm for the healthcare sector. In today“s world machine learning (ML) algorithm has a essential role in many sectors like medical diagnosis, predictive analytics, security and in finance. Many people today are dealing with serious illnesses that must be detected in the starting stages of development in order to begin therapy on schedule. The diseases may become incurable once reaching this stage. By using machine learning algorithms, we can discover the patterns and predict the diseases. This study attempts to briefly describe several machine learning approaches and to discuss the function of these algorithms in the field of healthcare, including diabetes, cancer diagnosis, brain tumor detection, bioinformatics, and many more applications.

articleTitle: A Case Study of the Implementation Difficulties in the Pilot Low Cost Concentrating Solar Power Systems Deployment in Sub-Saharan Africa
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Among those most important resources for a particular country's expansion and expansion was electrical power. articleTitle: Evaluating The Factors Influencing The Employee Retention In Private Higher Education Institutions In Noida, Uttar Pradesh (India)
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The preservation of high-caliber academic staff has emerged as a pivotal concern in the realm of tertiary education. The present investigation was conducted to ascertain the determinants that impact the sustenance of academic staff in a privately owned institution in Noida. The institution in question harbors a robust aspiration to ascend to the upper echelons of global academia within the forthcoming quinquennium. The inquiry into the determinants that foster the retention of high-caliber academic personnel within the academic institution was the impetus for this investigation. The present investigation has employed a qualitative research methodology. The data was procured via comprehensive interviews conducted with a purposively chosen cohort of 12 highly distinguished individuals, with the aim of elucidating the most pertinent factors they perceived to be instrumental in the retention of faculty. The examination of the interview data through content analysis revealed groupings of factors that provide evidence of the research aim of the investigation. The retention of university faculty is influenced by several key factors, including leadership and institutional culture, growth opportunities, institutional mission and vision, meaningful roles, and cooperation and healthy interaction. Based on these observations, it would be prudent for universities to incorporate and systematize these factors as part of their retention strategies for faculty. It is imperative that such strategies be conjoined with the innate requirements of the faculty, unceasing assistance, and implementation within the institutional ethos and structure. The discourse highlights several implications that could potentially serve as instructive indicators from a pragmatic standpoint.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning and Blockchain Technology in Improving Supply Chain Financial Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The database used by blockchain innovation is run by numerous components and creates a network pattern using hash indexes. The blockchain employs numerous nodes and transmits numerous data access points, decreasing reliance on the primary Internet server and preventing the danger of data destruction and server breakdown. The data files saved in the blockchain are protected using encryption techniques to maintain their authenticity and prevent illegally added or discarded data files. With technological characteristics like non-tampering, distributed ledger, and reliability, blockchain innovations and machine learning have innate benefits in supply chain finance. They also have great prospects to construct faith in order to overcome the major issues in supply chain finance, which is helpful for fostering economic advancement in the Tonkin Gulf region. This paper focuses on introducing the study on using blockchain innovation in supply chain finance in the Tonkin Gulf region and aims to offer suggestions on how supply chain finance could evolve there using blockchain innovation. This paper suggests supply chain finance game applications for pertinent investigations as well as blockchain innovation, supply chain banking threats assessment on the blockchain and machine learning, and supply chain finance implementation study methodologies in the Tonkin Gulf region. The empirical findings presented in this paper demonstrate that the built blockchain supply chain finance platform has an algorithm with an overall processing time of 4.10 seconds, a computational efficiency that is quicker, and the ability to more accurately analyse the pertinent concerns.

articleTitle: 6G Networks in Unmanned Ariel Vehicle Intelligent Internet of Things Secured Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Unmanned airborne vehicles (UAVs) have shown enormous possible throughout recent years in conveying the expense and time-successful answers for the different social applications, including medical services, store network, and video and reconnaissance. Scientists from everywhere the world have offered various ways of protecting information against cyberattacks on the grounds that it has various information security and security concerns. Various of them have made ideas for very computationally concentrated cryptographic-based arrangements. Just few scholastics have proposed Blockchain (BC)- based arrangements, but these arrangements might have high information stockpiling costs as well as inertness, trustworthiness, and limit issues with the networks. This study introduced an InterPlanetary Record Framework and BC-based secure UAV communication convention over the 6G organization to address the previously mentioned issues. The proposed arrangement ensures information secrecy and protection, brings down the expense of information stockpiling, and further develops network proficiency. The following stage is to examine the exploration issues and future headings for improving the proposed framework.

articleTitle: Framework for Generation of Annotated Corpus for Recognition & Categorization of Geo-Political Entities from Indian Election Domain
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive framework for generating an annotated corpus that facilitates the recognition and categorization of geo-political entities within the Indian Election domain. It focuses on the generation of an annotated corpus and the development of a customized Named Entity Recognition (NER) model for the identification and categorization of geo-political entities within Indian Election domain text. The entities of interest include states, districts, parliamentary constituencies, and assembly constituencies. The proposed work involves extensive research and data analysis from various resources such as ECI Publication manuals, several websites, Wikipedia, among others. The collected data is then annotated using the specialized annotation tool called Prodigy. Subsequently, a customized NER model is built and trained using the annotated data. The performance of the developed model is thoroughly tested and analyzed. The results of this project indicate the successful generation of a dataset specifically tailored for the Indian election domain, achieving an accuracy rate of 68%. Additionally, a framework is established for the generation of similar datasets in the future. It combines data analysis, annotation techniques, and machine learning to create a robust NER model that can effectively recognize and categorize geo-political entities in Indian Election domain texts. The generated dataset and framework contribute to the advancement of natural language processing techniques in the context of political analysis.

articleTitle: Progressive Technology of InfraRed Spectroscopy for Characterization of Materials
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The scientific study is the interaction of electromagnetic waves (EM) with matter is referred to as spectroscopy. Sir William Herschel discovered infrared radiation in 1800. The name of IR spectrum has been given names after their interactions with the visible spectrum. IR spectroscopy gives peak on basis molecular arrangement. Only those molecules with a permanent dipole moment, like CO2, will exhibit an IR spectrum. IR spectroscopy is innovative way for distinguishing chemical properties of drugs and materials. IR spectroscopy is relevant to all areas of chemistry, research institutes and industries. The paper reviewed aimed to provide details regarding the history, concepts, and operational techniques of infrared spectroscopy, as well as the applications of infrared spectroscopy in various areas.

articleTitle: Image Multidiffusion Algorithms for AI Generative Art
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) research is becoming a growing trend as a result of recent improvements in machine learning. Development and grasping knowledge of art is perhaps the most subtle field of interest in the ongoing study of the “Human Vs AI” relationship. Several fascinating projects have grown up at the intersection of AI and art, but understanding and appreciating the beauty of art is still thought to be only human capacities. This paper discusses pertinent features and discoveries made by several scholars in the creation of AI art. Many scholars use GAN, but as this field of study continues to advance, many new techniques have emerged, including DALL-E, DALL-E 2, stable diffusion, multi-diffusion, DIFF EDIT, SEMSTYLE, LAFITE, and Mirror GAN. This demonstrates that there are numerous techniques for creating images, but the primary difficulty is deciding which technique is appropriate and used for text to image synthesis. So, we talked about some of the key techniques and their methodology. Three crucial techniques-DALL-E, stable diffusion, and GAN-that serve as the foundation for the creation of artificially intelligent art are discussed. Additionally, we talked about the way they work and fundamental design. Furthermore, there is also a section of the literature review that discusses the work, methodology, and restrictions of 8 researchers' models. These techniques significantly increase public interest in this subject. This paper concludes with highlights of some attractive application of the main theme in the current world.

articleTitle: Advancing Parkinson's Disease Detection: An Empirical Evaluation of Machine Learning Models Based on Speech Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a neurodegenerative disorder that adversely impacts a considerable portion of the population, especially senior citizens. Currently, the basis of PD diagnosis is clinical assessments, which can be costly, time-consuming, and invasive, that can be subjective or prone to errors. Dysarthria, a prevalent condition characterized by slow and distorted speech, often coexists with PD, presenting an opportunity to leverage speech features for diagnostic purposes. In this research paper, the altered speech features caused by Dysarthria are harnessed to train a diverse set of cutting-edge machine learning algorithms, including Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forests, and Decision Trees. A thorough examination of the latest advancements in the diagnosis of Parkinson's disease (PD) using speech analysis is provided. Additionally, a comparative analysis between the performance of a newly introduced classifier, HyperTab, and existing models is conducted. The findings reveal the remarkable promise of machine learning in speech-based PD diagnosis, paving the way for developing a cost-effective tool for accelerating disease detection. Moreover, this contribution is crucial in providing vital support to those areas with limited access to specialized medical facilities, significantly improving the quality of life and outcomes for PD patients in rural regions.

articleTitle: Role of Neural Network, Fuzzy, and loT in Integrating Artificial Intelligence as a Cyber Security System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The massive network of electronically connected devices that is referred to as the “Internet of Things” is the primary component of this system. These interconnected devices collect vital information that might have repercussions not only for the administration of the corporation, but also for society as a whole and the environment in general. The exponential growth of loT applications has corresponded with an increase in people's concerns over the privacy and security of their data When it comes to the most cutting-edge technological breakthroughs in the field of cybersecurity, artificial intelligence (AI) is now in the driver's seat at this point. AI is used to develop the complicated algorithms that are required to defend networks and systems, such as the gadgets that make up the Internet of Things (loT). As a consequence of this, having intelligent security solutions that are dependable, decentralized and readily available is more important than it has ever been. No matter how large the dataset is, the machine learning algorithm is unable to manage its diversity. This research takes a multi-layered approach to cybersecurity, which is necessary for protecting the TL of the Internet of Things (IoT), and it is one of the goals of this study. We recommended using a technique known as Elfers-Sugano Fuzzy and Trust-based Neural Networks (ESFTNN), which makes it possible to use three other approaches besides the one that is traditionally used in order to strike a healthy balance between the aforementioned factors. The Elfers Probability Sensing (EPS) Model is the first of its kind to take into account the extent to which any sensor connected to the Internet of Things is protected. By proportionately spreading data between nodes, Sugano Fuzzy Processing, which does not incorporate defuzzification, controls the amount of energy used.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis Of Machine Learning And Its Powered Technologies Applications In The Banking Sector
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Due to developments in machine learning (ML), banking and additional financial sectors will be capable to implement novel items and assistance and, more crucially, withstand disturbances to their client experiences. Without the assistance of fintech sectors, which employ cutting-edge technology to supplement or attempt to replace human professionals with complicated computations, the banking sector would battle to prosper in modern automated market. Banking and financial sectors must embrace ML and incorporate it into their business processes and duties in order to maintain a decisive advantage. By concentrating on some of the most fundamental and confusing business concerns in this area, this research project will examine the components of computerized smart settings in the banking and financial sector and the way they are swiftly emerging as an essential disruptor. The study additionally looked into the various ML-powered technologies and how they can affect financial transactions and functions. For the correct conclusion of the study's task, the research employed the instruments and strategies in this study to collect the evidence for the study. There are a variety of perspectives on ML's possibilities in this area, with the bulk focusing on the implications and importance it will possess on work in the financial and banking assistance sector.

articleTitle: Performance Boosting of Automatic Sun Following Panels Using Soft Computing Technique

Both alongside and despite the application of scaled variables, a clear proportionate integral then a liquid-based logical control mechanism was investigated and integrated within the photovoltaic function.

articleTitle: AI Driven E – Commerce Product Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: E-commerce is growing in today's world, and if you want to sell more to your customers and stay ahead of the competition, you need to keep up with online shopping trends and know what they want. In the past few years, the number of products available on shopping websites has grown by a huge amount. This leads to the problem of systems growing. Websites use a lot of data mining tools and suggestion systems, but users still might not get the best product for their search, which hurts the customer experience. Getting the search results as small as possible and combining goods from different websites can save time and improve the customer experience. Also, no shopping website has a way for customers to track prices and make predictions about them. With the help of web scraping and the Product Rank algorithm, our system tends to give customers rich and expensive goods from all shopping sites at the cheapest price of their choice without having to use human filters. With sales going up and income going up, we must also show how much we lost when we bargained with customers. Our proposed system tends to work like a smart web spider for all e-commerce sites. It scans every page for you and finds the most affordable, ideal-quality goods of your choice in actual time. This also makes sure that all e-commerce websites will be merged into a single, highly screened system. It can also make good suggestions based on what the customer wants and act as an involved player in the system. This tool can also help e-commerce companies because it can find dead pages, prices that the seller put in wrong, glitches, mistakes, and fraudulent activities on their websites in real time.

articleTitle: A Semi-Supervised Quantitative Inference Model for Accurate Breast Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Breast cancer poses a significant threat to women's lives, necessitating the development of effective detection and treatment methods. Accurately classifying tissue samples as benign or malignant is crucial for appropriate cancer diagnosis and treatment planning. However, utilizing data mining algorithms for this task is challenging. This study proposes a semi-supervised approach to develop a quantitative inference model for breast cancer tissues. The methodology involves the initial clustering of the dataset using the farthest-first clustering method, followed by the classification of clustered records. The performance of the proposed model is evaluated using a confusion matrix, utilizing the Wisconsin Original breast cancer dataset from the UCI Repository. Our results demonstrate that the proposed method achieves the highest accuracy, with a random forest accuracy of 98% and decision tree accuracy of 95.2%. These findings highlight the potential of our approach in improving breast cancer tissue classification accuracy, contributing to more effective diagnosis and treatment strategies.

articleTitle: Sports Event Data Acquisition Method Based on Wireless Sensor Technology and BP Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: By and large, tantamount games were pursued and accumulated by various gatherings in various regions of the planet, prompting the improvement of a great many ethnic sports. Rivalry results for competitors are impacted by a wide assortment of conditions.
