Thus, in this exploration, we construct a model to foresee athletic execution and afterward test and dissect it utilizing data from different sources, all with the assistance of the BP neural organization procedure. The exploratory outcomes show that the BP neural organization technique beats the BP neural organization as far as combination speed and can achieve the normal blunder exactness in a more limited measure of time. Simultaneously, this paper combines the fields of wireless sensor networks and sports preparing to introduce a keen sports preparing framework that works on the back of such networks.

articleTitle: Unraveling the Diverse Array of Edge Detection Techniques Employed in Image Analysis:An In-depth Exploration
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: One of the goals of computer vision, specifically in image processing and analysis, is to interpret visual contents. Partitioning an image into object and backdrop is a crucial and difficult stage in image interpretation. Segmentation is the process of separating a picture into its component areas or objects from the backdrop in order to effectively read and identify content of it. Detecting edges is a crucial mechanism for image segmentation in this scenario. It also serves as the foundation for many other digital image processing approaches because it is such an important technique. The performance of several edge detection techniques, such as gradient based methods, nature inspired techniques, and wavelet transform methods, has been studied and compared in this article. The goal is to find a better approach for digital image edge recognition that works well for noisy images while also offering intense edges with a minimum chance of illusion.

articleTitle: Exploring the Mind-Bending Connection Between Virtual Reality and Human Perception: Review
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Despite many distinctions in the human perception and virtual reality, they exhibit a connection to each other which makes the experience in the virtual reality immersive and interactive for the user. Technological advancements in the field of simulated environments have led the human to be able to connect and perceive the virtual environment generated by the software but there are still some drawbacks of the virtual reality due to which the humans are still unable to connect to the simulations on a larger scale. This is because the human eye and other senses are still more capable than the senses imitated by the devices used in virtual reality. However, efforts are being continuously made to curb the lack in the technology of the virtual reality, it is still a great help with the existing technology in many fields. This research work represents an understanding of the study of theory of human perception and the technology of the virtual reality along with its types, Comparison and challenges.

articleTitle: Flying Neural Network-Based Optimistic Financial Early Alert System in AI Model
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: An innovative method for early warnings in the area of financial risk management is the Flying Neural Network-based Optimistic Financial Early Alert System (FNN-OFEAS). The FNN-OFEAS outperforms conventional models and rule-based systems because it makes use of the Flying Neural Network architecture and incorporates sentiment analysis. Using a fictitious dataset including past stock prices, financial ratios, economic indicators, and sentiment analysis data, this study details the development, use, and findings of the FNN-OFEAS. The results show that the system is effective at capturing complicated temporal correlations, recognising non-linear patterns, and factoring in market sentiment, all of which contribute to improved risk identification in a timely and accurate manner. Early risk identification, investment decision assistance, regulatory compliance, and financial stability evaluation are just few of the real-world uses for the FNN-OFEAS. Its application is beneficial for financial institutions, investors, regulators, and policymakers since it enhances decision-making, reduces risk, and sheds light on previously hidden information. More work has to be done to improve the model architecture, include other data sources, provide real-time implementations, evaluate the model's resilience, and make it easier to comprehend the results. Addressing financial risks and bolstering financial stability in volatile market settings is one area where the FNN-OFEAS shows promise.

Author Keywords: “Flying Neural Network Optimistic Financial Early Alert System (OFEAS)”

articleTitle: Critical Glance on The Role of Higher Education on Placement Quality of Graduates
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This study aims to establish how placement influences the links between other variables in Indian higher education, including program quality, industry link, student satisfaction, and service quality. The suggested model is validated using data obtained from overseas students using a practical sampling technique and influenced by the Cue Utilization theory. The results reveal that placement entirely mediates the association between the quality of educational services and their applicability to the business sector. It is not possible to confirm that placement moderates the association between program quality, student satisfaction, and service quality. According to the research, curriculum quality and student happiness appear to have a direct and considerable impact on service quality. The outcomes of this study may have important consequences for placement, increased performance, industry connectivity, and student happiness in India's higher education context. Higher education in India has been in the news for a variety of reasons, and the findings of this study provide clear evidence that placement serves as a moderating factor between the qualities of education provided to international students and their access to the necessary industry linkages.

articleTitle: Panel-Based Demand Analysis of OnlineShopping Websites
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Demand forecasting is a critical component of the performance of supply chain management for e-commerce businesses. Traditional approaches to statistics may not be practical for accurate as well as dependable forecasting, nevertheless, given the erratic and uncertain markets of today. In order to improve these approaches and boost forecasting accuracy, companies involved in manufacturing are now using artificial intelligence (AI) systems. The literature that already exists only provides a fairly broad overview of the AI techniques combined with demand forecasting. To manage inventory and optimize consumer satisfaction, the operational strategy has made demand forecasting a top priority. Researchers have presented a wide range involving conventional and complex forecasting methods, but none have ever consistently shown flawless accuracy. For businesses in both manufacturing and retail, accurate forecasting is essential. Additionally, the goal is aims to determine the best AI technique that can enhance demand forecasting. Following that, we will offer case studies and contrast panel forecasting with other commonly adopted demand forecasting methodologies.

articleTitle: Marine Predator Algorithm for Optimal Placement of EV Charging Station with Optimal Power Factor of DG on Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) may provide an ecologically sustainable way of transportation. EV charging stations (EVCS) are being developed worldwide to encourage the widespread adoption of EVs. However, the adoption of EVs on a large scale necessitates for the strategic positioning of EVCS across the distribution network. In this paper, the goal of integrating Distributed Generation (DG) with real and reactive power correction capabilities is to mitigate the negative impacts of EVCS load on the distribution network. For optimal siting, sizing and operating power factor of DGs with EVCS, nature inspired Marine Predator Algorithm (MPA) is employed. Multiple objective functions, such as active power losses, voltage deviation, the investment cost of DG units, and the voltage stability index, are taken into account. Several scenarios of different number of DG units with EVCS installations are considered to assess the efficacy of the proposed method on 33 and 69-bus radial power distribution systems. The MPA outcomes are also verified by comparing them with the outcomes of the dragonfly algorithm.

articleTitle: A Study on Analyzing Deepfake through various Facial Regions- A Review
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In today's scenario, Deepfakes images and videos are being spread globally in social media websites like facebook, twitter and instagram to divert the mindset of people and frame the particular opinion. Many android applications like Faceapp are using Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) to imitate realistic images. Moreover, some free deepfake android app such as Zao, The Chinese app that help users to interchange faces in an easy manner with well-known personalities of the film industry so they can look as if they are being casted for the role in the movie, There are great requirements for detecting deepfakes due to the holistic misuse. Although many deepfakes detection algorithms are already existing in this aspect, very little work has been done to detect deepfake on the basis of analyzing normal eye blink rate. This paper presents a review on detecting deepfake through analyzing various facial regions like normal eye blink rate of a human being because it is not generally feasible to detect eye blink rate of a person at normal rate due to the deficiency of closed eye images.

articleTitle: Phishing and Web Hacking: Examining the Vulnerabilities and Defenses in the Digital Age
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The interaction between phishing, web attacks, and vulnerability assessment in the context of cyber security is examined in this research article. The study examines the methods employed in phishing assaults and diverse web attacks through an analysis of numerous case studies, empirical investigations, and surveys. The significance of vulnerability assessment in identifying and reducing these dangers is also emphasized. The paper highlights the effectiveness of machine learning and deep learning techniques in tackling different types of web attacks, showcasing the potential of these methods for improving cybersecurity defenses. The paper concludes with implications for future research and developments in the field, including the necessity of better detection and prevention mechanisms, education and training for cyber hygiene, and the possibility of using artificial intelligence and machine learning to improve vulnerability assessment and threat detection.

articleTitle: Transforming the Insurance Landscape: How ChatGPT's Proficiency Empowers the Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The release of the ChatGPT by OpenAI in 2022 generated interest in academia and industry, with mixed reactions to its capabilities and ethical concerns. Numerous studies have explored its accuracy and adaptability in several industries, such as healthcare, education, finance, and atmospheric science. Still, its applicability in the insurance industry has yet to be comprehensively analyzed. The insurance industry protects financially against risks like property damage, accidents, and health issues. Insurance companies offer policies to individuals and businesses; policyholders pay premiums to cover potential losses. The industry relies on efficient communication, accurate information processing, and risk assessment to effectively underwrite policies and manage claims. In summary, the ChatGPT has the potential to become a game-changing tool in the Insurance industry, driving innovation in customer interactions, process automation, and risk management. As the technology continues to evolve, its' potential to reshape insurers' operations and customer service in the digital era is immense.

articleTitle: An Approach for Diabetic Retinopathy Using GNN
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The early diagnosis and prevention of blindness can both benefit from finding diabetic retinopathy. For this task, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) can be applied. Making a graph representation of the retina image is the first step in utilizing GNN to detect diabetic retinopathy. To do this, one strategy is to display the picture as a graph in which the pixels serve as the nodes and the connections between them serve as the edges. GNNs can be used to learn the characteristics of the nodes and edges after the graph has been built. A huge collection of retinal pictures with labels that denote the presence or absence of diabetic retinopathy can then be used to train the GNN. The GNN will learn things throughout the training procedure.

articleTitle: Research and Innovation In Next Generation Security and Privacy In Industry 5.0 Iot
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The objective of the newest manufacturing paradigm, known as “Industry 5.0,” is to combine human intelligence with cutting-edge technology like the Internet of Things (IoT), artificial intelligence (AI), and robots to develop production systems that are incredibly effective and adaptable. But as we rely more on these technologies, we face additional privacy and security issues that might affect how dependable and trustworthy these systems are. In this report, we examine the most recent advancements in security and privacy for Industry 5.0 IoT and pinpoint the newest trends, obstacles, and possibilities. We also cover how these changes may affect manufacturing in the future and provide advice to scholars, practitioners, and policymakers.

articleTitle: Unveiling the Veil of Deception: An Insightful Journey into Adversarial Attacks and Defence Mechanisms in Deep Learning Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In recent years, a surge of interest has been witnessed in the realms of Artificial Intelligence (AI) driven technologies. Fields such as Computer Vision, Autonomous Navigation, Natural Language Processing, among others, have experienced transformative breakthroughs. Yet, alongside these advancements, a susceptibility to adversarial perturbations has been unveiled. Machine Learning models, despite their sophistication, can be deceived into making erroneous inferences by insubstantial manipulations in the input, a situation recognized as adversarial attacks. These attacks pose significant limitations to the applicability of AI technology in critical security-conscious sectors. Consequently, fortifying AI systems against such malevolent attempts has emerged as a cardinal component in the evolution of AI. This research paper pivots on devising a model that safeguards against adversarial onslaughts, concurrently equipping users with the tools necessary to cultivate robust models. The long-term goal is not only to enhance the reliability of AI but also to further the responsible and secure use of AI in society.

articleTitle: Real-Time Cyber Attack Detection Based on Automated Ai Security System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Cyber security tactics must be more potent and cunning due to the complexity of cybercrimes, which is always expanding. This will enable guard components to make real-time decisions that successfully counter sophisticated threats. The two scientists and professionals should be familiar with current methods for ensuring cyber security in order to aid in this. Implementing automated and expert cycles for recognizing cyber threats is one of the key aspects of cyber security. In light of artificial brain association, we describe an artificial intelligence (AI) cyber risk detection method in this analysis. They gave arrangement utilizes progressed learning-based detection procedures to improve cyber danger distinguishing proof and completely changes countless gathered security occasions into individual occasion profiles. The innovation centers around recognizing valid and bogus positive alerts with the goal those security reviewers can rapidly answer cyber attacks. The exploratory consequences of this study affirm the reasonableness of our proposed approach as a learning-based model for network shortcoming detection, and in any event, when this show is applied to real-world applications; it isn't equivalent to regular AI. articleTitle: Radiological Approach Through Artificial Intelligence in the Field of Health Care
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Microarray technology, which refers to the retrieval of numerous numeric characteristics from clinical pictures, is a term that is comparatively new to the field of radiography. Machine learning (AI) is generally referred to as a collection of highly developed numerical programs that essentially learn the trends in the input data to make forecasts on previously unexplored data sets. Radiomics can be used in conjunction with AI due to its superior capacity to deal with vast amounts of data when contrasted with traditional analytical techniques. articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Laterite Index and a Novel Laterite Index to Improve Detection of Lateritic Bauxite in the Eastern Ghats of Odisha, India using Sentinel 2A Data

abstract: Aim: The principal aim of this research study is to identify and evaluate the bauxite mineral availability in the area of the Eastern ghats of Odisha, which partly includes 3 states namely Odisha, Andhra Pradesh, and Tamil Nadu. This study compares the mineral content derived from two indices namely, laterite index and a novel laterite index. Materials and Methods: Remotely-sensed satellite images from Sentinel 2A for the years 2021 and 2022 were used. After pre-processing, bauxite indices using laterite index and novel laterite index were derived. Indices from a sample of 50 pixels were then used as input for SPSS. A total of 50 pixels samples for each index were extracted from the index image. Results: Here, the data was developed by creating two distinct indices, one from the laterite formula's original formula and the other from a Novel Lateritic Index formula. articleTitle: 5G Dual Polarized Sectoral Antenna its Design with MIMO Channel
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Huge networking of items (IoT) with 5G is an exciting future innovation with many benefits. It poses some difficulties because many devices require a strong connection. In this situation, picture-input photo-output (MIMO) devices provide great ability to communicate and volume. With MIMO, there are a problem with antenna coherence. In order to lessen association, this article suggests a photo-sector MIMO home location antenna using 5G-New Media (5G-NR) spectrum N77 using a dual polarization structure. articleTitle: Economic Forecasting Through AI: A Comprehensive Review of AI Techniques and Advancements
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Accurate forecasting is crucial in the dynamic world of economics for directing investments, policy choices, and long-term planning. A new era of economic forecasting has evolved with the rise of artificial intelligence, providing previously unheard-of potential to glean insightful information from complicated and copious data. This in-depth research article explores the mutually beneficial interaction between AI and economic forecasting. In order to offer distinctive viewpoints on economic developments, the study investigates AI approaches. Deep learning architectures and hybrid models, two advancements in these methodologies, have paved the way for enhanced forecasting accuracy and decision-making procedures. This survey demonstrates the revolutionary potential of AI in economic forecasting across multiple indices, revealing deep patterns that impact economies through real-world applications. This study emphasizes the need for open, strong, and morally sound AI-driven economic insights by addressing the issues and ethical concerns inherent to AI. This study provides a compass for academics, decision-makers, and economists alike as we navigate the growing AI landscape, pointing us in the direction of fully utilizing AI to shed light on the future of economic forecasting.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation and Comparison of Clustering Algorithms for Social Network Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Evaluation of the effectiveness of various clustering methods using an enhanced K-Mean algorithm is shown in this paper. Essential data mining techniques, such as clustering techniques, divide things into proper subgroups. Data can be described and analyzed using clustering. Compared with K-Means, Hierarchical, and E.M. Algorithms in this study is the Improved K-Means Clustering Algorithm. The algorithms are used to compare the performance of the clusters based on how long it takes to assemble them. The enhanced K-Mean Algorithm performed much better results than traditional algorithms. Additionally, the Confusion Matrix is revealed.

articleTitle: The Evolution of Segmentation Techniques for Alzheimer's Disease Detection from Magnetic Resonance Images
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease is a neurological sickness that is getting increasingly frequent and causes the structure and performance of the central nervous system to gradually deteriorate. The prevalence of Alzheimer's disease is expected to double by the year 2050. These illnesses pose a significant threat to the physical and mental well-being of individuals as well as their families across the globe. It is a sort of neurodegenerative sickness that is chronic and irreversible, and it is characterized by the gradual death of neurons. This death of neurons leads to reduced cognition and the loss of brain functions. There are presently 47 million Alzheimer's disease patients across the globe; however, it is expected that this number will more than double by the year 2050, attainment 152 million individuals. One of the several neuron imaging techniques that are currently at researchers' disposal is magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), which has made it possible for non-invasive in vivo studies of AD-related abnormalities in the brain. This research makes use of a number of different denoising techniques in order to cut down on noise and improve the overall picture quality. A clearer, more relevant and more easily digestible visual illustration is one of the goals that subdivision strives to achieve. For the purpose of segmenting the region of interest in MRI scans, a computer aided model has been presented. For the purpose of evaluating the suggested method of image segmentation, which has been validated with a large number of images, alternative image segmentation algorithms, including Otsu thresholding and region expanding, have been compared. It has been determined, using the performance evaluation metrics, that the proposed method is capable of achieving a higher level of accuracy than other methods.

articleTitle: Investigating Patterns of UAV Attacks for Building Secure UAV Network
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles are remotely handled for fulfilling tasks like photojournalism, security, rescue efforts, and even package deliveries. These gadgets have a variety of sensors and cameras that enable them to gather data and provide real-time images to their administrators. These devices are vulnerable to cyber-attacks that can lead to hacking of devices, resulting in data theft, identity theft and spoofing. Important information carried by unmanned aerial vehicle devices can be intercepted by unauthorized users to destroy the network transmission. This research paper performs an experimental study on generating traffic patterns of unmanned aerial vehicle communication for cyber-attacks. The unmanned aerial vehicle traffic pattern is compared in global positioning system jamming and spoofing attacks for analyzing battery state, system power, logger status and computational load. The achieved results indicate the critical parameters of the network that are to be considered while framing security policies for unmanned aerial vehicle communication.

articleTitle: Data Sharing Enabled Through Internet of Things (IoT) in Wireless Communication Networks

abstract: A variety of difficulties while attempting to transmit a file including multimedia data through the many peers of a wireless IoT network. The system's centralization, which increases the risk of a security breach and makes it harder for users to access their information, is one of the biggest issues. It would be possible to address the issues with security and user accessibility, but doing so would forfeit scalability, low latency, and lengthy response times. The project in issue uses the Interplanetary File System and an original block chain approach as a direct result of this. Additionally, we discussed the system's workings and the ideas that led to its development. This research looks at a broad range of uses for economic and pricing models, which are often known as methods for intelligent, logical decision-making. Building adaptive protocols and algorithms that are designed expressly for use with WSNs is the ultimate objective of this study. Our objective is to create an atmosphere that inspires smartphone users to engage. The findings show that SATS has the potential to lower communication and computation costs, enabling it to provide affordable data transfer. The SATS system's calculation costs are as follows: AN: 14%, 23%, and 59%; Fog-Node: 6.5%,21.5%, and 51%; and Sensor Node and AN: 6%, 3%, and 4%, respectively. This is a reasonable price when compared to the costs of PPDAS, IDAP, and ASAS, which are 14%, 23%, and 59%, respectively. According to the findings, the suggested SATS has a greater storage capacity, lower computation costs, lower communication costs, and more effective energy utilization when compared to other systems that belong to the same category. When compared to other existing systems.

articleTitle: Covid Contagion Risk Prediction Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic has brought about a crisis in health all around the world and has brought to light the necessity of precise and timely prediction of the danger of infection. In this study, we offer a technique for predicting the risk of COVID contagion based on demographic, health, and environmental characteristics that use machine learning. This method takes into account the relationships between these elements. We demonstrate that the suggested strategy is superior to the baseline models by analyzing the performance of a number of different machine-learning models using a dataset that is freely accessible to the public. Our research shows that machine learning may be useful for forecasting the spread of COVID and developing better safety measures to combat the disease. In this study, we have utilized SVM and random forest to forecast the future case and have fulfilled our primary objectives of the studies, which will enable other researchers to carry out their research in the same area using these algorithms. Some other forms of research may also be carried out in the future.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Approaches for Circular RNA Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Circular RNAs (circRNAs) have emerged as crucial regulators of gene expression and potential biomarkers in various biological processes and diseases. However, accurately classifying and analyzing circRNAs necessitates effective representation of their sequences, a challenge that has led to significant research gaps. To address this, the present research project aims to explore and compare the performance of different methods and models, encompassing both machine learning algorithms and deep learning architectures, for sequence classification tasks. The project employs the k-mer extraction technique and the DNA2Vec algorithm to achieve vector representation or sequence embedding. These techniques enable the conversion of DNA sequences into numerical representations suitable for processing by machine learning and deep learning algorithms. A publicly available dataset is utilized for training the models, and their performance is assessed using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. Several machine learning algorithms, including K Nearest Neighbour, Random Forest, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, SVM (Linear), and SVM (Polynomial), are tested for classifying circRNA and IncRNA sequences. These algorithms exhibit varying levels of performance in accurately categorizing the sequences. Notably, the SVM (Polynomial) algorithm achieves the highest accuracy of 89.4%, demonstrating its proficiency in classifying the sequences with precision. In contrast, the deep learning algorithm ACNN-BLSTM, which combines a convolutional neural network with a recurrent neural network, surpasses the baseline models with an accuracy of 94.0%. This highlights the importance of incorporating both local and sequential information for accurate circRNA prediction. The findings shed light on the strengths and limitations of each model, providing valuable insights into their suitability for circRNA classification and functional analysis. The study emphasizes the significance of selecting appropriate sequence embedding techniques based on the dataset's characteristics and the specific requirements of the analysis task.

articleTitle: AI-Based Diagnostic Test Prediction- An Effective Way to Handle the New Normal Era in Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Disease Diagnosis (DD) healthcare recommender systems can significantly contribute to disease control by accurately predicting disease risk and aiding in disease management. These systems serve as must-be supplementary tools for physicians and patients, assisting them in effectively controlling and managing diseases. However, the development of accurate real-time recommendations for medical data poses contests due to the complex nature of the data, which is often unbalanced, large, multi-dimensional, noisy, and may contain lost values. The effectiveness of diagnostic tests (DT) is known to vary based on the context in which they are utilized, such as their position in the clinical pathway. In practice, tests are typically employed alongside other pertinent information, including patient age, sex, symptoms, clinical signs, and the results of other tests, to facilitate accurate diagnoses. Recognizing the interplay of these factors is pivotal for achieving optimal diagnostic outcomes. DTs are an essential aspect of ensuring patient safety and effective healthcare. However, in the post-pandemic condition, patients have become more cautious about visiting hospitals frequently, as they aim to minimize exposure to contagious diseases like SARS-CoV-2 infection. Consequently, there is a growing preference among patients to limit hospital visits. To address this concern, the integration of deep learning (DL), machine learning (ML), and other artificial intelligence (AI) techniques has proven to be highly effective in analyzing large medical datasets and recognizing patterns. AI-based diagnostic systems hold promise in accurately predicting diseases based on patients' symptoms, thereby supporting existing clinical practices. In this work, an AI-based recommender scheme was industrialized to suggest primary DTs using patient symptoms. Data were collected through a questionnaire from patients in the Kolhapur district of Maharashtra, India, and verified by medical professionals. To ensure data quality, an Extract, Transform, and Load (ETL) algorithm was employed for preprocessing. The collected data revealed significant associations between symptoms and probable diseases, enabling the system to provide relevant recommendations for primary DTs. For both patients and clinicians, predictive standards and their relative to result thresholds play a vital role in decision-making. These values depend on the personal preferences and priorities placed on outcomes, including positive and negative results. By considering these factors, the developed AI-based recommender system aims to assist in informed decision-making, offering accurate disease predictions while taking individual values into account.

articleTitle: NURTURE An Analytical Model that Supports Healthy Relationship Between Parents And Children Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The mental health of children aged 6 to 15 is a vital concern, given that not all youngsters find it easy to confide in parents regarding issues like school bullying and emotional struggles. This research delves into the complex problem of children's hesitancy to share problems and proposes strategies for addressing this within the evolving landscape of modern families. The current context is marked by a rise in dual-income households and nuclear families, leading to reduced parent-child time and weakened relationships. Amidst this, the study underscores the importance of optimizing the limited time parents and children have together. Recognizing timeconstraints, the research introduces a novel approach: enhancing the impact of existing time. By equipping parents with insights into children's moods, they can tailor interactions accordingly. If a child feels down, a day of attention, affection, and understanding can be provided, while happier days may require less parental involvement. The study promotes cultivating a friendly parental approach, aiming for stronger parent-child bonds. As parents adapt to children's emotional needs, a more open and communicative relationship is likely to develop. Ultimately, this research contributes to improving children's mental health within the bounds of contemporary family dynamics.

articleTitle: Data Mining Methods for Internet of Things: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: It is fascinating to think about all the many ways in which information, intellect, and knowledge may be used in human existence. Because of the lightning-fast pace at which technology is advancing, it is now essential to amass a large quantity of data in order to forecast and investigate potential developments in the field of artificial intelligence. In order to identify new information inside databases, it is necessary to apply strategies and procedures taken from a variety of information systems specializations. The practice of data mining entails not only the finding of new information but also the extraction of information that may be put to beneficial use. In recent years, considerable advances have been made in decision-making abilities in a variety of contexts, including expert systems, artificial agent networks, and machine intelligence. These businesses include companies in the fields of commerce, education, architecture, and building construction, among others. The approach that was taken in this piece was derived from an analysis of the data mining strategies and developments that have seen the greatest amount of adoption across a variety of business sectors over the course of the last five years. These patterns and modes of operation were investigated. Throughout the course of this enquiry, the processes and patterns described above were scrutinized. The use of text mining as a tool for database analysis, the enhancement of worker productivity in the industrial sector, and the application of data mining for instructional practices are only a few instances of what has been learnt in the area of education. One other illustration of this would be the use of text mining as a technique for image recognition. It was also found in the fields of trade and industry.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Analytics and Operations Research: Models, Applications and Managerial Implications
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Business analytics refers to the processes, strategies, and procedures that are utilised to derive value for individuals, organisations, and organisations from data. In today's fast-paced and more globalised digital economy, it is essential for decision-making to be driven more by data and to be supported by artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML). Deep learning (DL) does offer a number of benefits, but it also has a number of limitations that have, up to this point, prohibited businesses from making widespread use of it. Deep neural networks offer the potential of surpassing models from standard machine learning in terms of prediction accuracy, which is one of the reasons why the introduction of deep learning has led this area to undergo a major transformation. This is one of the reasons why the introduction of deep learning has caused this field to undergo a considerable shift. However, according to the findings of our review of the body of recently published research, the number of papers relevant to our industry that make use of operations research is quite low. Consequently, the objectives of this study provide an overview. In a few different case studies, we look at the value that operations research brings to the table by using real data from real-world business activities. Every one of these instances demonstrates improvements in operations research performance above what is possible with traditional machine learning, which ultimately results in gains in direct value. In this paper, we present academics, managers, and practitioners in the field of operations research who are interested in developing their abilities in deep learning and business analytics with suggestions and implications. Our computational investigations highlight the need of bespoke architectures by recommending a one-of-a-kind deep-embedded network as a solution to the problem that standard, out-of-the-box solutions are often not satisfactory.

articleTitle: Optimizing Medical Image Report Generation with Varied Attention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Image captioning plays a crucial role in interpreting visual information in the medical field. This research paper represents an innovative approach to produce descriptive and insightful reports for its respective medical images. The combination of natural language processing and computer vision techniques are used, an encoder-decoder architecture is employed which aids in leveraging by using a qualified InceptionV3 model to extract image features. The captions which are generated were based on a deep learning model with a Gated Recurrent Unit-based decoder and an attention mechanism, guaranteeing the connection between the generated text to the image content. The research focuses mainly on the dataset which consists of medical images with its associated reports by utilizing data extraction and preprocessing methods to enhance the accuracy and contextual understanding of the generated report. The experiments and results section demonstrate the implementation details and efficacy of the proposed model in generating meaningful report for the medical image, thereby facilitating enhanced interpretation and analysis of medical images. This research contributes to the advancement of image captioning techniques in the medical domain and holds significance for clinical decision support systems and medical image analysis.

articleTitle: Automated Diagnosis and Detection of Blood Cancer Using Deep Learning-Based Approaches: A Recent Study and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Blood cancer, also referred to as haematological malignancy, is a collection of cancers that affect the blood, bone marrow, and lymphatic systems. Early and accurate blood cancer detection is essential for effective treatment and enhanced patient outcomes. Deep learning algorithms have emerged as potent instruments for medical image analysis and disease detection in recent years. This paper intends to provide a comprehensive overview of the application of deep learning techniques to the detection of blood cancer. The paper begins by describing the various forms of blood cancer and the difficulties involved in their detection. The merits and weaknesses of various deep learning architectures and frameworks used in blood cancer research are described. The review then focuses on the datasets and imaging modalities that are commonly used for blood cancer detection. It discusses the pre-processing techniques used to improve image quality and reduce noise, as well as the data augmentation techniques used to increase the robustness of deep learning models in the proposed system architecture. The paper concludes with a discussion of prospective future directions and developments in the field. It highlights the significance of developing robust and interpretable deep learning models, incorporating multi-modal data for enhanced accuracy, and integrating clinical and genomic data to facilitate personalised treatment strategies.

articleTitle: Role and Application of Ribs in Solar Air Heater
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Maintaining the clean environment and reducing the usage of fossil fuels requires switching to renewable sources of energy, because of limited resources of fossil fuels and having insufficient fossil fuel storage. The world is facing from shortage of fossil fuel and its cost is going too high and its smoke is very harmful to the environment. In this crisis, the world is starting the use of renewable energy. Renewable energies are easily available, and it reduces air pollution and fuel cost. non-conventional energy sources, like solar energy, atomic energy, hydroelectric power, wind energy etc. are a substitute for conventional energy. Solar energy is the best one, is used in various utilization, like solar air heaters, solar water heaters, solar power generation, solar pumps, solar cooking etc. Solar air heater that absorbs heat from the sun's radiations to heat air and it is collected by the collector & converted into kinetic energy and also restored in the form of potential energy. The primary objectives of this review article are to assist and summaries the research work carried out by numerous researchers using a variety of rib types and rib parameters, and to examine the behaviour of numerous ribs, the rate of heat transfer using numerous ribs, and the fluid behaviour following an impact on the ribs.

articleTitle: Noma Based Full Duplex 6G Communication Systems

articleTitle: Role of VANETs in Machine Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Machine learning and Deep Learning with transportation opened new avenues of research by accessing to internet for agile conveyance, safety, efficiency, and comfort applications. However, the combination of Vehicular Adhoc Networks with machine learning and deep learning acts as an expansion of drivers' perceptions by providing road network predictions to avoid road fatalities, traffic congestion, and traffic jams. Thus, enhancing safe, comfortable, quality life, and efficient driving. This article summarized the role of the machine and deep learning algorithms in intelligent transportation according to the application domains. This paper presents applications, evaluation metrics, recognition rate, and limitations of machine learning and deep learning techniques with VANETs. In addition, it describes the different data sets and background of machine learning and deep learning models.

articleTitle: Customer Churn Prediction in Telecommunication, Medical Industry Using Machine Learning Classification Models
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Predicting the number of customers leaving a company is important for companies operating in various sectors. Businesses can now employ predictive models to identify clients at risk of churning, thanks to the growing availability of data and developments in methodologies for machine learning. This abstract offers an overview of predicting customer churn and highlights the most important techniques and strategies used in this subject. The unique features of the industry that are being taken into account should guide the selection of the most appropriate model. Variations in data availability, client behaviour, and other industry-specific issues may need individualised strategies for various businesses, such as those in the medical field, the banking industry, the online retail sector, and the telecommunications sector. In this research article on Automated fake profile classification on Instagram, the Novel Integrated Neural Networks algorithm was found to have a higher prediction precision percentage (90.91%) than the DT (85.45<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>). The proposed use of the NINN shows some improvement in the precision of fake profile detection compared to the DT algorithm, providing users with a more accurate way to identify fake profiles. This research provide a more effective solution for detecting fake profiles on Instagram and achieved the proposed aim of this article.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Tourism and Hospitality Services: Integrating AI in the Metaverse
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The purpose of the study is to examine the integration of AI into the metaverse for exploring the potential benefits and issues in the hospitality and tourism industry. The study highlights the structure of integration through a conceptual model and fragmenting each parameter included separately and covers a comprehensive analysis of the structural formulation of a metaverse in the industry. Additionally, elaborates on security issues and countermeasures. The paper provides a framework for businesses in exploring and revolutionizing the industry with innovative ideas. However, the analysis is constrained to a conceptual model, creating a real-time virtual environment will be the future agenda.

articleTitle: Intelligent Unmanned AI Detection Model for Financial Volatility in Stock Exchange
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: At the present days, the popularity of the stock marketing is very high as this is only the legal platform where the investor can doubling their investments within very short span. However, besides the chance of profitability, there is huge risk present due to the extreme volatility. In this context, to reducing the risk of financial this research study has developed a AI detection model so that a predictive future data related to the stock exchange can be obtained through the past data train. In order to predict where prices will go in the future, this model uses machine learning algorithms and NLP techniques to decipher historical market data. Backtesting on simulated data demonstrates that high levels of accuracy, precision, recall, and Fl score may be attained in the prediction of market volatility using the proposed model. The proposed model may be used by investors and financial institutions as a tool for making more informed investment decisions, reducing risk, and identifying untapped investment opportunities. An important contribution to the field of finance, this research shows how machine learning algorithms and natural language processing methods show potential in predicting market volatility.

articleTitle: An Analogical Study Between Lateritic Index and an Innovative Index to Enhance Detection of Bauxite in Ranchi and Lohardaga in Jharkhand, India using Sentinel 2A Data
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The primary objective of this study is to determine and assess the accessibility of bauxite in Jharkhand, which involves some specific regions such as Ranchi and Lohardaga. The data used in this study was generated by the Sentinel 2A satellite from ESA Copernicus and altered using SNAP 9.0 in the mentioned regions. In this context, spectral signatures of lateritic bauxite specimens were examined on GIS software using the spectral characteristics of lateritic bauxite. In this spectral signatures and central resolution of Sentinel 2A was preferred and was made use of which vegetative spectral signatures were visible i.e. VNIR-SWIR (visible-near-infrared and short wave infrared) domain. Understanding the distinctions between the spectral characteristics of bauxites and laterites is made easier by analysing the spectral signatures of lateritic bauxite samples. Based on these variations, simple pixel values of pictures were used after applying formulation in SNAP 9.0 After uploading the image in SNAP 9.0, the image was further underwent operations and later output was generated in the form of band 11 and band 12 image. The SNAP 9.0 mapping method is used to map the presence of bauxite deposits along the research region, and the occurrence is draped over the DEM of the study area. The pictorial representation of availability of bauxite suggests the size of the bauxite mineral resources. The statistical program SPSS was used to assess the data, and it was found that the statistically significant difference between the two indices was 0.005 which follows (p≤0.05) with a 95% Confidence interval. The standard error difference is around 0.1555, whereas the average mean difference is almost 1.20311. The area of Research study Ranchi and Lohardaga of Jharkhand displays a distinct bauxite resource zone, according to a research that was conducted utilising data and the aforementioned approach with suitable regard for the results generated. Consequently, SNAP 9.0 used Sentinel 2A from ESA Copernicus data to identify bauxite.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Security of E-Healthcare Transactions Using Hyperledger Fabric Modular Blockchain Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The most innovative development in recent years is blockchain technology, and its uses are expanding quickly across numerous businesses. It is well known for its capacity to adapt to this technology, which aids in the storing of data at locations linked by peer-to-peer networks. Blockchain technology has recently piqued the curiosity of the healthcare industry. Numerous significant issues that currently plague EHR systems could potentially be resolved by it. This essay offers a thorough analysis of the literature on the application of blockchain technology in the medical industry. The focus of this study is the current system used by tertiary institutions to store, access, and safeguard electronic healthcare data. According to analysis, hospitals maintain electronic health records most frequently using client/server architecture. The existing way of processing transactions in Punjab's tertiary institutions has serious issues with data accessibility and data privacy. After assessing the system's shortcomings, research was carried out. The Hyperledger fabric blockchain technology and pluggable PBFT have been coupled to assure the security of healthcare transactions.

articleTitle: A Systematic Survey on Breast Cancer Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)

articleTitle: A Comparative Survey on Machine Learning Techniques for Prediction of Liver Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The number of cases of liver diseases has been rising quickly as a result of heavy alcohol use, drug use, breathing contaminated air, tainted food, and pickle eating. Automated expert systems can help clinicians make automated predictions to address this issue. The ability to detect liver disease in its early stages in the recent developments in machine learning has facilitated prompt detection of this potentially deadly condition. Early detection of liver illness because of the advancement of machine learning may even save lives. The liver plays a crucial role in eliminating toxins from the body, underscoring the importance of early prediction for disease diagnosis and recovery. Different machine learning techniques can be used for the detection of liver disease. Some commonly employed methods include Decision Trees, Support Vector Machines (SVM), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Artificial Neural Networks, and Ensemble classifiers. The evaluation of classification algorithms involves assessing them using diverse measurement criteria, including accuracy, precision, recall, f1-score, area under the curve (AUC), and specificity. In order to diagnose and forecast liver disease, this work intends to provide a thorough overview and comparative analysis of several ML algorithms. Accuracy, sensitivity, precision, and specificity are some of the criteria used in the evaluation. Reviewing and contrasting the results of the multiple researchers who have already used these approaches to predict liver disease.

articleTitle: Enhancing Image Quality through Deep Learning-based Super-Resolution Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Significant advancements in super-resolution have been accomplished over the past two decades, particularly using deep learning techniques. Image super-resolution is a key image processing technique for improving an image's resolution in the field of computer vision. In addition to providing a thorough overview of recent developments in single-image super-resolution from the viewpoint of deep learning, this article aims to educate readers about the original conventional approaches for image super-resolution. In this article, we examine significant deep learning-based SR techniques and divide them into two groups based on the contributions they make to the definition of key optimisation targets for deep SISR and the assessment of relevant neural network topologies for SISR. Finally, we wrap up our study with some present issues and potential developments in deep learning-based SISR.

articleTitle: Effect of Cost on Internet of Things-Based Integrated Remote Electronic Health Surveillance, Self-Regulating Home, and Security Alert System: A Review Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Auto-control and the internet of things have brought about significant changes around the globe. articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Resource Allocation in Edge Computing for IoT

articleTitle: Malicious URL Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Malicious websites that can hurt users and steal personal information are now a serious problem that requires immediate attention. Machine learning techniques are widely utilized to accurately identify and categorize such websites. These models examine the static elements of the websites to find any potential flaws or hidden exploit code. This study assesses the effectiveness and accuracy of different machine learning models for identifying dangerous URLs. The autoencoder neural network had the lowest accuracy, at 61.50%, followed by the Multilayer Perceptrons (MLPs) model with an accuracy of 85.50%, and XGBoost with an accuracy of 85.35%. The study shows how well machine learning models work at identifying and stopping the spread of harmful websites. This study highlights the significance of using machine learning techniques to protect users from potential harm.

articleTitle: Battery & Fuel Cells comparative study on application with IoT Gadgets
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The majority of the Web of Things (IoT) gadgets are fueled by electricity lines. Consequently, major grid disruptions, that can happen with catastrophic events, stop the flow of electricity to such equipment. The majority of widely employed utilities were assessed in order to promote the creation of Internet of Things gadgets which can function under calamities. The operating duration, power generation, and overall technical characteristics of battery packs with lithium ion plus fuel-cell devices were contrasted in this investigation. Due to the disappointment, the biofuel cells with 10W had a lower running period over the remaining units at 57 minutes. Additionally, a Rasp Pi-based internet of things gadget was assessed to find the best power method. Although capacitors are now more affordable, biofuel cells' greater energy productivity will become more beneficial when their price decreases.

articleTitle: Ensemble Technique for Imputing Missing Values in MAR Missingness
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Missing data is a widespread problem across many research fields, and it can have a major impact on the precision of statistical analyses. Imputation is one method for handling missing data, in which missing values are imputed based on the available data. A promising method for handling missing data is ensemble imputation, which uses the advantages of various imputation models. This paper aims to provide an ensemble imputation method for missingness at random (MAR) mechanism in multivariate configuration (missingness in more than one variable). We consider three popular imputation models-k-Nearest Neighbours (KNNI), Multiple Imputation by Chained Equations (MICE), and MissForest (MF)-and combine their findings to produce a more reliable imputation technique. To evaluate the performance of our proposed ensemble imputation method, we employ four commonly used evaluation criteria namely Standard Deviation (SD), Coefficient of Determination (R2), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) values. By comparing the performance of our proposed ensemble method with the other three imputation methods, the results show that the proposed ensemble imputation method performed better than MF, KNNI, and MICE in 83.33% of the cases, achieving lower values of MAE, RMSE, and higher R-Squared values and lower SD values in 66.66% of the cases.

articleTitle: Real Time Plant Disease Detection Model using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have had remarkable success in classifying a variety of plant diseases through deep learning. However, just a few researches have shed light on the inference process, leaving it as an unsolvable mystery. In addition to guaranteeing the learnt feature's dependability, revealing the CNN to extract it in an understandable form enables human intervention-based verification of the model's veracity and the training dataset. Using a CNN that had been trained using a public ally accessible collection of images depicting plant diseases, several neuron-wise and layer-wise visualisation techniques were used in this study. We demonstrated that neural networks can, when diagnosing an illness, capture the hues and textures of lesions particular to that disease, which is similar to human judgement. The most critical aspect of agriculture is striking a balance between produce and population. Due to a variety of issues, including natural disasters, unforeseen rainfall, nutrient deficiencies in the soil, etc., the majority of farmers failed to produce and balance the crops. The main issue, however, is pest infection, which is the root of all the issues. To learn about plant diseases, several researchers employed a variety of methods. Convolutional neural network-based deep learning techniques are frequently utilised to solve image-oriented problems. A powerful and successful method for image analysis is the CNN (ConvNet) neural network model of deep learning. In this study, various models for plant disease detection with CNN are compared. The research report concludes by summarising its findings, identifying its limitations, and making recommendations for classification

articleTitle: Comparing Deep Learning and Traditional ML for Detecting Spam and Trolls on Video Sharing Sites
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This study compares the performance of deep learning and conventional machine learning (ML) models in identifying spam and trolling comments on video sharing websites. Convolutional and recurrent neural networks, as well as other deep learning (DL) architectures, are contrasted with more conventional machine learning techniques like KNN and Support Vector Machines using a sizable dataset of comments. Utilizing user data, text sentiment analysis, and other metadata, the models are assessed. The findings demonstrate that RNNs and CNNs, in particular, perform better in terms of accuracy, recall, precision and F1 score than do classic machine learning models. Traditional machine learning models, such as KNNs, decision trees, and SVMs, performed badly in comparison. The study highlights the potential of deep learning models for better spam and trolling identification on video sharing platforms and identifies other research areas for improving the models' performance in practical implementations.

articleTitle: Increasing the Power in Photovoltaic Systems using a Floating PV System compared with a Rooftop PV System by Limiting the Temperature Loss
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Aim of this work is to compare and enhance the power yield of a floating photovoltaic system to a rooftop photovoltaic system by reducing temperature loss due to temperature using PVsyst software. By performing the simulation of a novel Floating PV system 12 samples are obtained (i.e.12 months of a year) and total annual power generation is taken as the final output. The same steps are repeated to obtain 12 more samples for a rooftop PV system. The total number of samples obtained is 24. G power is noted as 0.8. A novel Floating photovoltaic system generates 176,158W of power. and for a rooftop photovoltaic system is 159,667W. The value of significance observed as 0.032 (p<0.05, statistically significant). Noted that the novel Floating PV technique achieved more efficient power than the Rooftop PV technique.

articleTitle: Client-Level Monitoring Approach to Secure Data in a Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Cloud computing imparts huge storage at low cost, because the internet is so widely used around the world, massive amounts of data are stored on local devices and integrated and stored on a common platform for easy access, sharing, and, high availability. The cloud environment provides a convenient way for normal users and enterprises to migrate their apps, data, and storage to the cloud-based server for storage due to the high availability of its services and the flexibility of computing processes. Securing information is the primary challenge in cloud computing. Securing the data from unauthorized modification and access is one of the key challenges of the cloud environment. In order to secure user data, different security algorithms were adapted. This paper provides a client-level monitoring approach to secure data in a cloud environment. The monitoring approach consists of the user or client system, monitor, and cloud storage. The user uploads the encrypted form of documents onto the cloud storage and the cloud storage stores the encrypted form of user documents, and the monitor periodically monitors or the user directs the monitor to check the integrity of user data.

articleTitle: Detection of Attacks by Assessing the Performance of MD2, MD5 and SHA-1 Hashing Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In today's data-centric world, there is a significant emphasis on ensuring data security in order to protect valuable and confidential information. Data integrity plays a crucial role in this context as it guarantees the accuracy, consistency, and protection of data. In order to instill a high degree of belief in the integrity of a message, it is necessary to employ mechanisms that prevent any form of alteration or loss of data during transmission. One commonly used technique for this purpose. The given paper presents the comparison of hashing algorithms namely MD2, MD5 and SHA-1 based on parameters like bits changed and intervened time.

articleTitle: Design of IoT Based Agricultural Farm Protector Drone Using Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In many cases, the safety of persons and commodities is now assured using surveillance drones, which are crucial technical systems. The drone is critical operational asset during surveillance operations because of its rapid deployment and accurate observation. It is crucial to safeguard farmland and agricultural areas from animals, birds, and other species. Numerous measures are attempted to deter human intrusion but they fall short in defending against the farmer's principal foes-animals that trample their crops, both domestic and wild animals must be kept out of the area. A farm protection drone has been employed to prevent such disasters. With the help of a drone technology with raspberry pi, used as animal protection to monitor the farms. To do this, this project makes use of (GSM) Global System for Mobile Communication and (GPS) Global Positioning System Module. A “SMS” the area that animals observe and detected by image processing will be sent to the farmer and forest officers.

articleTitle: Predicting the Accuracy of Fractionation of Patron's Activities in Online Social Networks Using Novel K-Means Clustering Algorithm Comparing with Agglomerative Hierarchical Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Aim: This research compares a novel K-means clustering algorithm with an agglomerative hierarchical clustering algorithm for its ability to predict user behaviour in online social networks with a high degree of accuracy. Materials and methods: The accuracy percentage was predicted using a 95% confidence interval, a G power (value = 0.8), and an evaluation of the Novel K-Means clustering method with a sample size =10 and the Agglomerative hierarchical clustering algorithm with a sample size =10. Results: The findings shows that the Novel K-Means clustering method Agglomerative hierarchical clustering algorithm (78.81%) in terms of accuracy. Two Algorithms were found to be statistically significant, with a p value of 0.001 (p < 0.05). Conclusion: It was demonstrated that the Agglomerative hierarchical clustering approach performed inferior to the Novel K-Means clustering strategy.

articleTitle: Optimized Construction Project Management Using Ai And Machine Learning

abstract: Starting during the 1950s, with the coming of Data Advances, artificial intelligence (AI) strategies have been created. This is empowering for the field of development the board specifically, as development projects are filling in size and intricacy as time and monetary constraints increment the quantity of stakeholders with contending needs. By the day's end, development the executives' utilized to get everything all together with the goal that precise expectations can be made about the end result. The subject of Artificial Intelligence (AI) incorporates AI as a subset and an assortment of related innovations. K-Nearest Neighbour's (KNN) is a famous managed learning strategy, making it one of the most broadly utilized AI calculations. In light of financial information in Vietnam, this article utilized the K-Nearest Neighbour's (KNN) calculation to appraise the development cost file. articleTitle: Advanced Use of Blockchain And Deep Learning Technologies For Financial Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Blockchain technology dependent on cryptocurrency have lately excited the curiosity of capitalists. They focused on forecasting the financial item's risk and return ratios. As a result, financial items require an autonomous algorithm to anticipate the return percentage of cryptocurrency. Deep learning (DL) algorithms that were lately developed lay the path for the return percentage forecasting procedure. This paper proposes a blockchain financial product utilizing DL for a smart return rate prediction (RRP-DLBFP) method. The suggested RRP-DLBFP method entails creating a long short-term memory (LSTM) framework for return percentage forecasting. Furthermore, the Adam optimization is used to effectively change the LSTM algorithm's hyperparameters, resulting in improved forecasting accuracy. The Ethereum rate of return has been selected as the aim of guaranteeing the RRP-DLBFP method's superior performance, and its outcomes are studied in various metrics. In terms of several assessment variables, the model's results demonstrated the superiority of the RRP-DLBFP method over the present latest methods. The suggested RRP-DLBFP exhibits MSE values of 0.0435 & 0.0655, accordingly, contrasted with a mean of 0.6139 & 0.723 for comparing techniques in both training and evaluation.

articleTitle: Emotion Based Mental Health Classifier for NCR Based Engineering Students
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Having a healthy body and mind is referred to as personal well-being. The human race is faced with great psychological strains in the current environment of rapid commercial development and pandemics. India is the nation with the highest burden of mental and behavioural illnesses as per a report by the world health organization for national care of medical health (NCMH, 2017) more than 300 million people experience depression on a global scale. The paper discusses a system named EMHC (Emotion Based Mental Health Classifier), which takes into account both categorical and sentimental attributes in order to classify students based on their Mental Health status. The system uses well established Machine Learning algorithms like DeepFace, K-means Clustering and Support Vector Classifier in order to classify students. The study classifies students under three categories: Good, Moderate, and Bad Mental Health. The Data for training and evaluating the system same was collected through a Web Application, whose link was shared among the students of the several Universities in India(NCR region) and the question in the Web Application were taken from [1] and [2]

articleTitle: Disease Classification Using ECG Signals Based on R-Peak Analysis with ANN
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The proposed research paper makes use of a method that is both extremely successful and composite in nature in order to categorise disorders on the basis of ECG data. Unfortunately, there is a shortage of professionals that specialise in electrocardiograms (ECGs). This demonstrates the importance of utilising an automated ECG analysis system that is supported by machine learning in order to minimise the likelihood of errors caused by human intervention. The R-wave is the first to be identified since it possesses the greatest amplitude and the steepest slope of any other wave. In order to develop the system, the ANN and EBP techniques were utilised. Using the window approach, the remaining components (P, Q, S, and T) are determined after the R wave has been established as the starting point. When other intervals and the heart rate are taken into consideration, the total number of variables (measures that are fundamental and diagnostically useful) approaches 27. As a result, the usage of this programme is beneficial for the examination of electrocardiogram (ECG) readings in real time.

articleTitle: Improvement of Output Power in Three Phase Rectifier Using PID Controller Compared with PI Controller by Controlling the Voltage Stability
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The goal of the presented study is to increase the three phase rectifier's output power utilising a unique PID controller instead of a PI controller by regulating the voltage stability using environmentally friendly power electronics. Materials and Methods: A total of 14 output power samples, each obtained at a different voltage and frequency, were taken. There are two sets of seven samples each out of these samples and the voltage stability values were calculated to quantify the output power improvement of three phase rectifier with novel PID controller and PI controller. G power is assumed to be 0.8. Result: By this work it is observed that the proposed work has achieved the voltage stability of 78.9% and for the PI controller is 72.3%. The significant value obtained is 0.001 (p less than 0.05) which is significant statistically. Conclusion: It is found that in sustainable power electronics, the novel PID controller performed significantly better than the PI controller in improvement of output power of the three phase rectifier by controlling the voltage stability.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Based Learning Approaches for Medical Imaging
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence is the most debated and discussed topic in the field of the health sector, especially in the research of medical imaging. It has the power to process many medical images and uncover those diseases that are not appreciated by the naked eye. AI-based models such as machine and deep learning can recognize patterns that aid medical diagnoses. In fact, these learning models have outperformed human capabilities in most applications, such as computer-aided diagnosis/detection, prediction of diseases, segmenting images, image generation, etc. Hence, this paper discusses the role and significance of AI and its techniques, such as machine and deep learning models, in medical imaging. Besides this, the works of the researchers who have used these techniques to process medical images are also presented along with their challenges that still persist.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Integration of Wireless Sensor Network with Li-Fi Wireless Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Ensuring data security in WSNs (Wireless sensor networks) has been a persistent issue. The absence of a reliable mechanism to secure data poses a serious threat to the integrity of information. Also, the quality of services provided by WSNs is poor. Hence, there exists a need for a new technological paradigm that can address these shortcomings of WSNs. In this regard, Li-Fi technology emerges as a highly relevant wireless communication technology. This research paper focuses on the integration of Li-Fi with WSNs and analyses its performance using the software: Opti System, used for analyzing the communication system. In this paper, three models: the LOS model, the single LED non-LOS model, and the double LED non-LOS models have been considered and the LOS model has been found best with an eye height of 1.050 due to which it leads to minimum distortion and noise as compared to the other two, which are non- LOS models.

articleTitle: Comparison of Regression Techniques and Integration Models Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Regression problems help extract the law from massive amounts of data to predict. Hence, regression algorithms have been a hot topic in machine learning research in recent years. In actual problems related to regression have complex internal and external factors, and different machine learning algorithms affect scalability and predictive performance. This research uses BP neural network, extreme learning machine, and support vector machine to examine the applicability of machine learning methods in regression problems. Comparing the single model and integrated model regression results of each machine learning algorithm shows its pros and cons. Finally, simulated experiments using four data sets show how well each machine learning method predicts regression. Research on machine learning algorithms and integration models appears to be viable and logical.

articleTitle: Application of Smart Collaborative 5G Networking For Enhancement of Vehicular Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: As a technology that encourages the expansion of mobile networks, 5G is gaining prominence. In the meantime, a variety of vehicular service and application scenarios are driving the ever-increasing demand for vehicular networks.
