A new building plan can move toward expanding data transmission and further developing dependability for vehicular correspondences by addressing the benefits of 5G for vehicular organizations. The developments of a novel and commonsense 5G-empowered shrewd cooperative vehicular organization (SCVN) design are the focal point of this article, which depends on our drawn out examination and practice in this field. SCVN considers portable situations for vehicular organizations notwithstanding the different specialized qualities of a 5G organization. In order to evaluate the architecture's efficacy, we have carried out extensive experiments in a variety of settings, including driving high-density vehicles at low or high speed across dense cells. SCVN outperforms its rivals in terms of throughput, dependability, and handover latency, as demonstrated by real-world experiments.

articleTitle: Covid-19 Impact on Mental Health: Sentiment Analysis Using NLTK
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Artificial intelligence has been described as the new electricity. The belief is that it will profoundly influence many fields and education is one of them. There are various ways where AI in education can bring a revolution benefiting students, teachers, and other stakeholders. Sentiment analysis of a student is one of the feathers of AI which helps determine a student's mental state – which is an important aspect in measuring the student's wellness with increasing competition and pressure. Hence, it is tried to attempt to study the mental condition of students during this pandemic of covid -19 using this NLP (natural language processing) based technique of sentiment analysis. A high-level classification library of Python -NLTK is used for this purpose. The dataset is collected from the student community about their thoughts during these difficult times and analyzed and represented in various interactive visual and graphical formats on the web application built by employing the FLASK framework.

articleTitle: A Voting Enabled Predictive Approach for Hate Speech Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In today's digital environment, hate speech, which is defined as disparaging and discriminating communication based on personal characteristics, presents a big difficulty. Hate crimes and the rising amount of such content on social media platforms are two examples of how it is having an impact. Large volumes of textual data require manual analysis and categorization, which is tedious and subject to prejudice. Machine learning (ML) technologies have the ability to automate hate speech identification with increased objectivity and accuracy in order to overcome these constraints. This article intends to give a comparative analysis of various ML models for the identification of hate speech. The proliferation of such content online and its negative repercussions on people and society are explored, as is the necessity for automated hate speech recognition. This paper intends to support the creation of efficient hate speech detection systems by performing a comparative analysis of ML models. Random forest records the best performance with higher accuracy and low response delay period for hate speech detection. The results will help enhance automated text classification algorithms and, in the end, promote a safer and more welcoming online environment by illuminating the benefits and drawbacks of various approaches.

articleTitle: AI-enabled Crop Health Monitoring and Nutrient Management in Smart Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence (AI) has paved the way for transformative applications in various fields, and agriculture is no exception. In this research paper, we explore the integration of AI technologies in smart agriculture to enhance crop health monitoring and nutrient management. By leveraging AI algorithms and techniques, we aim to improve the efficiency and sustainability of farming practices. The paper delves into the utilization of AI for early detection of crop diseases and pests, as well as the development of predictive models for precise nutrient management. Remote sensing and imaging technologies play a crucial role in real-time monitoring, allowing for informed decision-making. Through a series of case studies and evaluations, we demonstrate the effectiveness and potential benefits of AI-enabled crop health monitoring and nutrient management in modern agriculture. Despite the promising results, challenges and limitations are discussed, and future directions for research and application are suggested.

articleTitle: Vision-Based Snake Species Classification System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Snakes are limbless reptile animals that are more than 3000 species in the world specifically living in the forest. Identifying a snake just by looking at the picture or an actual snake is a difficult task if a person is not a herpetologist or specialist. This paper presents feature fusion of Haralick features, LBP and Color Histogram. Classify the snake species based on its visual features extracted from a dataset of snake images consisting of almost 1000 venomous and 715 non-venomous snake species. In proposed model after evaluation of SVM, RF, KNN, DT classifier. SVM classifier provides more accuracy compared with random forest, KNN, and Decision Tree with accuracy of 90%.

articleTitle: Accurate Recasting of Giant Text into Charts Using Rapid Automatic Keyword Extraction Algorithm in Comparison with Bag of Words Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Aim: For contrasting the accuracy of understandability between the techniques Novel Rapid Automatic Keyword Extraction (RAKE) and BOW (Bag Of Words) in the NLP (Natural Language Processing) utilizing the corpus Donald trumph speeches for building squarified charts from big text, that is the central goal. Materials and Methods: After pulling off key phrases from the huge content in a document, the rate of accuracy is evaluated. The accuracy rate evaluated based upon the quantity of similar key phrases in Novel RAKE and BOW compared with manual allotted key phrases. The key phrases grabbing done utilizing the Novel RAKE and BOW with sample sizes each 28 in the NLP (Natural Language Processing) resulting in G-power value 80%. Results: The Novel Rapid Automatic Keyword Extraction (RAKE) shows a larger rate of accuracy of 73.04% than the BOW (Bag Of Words) of 69.04% in gathering key phrases from a text file. This indicates that there is no statistically significant difference between the Novel RAKE algorithm and the BOW method with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{p}=0.333(\mathrm{p} > 0.05)$</tex>. Conclusion: The Novel RAKE has a larger rate of prediction accuracy of 73.04% when distinguished with the rate of prediction accuracy of 69.04% in BOW and subset of parameters or attributes in the marginal distribution.

articleTitle: Exploring the Frontier of Technological Progress in Plant Biotechnology
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Innovative solutions to major issues in agriculture and sustainability are now available because of the fusion of bio-inspired computing and plant biotechnology. This study examines how genetic algorithms and neural networks, two bio-inspired technologies, can be used to improve crop qualities, forecast plant responses, and manage crops more effectively. We demonstrate their potential influence on developing plant biotechnology by discussing their benefits and applications to conventional approaches. We showcase effective implementations, ranging from better planting schedules to creating disease-resistant crops. Its capabilities are further enhanced by combining omics and phenotyping technologies with bio-inspired computing. We discuss issues including data integration difficulties and moral concerns with regard to genetically modified creatures. Computer scientists and biotechnologists will be able to work together thanks to this multidisciplinary approach. In summary, we can conclude that combining bio-inspired computing with plant biotechnology has the potential to advance sustainable agriculture. This combination offers a crucial step toward resilient food systems and environmental stewardship as we move toward precision farming.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence's Effects on Corporate Decision-Making Processes
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: With the introduction of artificial intellectual ability life choice machine learning, how has decision-changed? The predictability of the judgement state space, communication resources of the life choice procedure and result, size of the unconventional set, life choice rate, and representativeness are five key plans in place factors in this blog entry as the peculiarities of human and Machine learning strategic planning. The paper develops a novel paradigm describing why both modalities of judgement may be merged to best benefit the level of company judgement call upon an examination of individual and Digital taking decisions or something along those parameters. Three major categories-full human to AI outsourcing, mixed mortal and Cognitive technologies sequence strategic planning, and merged decision-making between humans and AI- are presented by the structure as ways in which party members' choices can be coupled with AI-based judgments.

articleTitle: Exploratory Application of Deep Learning in Pharmaceutical Drug Discovery
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The most common way of finding and growing new meds is extensive, tangled, and exceptionally factor. For issues with clear details and enough of excellent information, the stockpile of apparatuses given by machine learning (ML) procedures is priceless. Machine learning can be involved anytime in the drug-discovery process. Clinical preliminary models incorporate objective approval, prognostic biomarker discovery, and computerized pathology information investigation. It also includes viral cells treated with various pharmacological mixes that were not part of our model development process but were used to validate it. In specifically, we built our model using a creative fountain move learning approach. The likelihood (proportionally, viability) scores generated by the SoftMax layer during the assessment cycle allow us to rank potential medications and analyze their observable performance. Utilizing this technique, we had the option to distinguish many drugs with high viability scores that show helpful commitment for the treatment of Coronavirus. Predictable with those distributed in the writing and those meds endorsed by the FDA or going through clinical examinations and preclinical preliminaries, GS-441S24 and Remdesivir were the most encouraging atoms. This examination exhibits how deep learning might assist find atoms with guarantee, which could accelerate responses to future pandemics.

articleTitle: High Utility Pattern Mining: A Comprehensive Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: High-utility pattern mining, the process of searching highly relevant patterns in databases. Pattern mining has gained popularity as a study area due to its many appliance in fields like bioinformatics, text mining, product recommendation, e-learning, and web click stream analysis. Effective decision- making requires high utility patterns, and demand for these patterns has grown recently. By classifying HUPM algorithms into a wide taxonomy, current comprehensive survey offers a overall, broad and strategic summary of advanced approaches in UPM. With a discussion of their benefits and disadvantages, a detailed analysis of current high-utility pattern mining techniques is offered. The study also covers current issues and practical difficulties in this field.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Image Compression for Efficient Wireless Communication in IOT
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This abstract emphasizes the transformative potential of deep learning-based image compression techniques as a solution to these issues and a way of allowing efficient wireless communication within IoT networks. The exploratory outcomes show that the recreated calculation outflanks the Key Part Investigation (PCA), Discrete Cosine Change, and Quick Fourier Change (FFT) on factor pressure proportions while utilizing the Terrific St-Bernard metrological dataset. The mimicked calculation has a lower root mean square blunder (RMSE) and a higher coefficient of assurance (R 2) esteem. Also, while utilizing the LUCE metrological dataset, it showed lower RMSE and higher-pressure proportion values on factor blunder limits contrasted with the Lightweight Worldly Pressure (LTC) procedure. It was consequently shown that the mimicked approach gives preferable pressure devotion over the customary procedures without a mistake bound system.

articleTitle: Cloud Cryptography: A Cutting-Edge Method to Protect Your Cloud
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Cloud computing has revolutionized the way data is stored, processed, and accessed. However, it also introduces new security challenges, making the protection of sensitive data a top priority for cloud service providers and users. Cryptographic techniques play a crucial role in ensuring data security in cloud computing environments. This abstract presents a study that investigates various cryptographic techniques employed to safeguard data in the cloud. This research aims to analyze different cryptographic techniques used in cloud computing, focusing on their effectiveness, performance, and suitability for different cloud deployment models. The study encompasses both symmetric and asymmetric encryption algorithms. The comparative analysis includes popular symmetric key algorithms such as Advanced Encryption Standard (AES), Data Encryption Standard (DES), Triple DES, Twofish and Blowfish, as well as widely adopted asymmetric key algorithms such as RSA.

articleTitle: A System Based on AI and M1 Enhanced to Investigate Physiological Markers for User Forecasting Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: By creating an explicatory AI report for stress prediction using wearable sensors, we fill this gap in our work. We based the explanatory AI's appearance and feel on a typical blood test report because medical professionals and patients are probably familiar with theseUsing physiological data, we provide in this study a novel, comprehensible AI technique for stress prediction. Users and medical professionals may decide which biological characteristics, in addition to any anomalies connected to health, have the greatest influence on the prediction of stress based on the report. Both quantitative and qualitative indicators were used to assess the usefulness of the study on explainable AI. It was demonstrated that the stress prediction accuracy was on par with modern standards. There was shown to be a correlation between the ratios of the individual physiological indicators used to make the stress prediction and the actual results. A qualitative survey with psychiatrists was also conducted in addition to these quantitative evaluations to further bolster the credibility and efficacy of the AI system's explanatory report on the stress. Additional explanatory elements pertaining to the patient's various emotional states, such as melancholy, relaxation, anxiety, or happiness, will be added in future study.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Theft Detection For Women Handbags
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In this paper, we are providing handbag security against theft by detecting suspicious and unauthorized activities using Passive infrared (PIR) sensors. Nowadays, the IoT is used in many fields and has a vital role in automating the application. PIR is an electronic sensor that helps in detecting motion, with the help of IR(Infrared) radiation. This principle is used to detect strange or suspicious access in our Handbag. The PIR sensor detects the motion and on successful detection, the integrated Camera gets switched on automatically. Then a set of five pictures are clicked and stored in the memory. Once any kind of suspicious activity is detected a loud alarm, which will also be integrated into our project, beeps. To maintain the practical use of this project we are installing an ON and OFF switch, which will be purely manual, and the user will have to switch it ON when he/she enters a crowded place. To make this project more efficient, GPS will be installed in the handbag to always receive location updates of the handbag. As a future development, further optimization can be done to make the smart handbag very portable and handier.

articleTitle: Securing Smart Contracts against Re-entrancy Attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: With cryptocurrencies, blockchain technology has revolutionized the financial industry, but its potential for decentralization extends far beyond finance. Blockchain is now being integrated with a wide range of emerging internet technologies, including the Internet of Things (IoI’), artificial intelligence (AI), and cloud computing. When combined with these technologies, Blockchain has the potential to overcome known flaws like scalability and energy consumption, making it more streamlined, efficient, and suitable for internet decentralization. Blockchain, for example, can provide secure data storage and sharing for IoT devices, preventing data breaches and unauthorized access. Furthermore, the transparency and immutability of Blockchain make it ideal for use in supply chain management, where it can enable transparency and accountability throughout the entire supply chain. Blockchain can also be used in conjunction with artificial intelligence to create decentralized, secure marketplaces for data sharing and storage, thereby preventing data monopolies and promoting fair competition.

articleTitle: Unleashing the Power of Big Data: A Comprehensive Analysis and Future Directions
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Big Data (BD) has emerged as a transformative force, offering unprecedented opportunities for organizations to extract valuable insights and drive informed decision-making. This research paper presents a comprehensive analysis of the current state of BD, explores its potential applications across industries, and outlines future directions for maximizing its benefits. This paper examines the key components of BD, including data collection, storage, processing, and analytics. It investigates the technologies and methodologies that enable efficient handling of large volumes of structured and unstructured data. Additionally, it explores the impact of cloud computing, artificial intelligence (AI), and the Internet of Things (IoT) on the growth and utilization of BD. Overall, this research paper provides a comprehensive analysis of BD, its current applications, challenges, and future directions. It serves as a valuable resource for researchers, practitioners, and policymakers seeking to unlock the full power of BD and harness its benefits across diverse domains.

articleTitle: Determining Average Error of Flank Wear in Turning Duplex Stainless Steel Using Canny's Edge Detection Algorithm in Comparison with Fuzzy Logic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: To obtain the average error of flank wear in turning Duplex Stainless Steel (DSS) using Canny's Edge Detection Algorithm and compare it with Fuzzy Logic Algorithm. The average error accuracy of flank wear is computed for Canny's Edge Detection Algorithm and Fuzzy Logic Algorithm separately and are categorized into Group 1 and Group 2 respectively, each consisting of 27 samples, providing a total sample size of 54. It was computed using clinicalc.com with an enrollment ratio of one, an alpha error of 0.05, a G-power of 80%, and a confidence interval of 95%. The average error accuracy determined using the Novel Canny's Edge Detection Algorithm (92.78<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) is more accurate and statistically significant than the Fuzzy Logic Algorithm (88.91 %) and the significance value obtained is p = 0.000 (p<0.05). The proposed Novel Canny's Edge Detection Algorithm is significantly better at predicting flank wear and the average error accuracy than the Fuzzy Logic Algorithm.

articleTitle: Anomaly Detection in Chest X-Ray Images using Variational Autoencoder
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The identification of anomalies holds significant importance across various domains, including finance, healthcare, and cybersecurity. Recently, deep learning techniques, such as autoencoders and variational autoencoders (VAEs), have emerged as promising approaches for anomaly detection. In this particular investigation, we employed a VAE to detect abnormalities in chest X-ray images and differentiate them from normal images. To train the VAE, a custom loss function was employed, combining reconstruction loss and KL divergence loss, using a dataset consisting solely of normal images. Anomalies were identified based on the presence of a high reconstruction error. The outcomes demonstrate that the VAE algorithm exhibits the capability to identify abnormal patterns and separate them into distinct distributions for normal and anomalous data.

articleTitle: Detecting Brain Tumor Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Brain tumor represent some of the most difficult diseases to cure in modern medicine. An exact and prompt detection of a brain tumor is required for proper analysis. Deep learning advances can help radiologists diagnose tumours without resorting to risky therapies. Deep learning is now the most demanding technology for assisting medical researchers by boosting MRI image interpretation and training speed and accuracy. The purpose of this research is to recognise brain tumor with a suggested approach based on CNN architecture. The experimental findings show that the suggested CNN model obtained 98.98% accuracy after running numerous tests with different random states and batch sizes.

articleTitle: Comparing TensorFlow.js and TensorFlow in Python: An Accessibility and Usage Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: TensorFlow, a popular machine learning library released by Google, has gained significant traction among developers in creating ML models. It provides support for both Python and JavaScript, with TensorFlow.js, the JavaScript version. This paper presents a comparative analysis of these frameworks, focusing on accessibility factors like ease of learning, available content and tutorials, minimum required knowledge, and hardware requirements. The study highlights that TensorFlow for Python offers a comprehensive suite of tools and abundant resources, making it a robust choice for experienced developers. Tensorflow.js, on the other hand, stands out for its beginner-friendly characteristics. The research findings show that Tensorflow.js is very easy to deploy on the web and is capable of handling graphic intensive models (like face recognition using camera) on entry-level computers as well. This study looks at the advantages and disadvantages of TensorFlow in Python and TensorFlow.js in order to help new programmers choose the best tool for their machine learning projects.

articleTitle: Fortifying IoT Against Quantum Threats: Strategies for Securing Connected Devices in the Quantum Era
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: All data sent to and from IOT devices, (as well as any data held), must be encrypted in order to enhance the security of IOT devices. At the moment, elliptic curve cryptosystems (ECCs) are used as fundamental building blocks to secure communication in the Internet of Things. Yet, forthcoming quantum computers can quickly compromise public key systems like ECC. We should take action right away to get the IOT ready for the quantum future due to recent developments in quantum computing. This paper at first will give a brief overview on Crystal - Kyber, SIKE and BIKE algorithm which are among the NIST's third round candidate. Then the comparison of these three on the basis of key size, computational power and memory requirement. Finally a recommendation on the most suitable algorithm for making IoT secure in quantum world.

articleTitle: Conventional Neural Network for Maths Handwritten Digit Categorization
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Handwritten digit recognition plays a crucial role in various sectors such as document processing, automatic form identification, and postal automation. This task involves accurately identifying and classifying handwritten digits into their respective numerical values. This presentation provides a summary of current developments in machine learning techniques for handwritten digit recognition. The primary objective of this research is to develop an advanced system for recognizing handwritten digits by harnessing state-of-the-art machine learning techniques. To train and test the suggested system, a sizable dataset of handwritten digits is used. We are utilizing the MNIST dataset here. To improve the quality of the input pictures and guarantee uniform feature representation, preprocessing techniques like image enhancement and normalization are used. Experimental results indicate that the CNN model surpasses all other investigated techniques in accuracy, boasting an impressive accuracy rate of over 98%. The capacity of the CNN model to automatically deduce pertinent characteristics from the input pictures, catching both local and global patterns, is credited with its better performance. Additionally, the model can successfully handle spatial relationships in the digit pictures because to CNNs' usage of convolutional layers. A number of practical applications, such as computerized form processing, digital document analysis, and intelligent character recognition, are possible with the suggested handwritten digit recognition system. The CNN model's high accuracy enables accurate digit categorization, enhancing efficiency and accuracy across a variety of applications. Future research can concentrate on investigating ensemble approaches, data augmentation methods, and fine-tuning techniques to improve the handwritten digit recognition system's performance even further.

articleTitle: TSM: A Cloud Computing Task Scheduling Model
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Cloud offers online-based runtime computing services through virtualized resources, ensuring scalability and efficient resource utilization on demand. Resource allocation in the dynamic cloud environment poses challenges for providers due to fluctuating user demand and resource availability. Cloud service providers must dynamically and economically allocate substantial resources among dispersed users worldwide. Users, in turn, expect reliable and cost-effective computing services, requiring the establishment of Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Resource distribution uncertainty arises in view of the dynamicity of the cloud, where VMs, memory capacity requirement, processing power, and networking are allocated to user applications using virtualization technology. Resource allocation strategies must address issues such as insufficient provisioning, scarcity, competition, resources fragmentation. CPU scheduler plays a crucial role in task completion, by selecting job from queue considering specific requirements. The Task Scheduling Model (TSM) algorithm improves scheduling by considering expected execution time, standard deviation, and resource completion time, aiming to address resource imbalances and task waiting times. The research discusses previous work, presents experimental findings, describes the experimental setup and results, and concludes with future research directions.

articleTitle: Prediction of the Variation in Price of Bitcoin Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This paper presents an approach for predicting the price of Bitcoin using machine learning techniques. We used historical data of Bitcoin prices and extracted relevant features such as trading volume, social media sentiment, and market capitalization to train and test the models. Numerous machine learning algorithms, such as random forest, gradient boosting, and neural networks, were tested by us and evaluated their performance using metrics such as mean squared error and accuracy. Our results show that machine learning models can effectively predict the price of Bitcoin with a reasonable degree of accuracy. We also discuss the limitations of our approach and suggest future research directions to improve the performance of Bitcoin price prediction models. Our findings suggest that machine learning can be a useful tool for investors and traders in making informed decisions about Bitcoin investments.

articleTitle: Smart Agriculture: A Comprehensive and Analytical Survey
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The development of various technologies has been beneficial, to varying degrees, for the many different kinds of businesses that exist today. Several other industries, including the agricultural sector, have benefited from implementing technology based on the Internet of Things (IoT) in crop production. Consequently, the following review paper has attempted to present the influence that the Internet of Things technology has had on the development of intelligent agriculture. This paper will review intelligent agricultural systems using the Internet of Things. These systems were developed in recent years. To arrive at these conclusions, the research paper has discussed several aspects of intelligent agriculture and the benefits of technology based on the Internet of Things. In addition, a review paper was presented in which the Internet of Things (IoT) technology was broken down into its parts in great detail. Several particulars hamper the application, including the high cost, energy consumption, and the current knowledge gap. In addition, the solutions to the problems are simultaneously and coherently; the use of secondary qualitative methods has made it simpler to discuss the requirements of smart agriculture. The information presented in the paper reflects concrete knowledge regarding the application of IoT systems in intelligent agriculture.

articleTitle: Detection of Stress Over Social Interactions Using Machine Learning and Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In the field of natural language processing, the investigation of stress is turning out to be increasingly critical. The advancement of recommender frameworks and computerized emotional well-being assessments can profit from the investigation of stress discovery for psychological wellness expectation, as per earlier examination. In this study, we enhance sentiment and emotion analysis to measure the stress levels of people by analyzing their social networking posts and comments. Using machine learning techniques and the deep learning sentiment analysis model BERT, we analyze sentiment using enormous datasets of tweets. We also used an unsupervised machine learning technique called Latent Dirichlet Allocation to scan a set of papers to find word and phrase patterns and create word groups and related phrases that most accurately represented the documents. This aids in predicting the subject that is connected to the textual information. We will be able to identify users' emotions online with the help of these models. Additionally, stress or depression can be studied using these feelings. In summary, the BERT model and ML models have very high detection rates. The benefits of this research can be shown in terms of mental wellness.

articleTitle: Prediction of Human Misbehavior Detection From CCTV Video Recording Using Convolutional Neural Network Compared With VGG-16 Method
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In contrast to the Visual Geometry Group (VGG-16) technique, this study uses a novel implementation of Novel Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm to increase the accuracy of human misbehavior detection in real-time Closed-Circuit Television(CCTV) footage. Materials and Methods: A total of 3200 samples used for this research is obtained from Kaggle database. The Kaggle database system served as the source for the research dataset used in this study.The study utilized G-power analysis with 80% power,alpha rate of 0.05 results in 20 iterations for each group with total iterations as 40. The clincalc tool was used to determine the total number of iterations N equals 40 (20 iterations for each group). In G-power analysis the power utilized was 80%, alpha rate was 0.05 and the sample size was 3200(for 2 groups). CNN and VGG-16, both with the same amount of data samples (N=10), are used to perform the prediction of an individual's misbehavior, with CNN achieving a better accuracy rate. Results: The proposed CNN achieves a 97.25 percent success rate compared to the VGG-16 classifier's 90.30 percent success rate. This represents a significant difference. The significance level of the investigation was determined to be p=0.001(p<0.05) which is significant statistically. Conclusion: Suggested CNN model significantly obtains a greater rate of accuracy than the VGG-16 model when it comes to the prediction of human misbehavior in real-time surveillance video.

articleTitle: A Rectangular Dual-Band (30/60 GHz) Patch Antenna with Rectangular Slots and Parasitic Structure for Ka-Band and V-Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This research article deals with the design and analysis of a dual-band Electromagnetic Wave modified microstrip antenna radiating EM energy. The proposed antenna is designed using a 0.254 mm thick Rogers RT/Duroid 5880 substrate with dimensions 6.2 × 7.4 × 0.254 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>and a relative permittivity of 2.2. The copper patch is inscribed at a precise location of x = 0.8mm, y = 1.585mm, z = 0.289mm on the substrate with a feedline connecting it to the port. The overall dimensions of the patch are 3.64 × 4.23 × 0.034 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. Performance enhancement of the antenna is done with the help of an H-shaped slot made on the ground and a rectangular parasitic structure with rectangular slots on the patch. The antenna is designed, analyzed, and examined on Ansys HFSS(High-Frequency Structure Simulator) Software. The dual peaks of the proposed antenna are centered at 29.84GHz (Ka-Band) and 60.27GHz (V-Band), with a peak return loss of −39.47dB and −37.90dB, respectively. At 30GHz and 60GHz, the return losses obtained are −17.49dB and −27.26dB, respectively and can be deployed in 5G infrastructure. The antenna is operational in K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</inf>-band, making it beneficial for high-speed satellite communications, including broadband. The antenna also operates in the V-Band, which makes it suitable for high-speed wireless communication and short-range point-to-point links. This paper provides a comprehensive discussion of the design evolution of the proposed antenna, including a list of enhancement techniques used and their impact on the return loss.

Author Keywords: an H-shaped slot on the ground

articleTitle: Exploring the Potential of AI for Urban Crime Prediction in India: A Case Study of Indian Metropolitan Cities
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Urban crime prediction is of major interest to police departments and criminologists. This study focuses on the prediction of urban crime for 4 Indian cities (Surat, Delhi, Bangalore, Kolkata). Prediction is made for the total IPC crime rate for selected cities using the time period of 2001 to 2020. Here we have used a novel approach for prediction which uses the neural network time series application of MATLAB. This application has a nonlinear autoregressive tool that solves non-linear time series problems. So, this method can be referred to as NARNN (Nonlinear Autoregressive Neural Network). This method is compared with two classical methods of time-series forecasting (Linear regression, ARIMA). The results of the NARNN gave the highest accuracy for all 4 cities. It gave an accuracy of up to 98% for crime prediction in Delhi. When the crime rate is non-linear or doesn't have any significant trend ANN is strongly recommended. ARIMA is reasonably good when data have trends, while the use of linear regression for prediction is completely impractical.

articleTitle: Cancer Detection with Ensemble Learning Model from Novel Precedence based Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Cancer is a complex disease with many distinct forms. Because to its importance in patient care, early cancer research has made prompt identification and management of a cancer type a necessity. When it comes to medical applications, machine learning excels, especially when complicated biochemical and genomics data are involved. As a direct consequence of this, ML is routinely used in the process of diagnosing and detecting cancer. In this paper, the authors proposing a cancer prediction using machine learning algorithms with precedence levels for detection of cervical cancer and breast cancer. After training the basic models, we used ranking-based techniques to forecast final accuracy. The proposed framework is demonstrated by experimental results on two datasets and achieved good accuracy rate for cancer detection.

articleTitle: Improve the Accuracy for Flight Ticket Prediction using XGBRegressor Optimizer in Comparison with Extra TreeRegressor Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The important aspect of this study is to improve the accuracy for air transport Flight Ticket Prediction using Novel XGBRegressor Optimizer and Referred with Extra TreeRegressor Performance. We compare a Novel XGBRegressor Optimizer algorithm with the ExtraTree Regressor algorithm to enhance the system's accuracy. We use 40 sample sets for the comparison. The Novel XGBRegressor Optimizer algorithm is a new method that applies gradient boosting to optimize the parameters of the XGBRegressor model. The ExtraTree Regressor algorithm is a variant of the random forest algorithm that uses extremely randomized trees to reduce the variance of the predictions. Initialized Novel XGBRegressor is used for training the model. This helps to improve the execution of the system overall. Hence, the accuracy of the prediction is enhanced by the NXGBRegressor algorithm as it uses the best parameters during the prediction. ClinCalc software is used as aid to calculate the correctness of the setup under supervised learning. The alpha value is considered as 0.05, G-Power is 0.8, Confidential Interval (CI) of 95%. By performing the current research experiment, Novel XGBRegressor Optimizer has achieved an accuracy of 82.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>, ExtraTree Regression has achieved an accuracy of 78.2%. The value of significance is found to be <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{p}=0.000$</tex> after analyzing the results from the independent samples test and hence it is statistically significant as the value of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{p}=0.000$</tex> is found to be greater than <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathrm{p} < 0.05)$</tex>. In the present research article, the Novel XGBRegressor Optimizer is correlated with the ExtraTree algorithm. By succeeding the current research experiment it is found that the Novel XGBRegressor algorithm (82.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>) has more enhanced accuracy than the ExtraTree algorithm (78.2%).

articleTitle: Analytical Approach of Machine Learning for Prediction Models
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: With the increasing availability of data, machine learning (ML) predictive models have become a popular tool for making informed decisions in various fields. However, choosing suitable algorithms and techniques to develop accurate forecasting models is a challenging task. In this study, we aim to compare different ML algorithms and methods to develop accurate prediction models. We analyzed the results to determine the most effective approach to developing accurate forecasting models. In addition, we investigated the effect of hyperparameter tuning on the performance of this model. The results of this study can provide valuable insights for practitioners and researchers in choosing the most appropriate machine learning algorithms and methods to develop accurate prediction models. Our study shows the impact of choosing the right features and choosing the method of data pre-processing and hyperparameter tuning on model performance. Finally, our results can inform the design of more accurate prediction models and contribute to the development of the field of machine learning.

articleTitle: Employee Appraisal Prediction Using Classification Models
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: This paper presents a study that leverages machine learning techniques to determine employee performance using available data in organizations. The objective is to detect the key causes of attrition and minimize them through data analysis. The methodology involves data acquisition, conditioning, visualization, and classification using classification models like Random Forest, Support Vector Machine, K-Nearest Neighbor, Decision Tree, and Naive Bayes algorithms in Python. The results are evaluated using an accuracy score and confusion matrix, revealing that the Decision Tree XGBoost algorithm achieved the highest accuracy at 82.7%. However, Naive Bayes and Support Vector Machine models performed better in classifying true positives. This research provides valuable insights for organizations seeking to utilize data to understand and address attrition issues.

articleTitle: Getting Started: First Person Shooter Game Using Unity
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In recent years, Unity has become a well-known cross-platform game engine. Users will feel completely immersed in it because it has realistic-sounding music, video, lighting, graphics and physics effects. The success of Unity is a result of its vibrant community. It varies from other gameplay engines in that it has rigid body characteristics and built-in physics. Utilizing coders and products from the Unity platform, instructional materials, movies, and video games are all produced. First-person shooting, or fps, games built on the Unity engine are addressed in this study.

articleTitle: Prediction of Defective Artifacts by Removing Redundant Metrics in Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Software defect prediction (SDP) models aid software testing teams in forecasting faulty artifacts prior to actual testing. Software Development Process (SDP) models aim to comprehend previous shortcomings based on software metrics data that resulted in faulty modules. Previous research has determined that defect prediction models constructed without eliminating superfluous metrics yield unforeseen outcomes. This study examines the effect of superfluous metrics on the defect prediction performance of different software development processes. Through the analysis of five publicly available datasets containing system defects, it was determined that significant portions of the metrics examined were found to be superfluous and had only a negligible impact on predictive capabilities. The aforementioned observation leads to the inference that the development of a proficient defect prediction model necessitates the elimination of superfluous metrics from the datasets.

articleTitle: Use of Neural Machine Translation in Multimodal Translation
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Multimodal Neural Machine Translation (MNMT) is a type of Machine Translation that allows the translation of source language that contains various forms of information, such as images, video, audio, and signs, into the target language while maintaining the intended meaning of the source language. In MNMT, the use of deep learning techniques such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) are required to process different modalities and to generate an appropriate translation. The use of attention mechanisms, early and late fusion techniques, and hierarchical fusion have significantly improved the accuracy and fluency of translation. The performance of different MNMT systems can be evaluated in terms of various metrics such as BLEU score, accuracy, and fluency. MNMT has the potential to revolutionise the way we communicate by bridging the gap between different languages and cultures. The integration of MNMT in various industries, such as e-commerce, tourism, and healthcare, can bring significant benefits in terms of customer experience and accessibility. It states how Neural Machine Translation plays a significant role in processing different modalities in Multimodal Neural Machine Translation. More research work in this field can produce effective and innovative ideas to improve Multimodal Neural Machine Translation.

articleTitle: Skin Lesions Segmentation by Artificial Learning and Immune System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Medical image diagnosis increases the efficiency of health specialists. In order to further improve image diagnosis researcher has proposed various image processing models. This paper has proposed a model that works on skin lesions detection. Segmentation of the infected region of the image was done by the use of an artificial immune genetic algorithm. It was found that the use of artificial neural networks for the initial population generation has increased the cluster center selection of the genetic algorithm. The proposed model does not need prior information on an input image. Artificial affinity estimation for cloning and mutation reduces the iteration of the model. The experiment was done on reading skin lesion dataset. Results demonstrate that the suggested model, when compared to earlier existing skin segmentation models, has enhanced the work precision, recall, and accuracy values factors.

articleTitle: Blockchain-Based eCommerce Warranty System Using NFTs
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Blockchain-based e-commerce NFT warranty system is a new solution that allows customers to receive digital warranty for their purchases on e-commerce platforms. The system is built using the Ethereum blockchain and uses non-fiscal tokens (NFTs) to set up and execute transactions. This project aims to solve the physical certificate management problem and the challenge of warranty tracking for customers and companies. With the NFT warranty system, customers can store the warranty in their connected digital wallet and easily send it to other users when selling. Also, companies do not need to manage services separately, as authentication and authorization are tracked by a blockchain-based system. The advantage of this project is that it provides a secure and transparent warranty system that prevents fraud and counterfeit products. Additionally, the use of NFTs ensures the authenticity and authenticity of all warranties, thus preventing competition or abuse of warranties. The project works by allowing companies to join e-commerce sites and add their vendors to generate NFT security tokens. When customers make a purchase, they receive a digital NFT warranty that they can use for warranty service. Warranty claims are recorded on the blockchain and can be tracked by both the customer and the company. The system also adds value to customers' purchases by allowing them to resell NFT-warrantied products. All in all, the blockchain-based e-commerce NFT warranty system is a cutting-edge solution that will simplify the warranty process for clients and customers. company. It offers an easy-to-use, secure and transparent warranty system and provides added value to customers.

articleTitle: Innovative Empirical Approaches for Behavioural Finance Research
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: An interdisciplinary subject matter referred to as behavioral finance, which mixes psychology and economics, has shed focus on the intricacies of human being's actions inside the economic marketplace. Even though they're beneficial, traditional conventional methods often fall short of capturing the complex and illogical components of decision-making which can be at the coronary heart of behavioral finance phenomena. This research paper examines present-day empirical techniques that provide new vantage factors and better comprehension of behavioral finance. We begin by means of intensive observation of the literature to discover any gaps or restrictions in the methods currently being used in research. Then, we present a huge range of current empirical methodologies, such as neuro-finance, experiential economics, huge records evaluation, and blockchain strategies. With the use of those methods, we may also explore investor behavior, sensory evaluation, and marker dynamics in new ways. This study demonstrates the changing nature of behavioral finance research, which is defined by cutting-edge empirical strategies that make use of big data, neuro-finance, experimental techniques, and cross-disciplinary cooperation.

articleTitle: Fake News Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Due to the increase in smart devices and internet usage in recent years, there is a lot of material created every second. The abundance of information has led to the rapid spread of false information in today's society, which is a serious issue. In this research, we developed a fake news classifier that uses natural language processing methods and three distinct openly accessible internet datasets to accurately and automatically identify fake news articles. Our model, which utilized pre-trained recurrent neural net architecture, achieved an accuracy rate of over 90%. This demonstrates the potency of our strategy and the potential of machine learning in the battle against fake news.

articleTitle: Early Cardiovascular Disease Detection Using Ensemble Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Finding cardiovascular disease symptoms as early as feasible is one of the most difficult tasks for medics. The annual death toll from cardiovascular disease is high around the world. Heart disease must be promptly treated because it is a serious problem. It is difficult to diagnose cardiac disease because of numerous factors that might impair health, including high blood pressure, raised cholesterol, an irregular heartbeat, and many more. Thus, early disease detection and treatment are made possible by artificial intelligence. This study suggests an ensemble-based method for predicting a person's risk of cardiovascular disease using machine learning (ML). In order to forecast cardiovascular disease, we use five categorization methods and by tuning the hyperparameters of the models, we get an accuracy of 92.96%. Majority voting was employed to reduce the number of false results.

articleTitle: Design of Hydrodynamic Journal Bearing for Integrally Geared Centrifugal Compressor
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: With performance considerations driving the design of rotating equipment, operating speeds and journal loads have increased greatly in recent years, often exceeding generally accepted design limits. For high performance applications including integrally geared compressors, tilting pad bearings are often used as they are subjected to both high speeds and loads. This paper presents design of tilting pad bearing for an integrally geared centrifugal compressor where the shaft stiffness and the bearing stiffness are in the moderate range. A rotor model was created to study the response of the system. Critical speed mode shapes, undamped critical speed map and Bode plot are plotted for this rotor model. The analysis is carried out at maximum continuous operating speed of 31000 rpm (± 5%) which lies between the 2nd and 3rd critical speeds. This paper illustrates design of tilting pad bearing along with rotordynamic analysis which helps to explain the rotor response and provide assurance that Separation Margin are within acceptable limits mentioned in API-672. Speed at the vibration probe location of the rotor from the DyRoBeS software and on-site data of the same are compared in which we observed a percentage variation of 3.29% in first stage vibration probe location and 10.9% in second stage vibration probe location which are within acceptable limits.

articleTitle: An Innovative Method of Temperament Identification Using Text Messages and Social Media History with Gated Recurrent Unit Algorithm in comparison with Support Vector Machine Algorithm for Improved Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The research aims to boost the accuracy of Innovative Temperament identification using social media and text messages. The proposed GRU algorithm was compared with SVM algorithm, a widely used algorithm in text classification. Materials and Methods: In order to anticipate an individual's nature by assessing their thoughts and intentions at an increased rate, the Gated Recurrent Unit algorithm and the Support Vector Machine (SVM) with a total of 20 iterations (N equals to 10 each) are utilized for the sample size of 3062. GRU and SVM are utilized for temperament analysis, with different training and testing splits. Kaggle website is used for retrieving the datasets from the csv file repositories which serves as the origin of the data used in the study. The statistical calculations are made with a G-power of 0.80 and alpha quality, beta qualities are 0.05, 0.2 respectively with the confidence interval consisting of 95%. Result: The results indicate that the GRU algorithm with 93.40% accuracy and 6.59% loss outperformed the SVM algorithm with accuracy 88.59% and 11.40% loss. The independent sample t- Test analysis with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{p} < 0.05$</tex> was employed to analyze the significance value and retrieved a value of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{p}=0.052$</tex>. i.e. there is no significant difference between the two groups. This research contributes to the development of methods for the Innovative Temperament identification using social media and text messages. Conclusion: The comparison of GRU is performed with the SVM algorithm and observed that the accuracy value of the Gated Recurrent Unit is 93.40% when compared to the accuracy value of the Support Vector Machine with 88.59%.

articleTitle: Hand Sign & Gesture Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Hand gestures serve as a form of non-verbal communication utilized in sign language, primarily employed by individuals who are deaf or have hearing impairments to communicate with those who do not share the same condition. While numerous sign language generators exist, none of them offer customization options or cost-effectiveness for end users. This proposed work outlines a prototype system named the Hand Sign and Gesture Recognition System Software. The system aims to automatically interpret sign language, facilitating smoother communication between individuals who are hearing and those who are deaf. Particularly, the system can be implemented on popular video-sharing platforms like YouTube, which currently lack an auto-text creation feature for gestures and sign language. The system utilizes a real-time hand gesture recognition mechanism that employs shape-based features such as orientation, centroid of the center of mass, finger state, and thumb position relative to extended or folded fingers to identify gestures. A convolutional neural network (CNN) supervises the entire feature extraction process. Each frame of the video is captured, allowing the identification and isolation of hands for processing by the CNN. The system achieved a remarkable test accuracy of 99.89% by employing CNNs for both training and testing. An advantage of this approach is its independence from external hardware or devices, as it operates solely through the software implementation.

articleTitle: Study and Implementation of Quantum AI Algorithms and Comparison with Classical AI Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: TensorFlow and TensorFlow Quantum are two frameworks developed by Google that provide powerful tools for machine learning and quantum machine learning, respectively. While both are based on the same foundational concepts of tensors and automatic differentiation, they differ in their approach to modeling data and computation.While TensorFlow and TensorFlow Quantum share some similarities in terms of their underlying principles, they are designed to address distinct problem domains. Understanding the differences between these two frameworks using the same dataset to compare the efficiency of both systems can help choose the right tool for specific needs, whether they are working on classical machine learning problems or exploring the potential of quantum computing.

articleTitle: Analysis of Access Time in Malicious Application Detection Using You Only Look Once V3-Spatial Pyramid Pooling in Comparison with You Only Look Once
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Aim: This research aims to predict the vulnerabilities in native applications using the Novel YOLO V3 SPP algorithm in comparison with YOLO algorithm to compute access time. Materials and Methods: Access time is calculated using the Novel YOLO V3 SPP algorithm of the sample size of (N=25) with the total sample size is (N=50) and G power is computed to be 80%. Results: Novel YOLO V3 SPP has access time which takes more time (83.36ms) than the YOLO algorithm has (79.72ms) in data exploitation prediction. There is no statistical significance difference among Novel YOLO V3 SPP with YOLO Algorithm with p=0.239 (Independent sample t-test p<0.05). Conclusion: Novel YOLO V3 SPP algorithm has a more access time of 83.36ms compared to YOLO algorithm access time of 79.72ms in predicting vulnerabilities in native applications.

Author Keywords: Novel You Only Look Once V3-Spatial Pyramid Pooling

articleTitle: Descriptive Analysis of Feature Selection and Clustering Algorithms for Optimized Drug Toxicity Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Prediction of toxicity is a great challenge over the years. The development of a new drug or chemical compound is quite an expensive and complex process. Artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques give new insights into drug toxicity prediction. A quantitative structure-activity relationship has accomplished significant advancements in the field of toxicity prediction. Feature selection algorithms in machine learning help to assign ranks to selected features depending upon the priorities and importance. This paper focuses on analyzing and identifying prominent features using different feature selection algorithms. The ranking is assigned to the features based on the weightage assigned. Five feature selection techniques Principal components analysis, Correlation attribute evaluator, Relief F attribute evaluator, Classifier subset evaluator I, and Classifier subset evaluator II are used for four different machine learning models to calculate accuracy and error as well. The correlation attribute evaluator achieved the highest accuracy with each algorithm in comparison to other techniques. Ten folds of cross-validation are used to create a robust model. Further cluster analysis helps in improving the performance of the prediction model. Cluster analysis is also performed using seven different clustering algorithms. Canopy, EM, Filter Clusterer, Farthest First, Hierarchical Clusterer, k - Means Clusterer, and Density-based Clusterer are applied to analyze for the number of clusters, count of iterations, and duration to develop the model. The different results from distinct feature selection and clustering algorithms are considered. Analysis of important features and cluster-wise analysis help in building the optimized prediction model for prediction of the toxicity.

articleTitle: Secure Supply Chain Management Framework Using Otway-Rees Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: By compromising third-party defenses or exploiting a vulnerability in a vendor-provided solution, an attacker with access to client data and systems can get access to supply chain management's digital infrastructure. There is a risk of losing openness, traceability, and integrity as a result of the problems. We will provide a secure supply chain management architecture that uses the symmetric key, the Otway-Rees protocol for session key generation, and BlockChain to guarantee on-time commodity delivery to customers in this work.

articleTitle: An Integrated and Optimized Fog Computing enabled Framework to minimize Time Complexity in Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: A distributed computing paradigm known as “cloud computing” works as a connection between IoT devices and cloud data centres. The environment system model in this work is on basis of clouds and fog and includes smart grids, which we explore. Prior to understanding the use of fog computing in smart grids we discuss about various features of cloud computing and talk about how to manage the connection between fog and cloud computing. Along with the usual performance of low latency, low cost, and high intelligence, the distinctive characteristics and service scenarios are also explored. Based on the outcome of the simulation, it appears that our suggested PSO-SA algorithm outperforms other optimization algorithms. It recorded a least mean response time of 3.86 seconds only. While the model build up delay was 4.6 seconds, the model execution delay was also found to be only 4.9 seconds with PSO-SA method. The improved efficiency of the technique can be credited to the best aspects of particle swarm optimisation (PSO) and a modified inertia weight obtained by simulated annealing.

articleTitle: Long Term Electricity Load Forecasting for Garhwal Region of Uttarakhand Using Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The one of the hill state Uttarakhand of India is full of flaura and fauna. The Char Dham Yatra of the state is very famous. Rishikesh city famous for Yog Sadhna and Haridwar is for pilgrims. Dehradun City is the capital of Uttarakhand where is also known as Smart City. The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) has listed Dehradun Smart City among third round cities in India. The initiative Electric Bus introduces Dehradun Smart City as carbon free city. There are 30 Electric Buses planned in Phase-1. Each Electric Bus is equipped with GPS, CCTV Surveillance and Emergency Panic Button. The estimated arrival time (ETA) is linked to Smart Bus Shelters where a digital screen is showing its arrival and waiting time and current position in the city. There are 49 Smart Traffic junctions in the Dehradun Smart City which are connected with Integrated Command and Control Centre (ICCC). The arrangement for charging these electric buses have been arranged near the ISBT area. Each Electric Bus takes 2–3 hours for full charging. Vision 2030 is the mission of Uttarakhand Government which includes Electric Vehicle Policy of Uttarakhand Government and Shoonaya Mission of Government of India through which by 2040 sixty percent vehicle will be electric. For smooth functioning of Electric Vehicles charging infrastructure is essential and demand of electricity will be high. There would be high demand of electricity due to invasion of Electric Vehicles. The Generation and Distribution Company needs to predict the electricity demand on Long Terms in Uttarakhand. In this paper the study focuses on five years electricity Load Forecasting. The MATLAB tool is used to predict the demand using Scaled Conjugate Method which uses Deep Learning algorithm.

articleTitle: Enhancing Sentiment Analysis In Text Of Social Media Texts Using Hybrid Deep Learning Model And Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Sentiment analysis (SA) is a mechanized strategy for finding and understanding the feelings depicted in text. Over the most recent decade, SA has altogether expanded in ubiquity in the Natural Language Processing (NLP) people group. One emotion that has a negative effect on people's daily life is depression. Every year, more people around the world report having long-lasting feelings. Finding persons with depression as early as possible is one of the most difficult difficulties. Researchers are analyzing text content posted on social media using Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques, which helps to develop methods for Depression detection. This study examines various earlier investigations that employed learning strategies to recognize depression. The current approaches have issues with better model representation that make it difficult to accurately identify depression from literature. Fast message in the ongoing undertaking to address an answer for these issues, Fast text Convolution Neural Network with Long Momentary Memory (FCL), an original hybrid deep learning brain network plan with improved message portrayals, is made. Real-world datasets that were used in the literature were used to implement the current study. The suggested method achieves higher accuracy in detecting depression than the state-of-the-art.

articleTitle: Secure and Enhanced Medical Data Repository
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Healthc are industry is one of the most hypersensitive sectors which is directly connected to us in all of the following possible ways-emotionally, mentally, physical and financially. The development of the economy and new technology in this sector creates an impact that requires immediate attention to address and solve the forthcoming challenges.In this paper, we propose the idea of creating a secure and robust data management model that stores and manages the lifetime medical history of every individual. This advanced architecture includes a data management model which uses a non-relational database that is capable of handling large amounts of unstructured data. It also allows us to create rooms for the addition of new data.

articleTitle: Computer-Aided Diagnosis for Breast Cancer Classification Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: In today's world, breast Cancer is one of the most deadly diseases among women, although early detection dramatically improves survival rate. CNN Models are the category of DL architecture that was developed to improve accuracy in breast cancer categorization. Compared to traditional methods, CNN has demonstrated better classification efficiency and tumor detection in medical imaging. Based on deep CNN architectures This research provides a new breast cancer classification system. This research provides a new breast cancer classification system based on deep CNN architectures. To develop a technique for early and accurate breast cancer detection in order to avoid wasteful therapy (error 1) due to False Positive and late treatment (error 2) owing to False Negative is the main aim of this research methodology. The primary goal of this work is to prevent error 2, for which we employ Resnet-152.

articleTitle: Comparative Energy & Hardware Analysis on Implementation of Full Subtractor Using Different FPGAs Families
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: There are major energy challenges in several developing countries. The development of an effective Full subtractor using the Vivado software platform and multiple generations of FPGAs has contributed to the advancement of environmentally aware communication. Many different families of FPGAs were analyzed to accomplish this goal. Genesys, Kintex, and Artix series boards of FPGAs are used. Studies were conducted to determine which FPGA family required the least amount of electricity overall. Genesys uses 1.065 W, Kintex uses 1.154 W, and Artix uses 1.034 W of electricity respectively. The temperatures on Genesys and Artix are at 58.1 degrees Celsius, but Kintex is at 73.4 degrees Celsius. Following the guidelines for using the Genesys family of 7 series of components instead of the other two families will help reduce the amount of power lost due to dissipation. The power efficiency of Artix is comparable to that of other FPGA families. Artix Boards outperform both the Genesys and Kintex boards in terms of energy efficiency, cost, size, and performance.

articleTitle: Cognitive Defense Cyber Attack Prediction and Security Design in Machine Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Companies of all sizes in today's linked digital world are susceptible to cyber dangers. In this study, we provide a novel approach to cyber defence that integrates machine learning with cognitive defensive techniques to identify and prevent cyber attacks in their tracks. We built three ML models that use cognitive defensive strategies and other cutting-edge security measures like encryption and intrusion detection. A 95% accuracy rate was reached by our models, which is far greater than where things stand right now models. Our work has the potential to have a huge effect since the models we've developed may one day help businesses take a more preventative stance against cyber threats. Our findings may potentially be used to fields outside than cyber security. Overall, our study shows that machine learning and cognitive defense are useful for foreseeing and stopping cyber threats, and points the way toward fruitful future study in this area.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Energy Optimization Techniques for WSN Based Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The primary aim is to Minimizing energy consumption and increasing the durability of the sensor network. The implementation of hierarchical routing can efficiently decrease energy usage within a cluster through the process of data aggregation and fusion, ultimately leading to a reduction in the number of messages transmitted to the base station. The generation of optimal clusters is contingent upon the execution of cluster head selection and cluster formation procedures. It is recommended to minimize the quantity of messages exchanged while simultaneously ensuring that the overall time complexity remains stable and unaffected by the expansion of the network. The objective of this investigation is to optimize energy efficiency through the elimination of the setup phase for cluster head selection, which is based on the criterion of maximum residual energy. Instead, the study proposes to proceed with the steady phase until the average energy of the cluster is attained. The principal objective of this study is to enhance energy efficiency and prolong the longevity of the network. Numerous techniques have been proposed for the purpose of optimizing energy, such as LEACH, HEED, and EECS. However, our proposed approach is deemed superior and more precise. A comparative analysis has been conducted to support this assertion.

articleTitle: SVM Based AutoEncoder for Detecting Dementia in Young Adults
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: Dementia's impact on cognitive function necessitates timely diagnosis for effective intervention. Understanding the need for timely detection, the proposed work integrates SVM's decision boundary determination and autoencoder's noise reduction capabilities. The proposed work advances in dementia detection in young adult. Results indicate promising performance, with the model achieving high accuracy around 85.33%. The ROC curve illustrates a balanced trade-off between sensitivity and specificity, while the precision-recall curve highlights effective classification. Importantly, the model surpasses existing literature, underscoring its practical utility. While acknowledging limitations, such as parameter fine-tuning, this study lays the groundwork for refining and expanding this innovative methodology. In summary, this research contributes to the urgent field of early dementia detection, potentially transforming patient care and intervention strategies.

articleTitle: Big Data and Reinforcement Learning, Emg Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The need of creating improved that are better equipped to manage “big data” has significantly grown due to the growing volume of data in electromyographic signal study. As a result, increasingly sophisticated created. This essay starts with a succinct overview of the key driving forces behind the expansion of big data age, then moves on to discuss the recent development of current shared data sets. After that, we cover current research and advancements in pattern recognition techniques that can be used for big data analytics. These new signal analysis approaches may be classified into two primary categories engineering utilizing a potential large specific focus on “deep learning”. Finally, suggestions for further pattern research are presented and explored.

articleTitle: Analyzing Breast Cancer Detection: A Scopus-driven Study on the Role of Machine Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: The common and occasionally fatal condition known as breast cancer affects millions of people worldwide. Early detection and precise diagnosis are essential for enhancing patient health, and their importance cannot be overstated. Machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) techniques obligate recently made substantial progress in the identification and diagnosis of breast cancer. This paper gives a thorough review of how ML and DL are used to detect breast cancer. The evaluation of yearly publication trends, citation analysis, prominent sources, and keyword distributions is done using data gathered from Scopus from 2008 through 2023 in order to give future academics insight into this field's research tendencies. The technique emphasizes the dynamic character of research by showing that more recent papers have shorter epochs of influence.

articleTitle: A Survey of Localization Techniques for Navigation in Road Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 6th International Conference on Contemporary Computing and Informatics (IC3I)
abstract: GPS localization is the technique of using the GPS (Global Positioning System) to pinpoint the exact location of a device or object on the surface of the planet. Due to a variety of circumstances, including satellite geometry, signal blockage, atmospheric conditions, multipath effects, and several other causes, GPS signals can occasionally experience mistakes and inaccuracies. In road networks, GPS localization methods primarily target on-road cars.
